works.author: al-Tabrīzī (compiler); Capt. A. N. Matthews (English translator)
works.description_en: A selection from Capt. A. N. Matthews' 1809 English translation of the Mishkât-ul-Masâbih, the celebrated hadith manual of al-Tabrīzī: the chapters of the first volume in which the Prophet's ﷺ own worship comes to the front. Matthews, a Bengal Artillery officer, wrote in his preface that a translation's 'principal merit is fidelity'. Further chapters will follow as the volume is worked through; the second volume (1810), covering his dress and daily life, has never been publicly digitized and will be added when a scan exists.
works.source_en: Arabic text: the Mishkât of al-Tabrīzī, classical and in the public domain, from the Shamela digitization of the Ihya al-Turath print. English: Capt. A. N. Matthews, 'Mishcât-ul-Masâbih' (Calcutta: T. Hubbard, Hindoostanee Press, 1809, vol. 1), in the public domain, checked against the scanned pages. Matthews' chapter headings are kept as printed; his marginal notes are omitted. A modern simplification in present-day English, made for this project, appears beneath Matthews' text as a reading aid. It is a simplification of the Victorian translation it accompanies, not a new translation of the Arabic. The Matthews translation remains the citable text. Where Matthews' narrator attributions differ from the Arabic shown, the Arabic is authoritative.

sections.heading: On Repeating Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XVII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XVII of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 190-194. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on the tashahhud (reports 919-938); Matthews omits report 934. His 'A. G. s.' = 'Apostle of God said'.

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ: لَقِيَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَلَا أُهْدِي لَكَ هَدِيَّةً سَمِعْتُهَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى فَأَهْدِهَا لِي فَقَالَ سَأَلْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ عَلَّمَنَا كَيْفَ نُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكُم قَالَ: «قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صل عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حُمَيْدٌ مجيد اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّك حميد مجيد» . إِلَّا أَنَّ مُسْلِمًا لَمْ يَذْكُرْ " عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْمَوْضِعَيْنِ
units.en: Abd-ul-Rahman-bin-Abi-Laila said; Cab-bin-Ujra met me and said, "shall I send you a present of a saying which I heard from the Prophet?" I said to him, "yes, send it to me." He said, "I asked the Prophet, saying, O messenger of God! how must I send blessings on thee? For verily God hath ordered me to do so." He said, "thou must say, O Lord! peace be with Muhammed and his family, in the manner that thou didst send blessings on Ibrahim and his family: for verily thou art praised and glorified. O Lord! increase thy compassion on Muhammed as thou didst on Ibrahim and his family: for verily thou art praised and glorified."
units.en2: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā narrates: Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra met me and said, "Shall I give you a gift — something I heard from the Prophet ﷺ?" I said, "Yes, do give it to me." He said: We asked the Messenger of Allah, "O Messenger of Allah, how should we invoke blessings upon you, the people of the House? For Allah has already taught us how to greet you with peace." He said: "Say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bestow grace upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You bestowed grace upon Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي حميد السَّاعِدِيِّ قَالَ: قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ نصلي عَلَيْك؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " قُولُوا: اللَّهُمَّ صلى الله عَلَيْهِ وَسلم عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حُمَيْدٌ مجيد "
units.en: Abu-Humaid-al-Sa'idi said, "the companions said, O Prophet, how shall we send up blessings on thee?" He said, say "O Lord! have mercy on Muhammed, his wives and children; like unto that which thou hadst on Ibrahim: and increase thy grace on Muhammed, his wives and children; as thou didst on Ibrahim; for verily thou art praised and glorified."
units.en2: Abū Humayd al-Sāʿidī narrates: They said, "O Messenger of Allah, how do we invoke blessings upon you?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Say: O Allah, bless Muhammad, his wives and his descendants, as You blessed the family of Ibrāhīm; and bestow grace upon Muhammad, his wives and his descendants, as You bestowed grace upon the family of Ibrāhīm — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عشرا»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. The Prophet said, "that person who sendeth blessings on me once, may God send blessings on him ten times."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him."

units.ar: عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرَ صَلَوَاتٍ وَحُطَّتْ عَنْهُ عَشْرُ خَطِيئَاتٍ وَرُفِعَتْ لَهُ عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "That person who sendeth blessings on me once, may God send blessings on him ten times: and ten faults will be struck off from his list, and he will be exalted ten steps."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him, ten faults are erased from his record, and he is raised ten degrees."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: «أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ عَلَيَّ صَلَاة»
units.en: Ibn Mas'ud. A. G. s. "That person will be nearest to me on the day of the resurrection who shall have repeated many blessings on me."
units.en2: Ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The closest of people to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those who sent the most blessings upon me."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِيَ السَّلَامَ»
units.en: A. G. s. "Verily there are angels that move on the earth for God, that cause to reach me the blessings and prayers which my sects send up for me."
units.en2: Ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah has angels who travel through the earth, bringing me the greetings of peace from my community."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلَّا رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. The Prophet said, "there is not any one who sendeth peace on me, but God sendeth it to my spirit, in order that I may return peace on him."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No one greets me with peace without Allah restoring my spirit to me, so that I may return his greeting."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «لَا تَجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قُبُورًا وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيدًا وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ فَإِنَّ صَلَاتكُمْ تبلغني حَيْثُ كُنْتُم»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. "I heard the messenger of God order; make not your houses your graves; but say your prayers in them the same as in a Masjid; perform the prayers established by divine commandment in a Masjid, and those which were appointed by the Prophet in your houses: and send blessings on me, because they reach me wherever you may be."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Do not make your houses graves, and do not make my grave a place of festival; and send blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me wherever you are."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «رَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ وَرَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَمَضَانُ ثُمَّ انْسَلَخَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُغْفَرَ لَهُ وَرَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَوَاهُ الْكبر أَو أَحدهمَا فَلم يدْخلَاهُ الْجنَّة»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "May he perish before whom I may have mentioned it, and he doth not send blessings on me: and may that man be destroyed who passed through the month of Ramdan without worshipping, as a means of the remission of his sins; and may that man suffer perdition whose parents shall be aged, or either of them, and he behaves not well to them, as a means of his entering into paradise."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "May he be humbled — the man before whom I am mentioned and who does not then send blessings upon me; may he be humbled — the man who enters Ramaḍān and leaves it without being forgiven; and may he be humbled — the man whose parents reach old age in his care and yet do not admit him into Paradise."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي طَلْحَة أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَاءَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَالْبِشْرُ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ: " إِنَّهُ جَاءَنِي جِبْرِيلُ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقُولُ أَمَا يُرْضِيكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَنْ لَا يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ إِلَّا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا وَلَا يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ إِلَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا؟ "
units.en: Abu Talhah. Verily the Prophet came one day, with pleasure appearing in his countenance, and said, "verily Gabriel came to me and said, thy Lord saith, be satisfied, O! Muhammed! for that person who sendeth blessings on thee once, I will send blessings on him ten times: and whoever sendeth peace to thee once, I will send peace to him ten times."
units.en2: Abū Ṭalḥa narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out one day with joy visible on his face, and said: "Gabriel came to me and said: Your Lord says — does it not please you, Muhammad, that none of your community sends blessings upon you without My sending ten blessings upon him, and none greets you with peace without My greeting him tenfold?"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُكْثِرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيْكَ فَكَمْ أَجْعَلُ لَكَ مِنْ صَلَاتِي؟ فَقَالَ: «مَا شِئْتَ» قُلْتُ: الرُّبُعَ؟ قَالَ: «مَا شِئْتَ فَإِنْ زِدْتَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» . قُلْتُ: النِّصْفَ؟ قَالَ: «مَا شِئْتَ فَإِنْ زِدْتَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» قُلْتُ: فَالثُّلُثَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: «مَا شِئْتَ فَإِنْ زِدْتَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» قُلْتُ: أَجْعَلُ لَكَ صَلَاتِي كُلَّهَا؟ قَالَ: «إِذا يكفى همك وَيكفر لَك ذَنْبك»
units.en: Ubai-bin-Cab said, "I said, O messenger of God! verily, I wish to send a great many blessings on thee; then what space of time shall I allot for that purpose?" He said, "any time that thou likest." I said, "shall I appropriate a fourth of my time for this purpose?" He said, "any proportion of time that thou chusest, and the more the better for thee." I said, "shall I allot half my time?" The Prophet said, "whatever thou likest: but the more the better." I then said, "shall I appropriate two thirds?" He said, "as thou pleasest, the more the better for thee." Then I said, "I will give up my whole time in sending up blessings on thee." Then the Prophet said, "in these times thou wilt obtain all thy wishes, both worldly and in futurity, and all thy faults will be hidden, external and internal, first and last."
units.en2: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb narrates: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I send many blessings upon you — how much of my supplication should I devote to you?" He said, "Whatever you wish." I said, "A fourth?" He said, "Whatever you wish — and if you do more, it is better for you." I said, "A half?" He said, "Whatever you wish — and if you do more, it is better for you." I said, "Two-thirds?" He said, "Whatever you wish — and if you do more, it is better for you." I said, "I shall devote all of my supplication to you." He said, "Then your worries will be taken care of, and your sins forgiven."

units.ar: وَعَن فضَالة بن عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَاعِدٌ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَصَلَّى فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «عَجِلْتَ أَيُّهَا الْمُصَلِّي إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ فَقَعَدْتَ فَاحْمَدِ اللَّهَ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ وَصَلِّ عَلَيَّ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُ» . قَالَ: ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَجُلٌ آخَرُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَصَلَّى عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَيُّهَا الْمُصَلِّي ادْعُ تُجَبْ»
units.en: Fad'alah-bin-Ubaid said, "whilst the Prophet was sitting down, a man came in, and said his prayers; after which he said, O Lord! have mercy upon me, and forgive me my sins." Then the Prophet said, "thou wast in haste, for thou didst prefer thy supplications, before pronouncing the praises of God and imploring his grace for me. When thou shalt have performed prayers, sit; and praise God in the manner he is worthy of, and send peace on me; then ask of God any thing that thou wantest." Fad'alah said, "then another man said his prayers, and praised God, and implored peace on the Prophet. Then the Prophet said to him, O thou that prayest, ask whatever thou wantest and it will be approved."
units.en2: Faḍāla ibn ʿUbayd narrates: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting, a man came in, prayed, and said: "O Allah, forgive me and have mercy on me." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You have been hasty, O praying man. When you have prayed and sat, praise Allah as He deserves, send blessings upon me, and then make your supplication." Another man then prayed, praised Allah, and sent blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ; and the Prophet said to him: "O praying man, ask, and you will be answered."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا جَلَسْتُ بَدَأْتُ بِالثَّنَاءِ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ دَعَوْتُ لِنَفْسِي فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «سَلْ تعطه سل تعطه»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Masu'ud said, "I was saying my prayers in presence of the Prophet; and Ab'ubacr and Omer were also with his highness: and when I sat down after having finished my prayers, I commenced with the praise and glory of God, and grace upon his Prophet; after which I supplicated for myself; when the Prophet said, ask whatever thou desirest, it will be granted thee." This he repeated twice.
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates: I was praying near the Prophet ﷺ, and Abū Bakr and ʿUmar were with him. When I sat, I began with the praise of Allah, then blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, then supplication for myself. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Ask, and you will be given; ask, and you will be given."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَكْتَالَ بِالْمِكْيَالِ الْأَوْفَى إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَيْنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ على مُحَمَّد وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حُمَيْدٌ مَجِيدٌ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Whoever is desirous of obtaining the complete object of his wishes, when he sends blessings on me, he must say this; O Lord! send grace on Muhammed, the illiterate Prophet; and on his wives, who are the mothers of the faithful; and send grace on his children and family; like the prayers for the family of Ibrahim; for verily thou art praised and glorified."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever wishes to measure with the fullest measure when he sends blessings upon us, the people of the House, should say: O Allah, send grace upon Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon his wives, the Mothers of the Believers, and upon his descendants and the people of his house, as You sent grace upon the family of Ibrāhīm — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الْبَخِيلُ الَّذِي ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ» وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ غَرِيبٌ
units.en: Ali-ibn-Ab'ut'alib. A. G. s. "That person is a miser, before whom my name shall be mentioned, and he does not send blessings on me."
units.en2: ʿAlī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The miser is the one before whom I am mentioned and who does not send blessings upon me."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ سَبْعِينَ صَلَاةً
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Omer. A. G. s. "That person who sends blessings on me once, God and his angels will send blessings on him seventy times."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr narrates: "Whoever sends one blessing upon the Prophet ﷺ, Allah and His angels send seventy blessings upon him."

units.ar: وَعَن رويفع أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْزِلْهُ الْمَقْعَدَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَجَبَتْ لَهُ شَفَاعَتِي "
units.en: Ruwaifi-bin-Tha'bit. A. G. s. "That person who sends blessings on the Prophet and says, O Lord! place Muhammed on that seat, which is appointed to be near thee on the day of resurrection, I will be his saviour."
units.en2: Ruwayfiʿ ibn Thābit narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sends blessings upon Muhammad and says, 'O Allah, seat him in the Near Station beside You on the Day of Resurrection,' my intercession is guaranteed for him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ قَالَ: خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ نَخْلًا فَسَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ حَتَّى خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى قَدْ تَوَفَّاهُ. قَالَ: فَجِئْتُ أَنْظُرُ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ: «مَا لَكَ؟» فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ. قَالَ: فَقَالَ: " إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام قَالَ لي: أَلا أُبَشِّرك أَن اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَقُولُ لَكَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْكَ صَلَاةً صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ سلمت عَلَيْهِ "
units.en: Abdulrahman-bin-Awf said, "the Prophet came out and went into a date-garden, and prostrated himself a long time; till I was afraid that God had taken his soul away. Then I went and looked at him; when he said, what is come to you, and what are you about? And I told him what I had imagined. Then his highness said, Gabriel said to me, shall I not give thee joyful tidings? Almighty God saith for thee, that person who shall send blessings on thee, I will send blessings on him; and he who sendeth peace on thee, I will send peace on him."
units.en2: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAwf narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out and entered a palm-grove, and prostrated for so long that I feared Allah had taken his soul. I came to look; he raised his head and said, "What is the matter with you?" I told him what I had feared, and he said: "Gabriel, peace be upon him, said to me: Shall I not give you glad tidings? Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says to you: whoever sends blessings upon you, I bless; and whoever greets you with peace, I greet with peace."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: إِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ مَوْقُوفٌ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا يَصْعَدُ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى نبيك
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khat'tab said, "verily supplications stop between the heavens and the earth; and no part of them is carried up, till you send blessings on your Prophet."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: "Supplication is suspended between heaven and earth; none of it rises until you send blessings upon your Prophet."

sections.heading: On Supplications after the Profession of Faith (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XVIII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XVIII of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 195-198. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on supplications in the tashahhud (reports 939-958); Matthews omits reports 941, 951, and 952.

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدْعُو فِي الصَّلَاةِ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَمَاتِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ قَائِلٌ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تَسْتَعِيذُ مِنَ الْمَغْرَمِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا غَرِمَ حَدَّثَ فَكَذَبَ وَوَعَدَ فَأَخْلَفَ»
units.en: Aayeshah. The Prophet would supplicate after the profession of faith in these words: "O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from the punishments of the grave; and from the strife of Dajjal, who will come at the end of time, and pretend to be God: and I seek for an asylum with thee, from the calamities of life and death. O Lord! defend me from sins, and from those deeds which might cause me to fall into sins; and defend me from debt, which might be difficult for me to discharge." Then a person said to his highness, "it is very extraordinary that you should ask protection from debt." Then his majesty explained the mischief of debt, and said, "verily when a man is in debt, he talks about his situation, tells lies, makes promises, and acts contrary to them."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate in prayer with these words: "O Lord, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave; I seek refuge with You from the trial of the False Messiah (al-Dajjāl); and I seek refuge with You from the trials of life and death. O Lord, I seek refuge with You from sin and from debt." Someone said to him, "How frequently you seek refuge from debt!" He replied, "When a person is in debt, he speaks and tells lies, and he makes promises and breaks them."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, the Prophet of God said, "when any one of you hath finished the last profession of faith, he must ask defence from four things; from the punishment of hell and the punishment of the grave; the afflictions of life and death; and the wickedness of Dajjal."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When any of you finishes the final Tashahhud, let him seek refuge with Allah from four things: from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the False Messiah (al-Dajjāl)."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلَاتِي قَالَ: «قُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ»
units.en: Abu'Bakr said, I said, "O Prophet! teach me a supplication to make after the last profession of faith." And the Prophet said, "say O Lord! verily I have tyrannized over my own soul, and no one can pardon the faults of thy servants but thou; then forgive me from thy kindness, and have mercy on me; for verily thou art the forgiver of offences and bestower of favours on thy servants."
units.en2: Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq narrates: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, teach me a supplication to recite in my prayer." He said: "Say: O Allah, I have wronged my soul greatly, and none forgives sins except You; so grant me forgiveness from You, and have mercy upon me — You are the Forgiving, the Merciful."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ حَتَّى أَرَى بَيَاضَ خَدِّهِ
units.en: Aamir-bin-Sa'd-bin-Abi-Wakkas said, that Sa'd said, "I saw the Prophet repeat the Salam to the right and to the left, so that I saw the whiteness of his cheeks."
units.en2: ʿĀmir ibn Saʿd narrates from his father: "I used to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ give the Salām to his right and to his left, until I could see the whiteness of his cheek."

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا صَلَّى أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ
units.en: Samurah-bin-Jundub said, "when the Prophet finished prayers he would turn his face towards us."
units.en2: Samura ibn Jundab narrates: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished prayer, he would turn his face toward us."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ
units.en: Anas said, "the Prophet used, after prayers, to go away from the right."
units.en2: Anas narrates: "The Prophet ﷺ used to depart from his right side after finishing prayer."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: لَا يَجْعَلْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ يَرَى أَنَّ حَقًّا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لَا يَنْصَرِفَ إِلَّا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَثِيرًا يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Mas'ud said, "let not the devil enter into your prayers," and he explained it thus: not to walk away from prayers except from the right.
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd said: "None of you should give Satan a share of his prayer by thinking it is obligatory only to turn away from the right; I often saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turn away to his left."

units.ar: وَعَنِ الْبَرَاءِ قَالَ: كُنَّا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَا خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَحْبَبْنَا أَنْ نَكُونَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ يُقْبِلُ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ قَالَ: فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «رَبِّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ أَوْ تَجْمَعُ عِبَادَكَ»
units.en: Bara ibn Aazib said, "when we said our prayers behind the Prophet, we liked to stand on his right side, that he might turn to us at the time of the Salam. I heard the Prophet say after giving the Salam, 'O Lord! defend me from thy punishments on that day when thou wilt raise up thy servants.'"
units.en2: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib narrates: "When we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we loved to be on his right side so that he would turn toward us first. I heard him say after the Salām: 'O Lord, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ: إِنَّ النِّسَاءَ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كُنَّ إِذَا سَلَّمْنَ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ قُمْنَ وَثَبَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَإِذَا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ الرِّجَالُ
units.en: Umm Salmah said, "when women repeated the Salam in the divine prayers, in the time of the Prophet, they used to rise up and go away before the men; and the Prophet remained sitting, as also the men: and when the Prophet stood up, the men did so likewise."
units.en2: Umm Salama narrates: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when women gave the Salām at the end of the obligatory prayer, they would rise and leave, while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the men remained in their places as long as Allah willed. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up, the men would then stand.

units.ar: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ: أَخَذَ بِيَدِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّكَ يَا مُعَاذُ» فَقُلْتُ: وَأَنَا أُحِبُّكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: «فَلَا تَدَعْ أَنْ تَقُولَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ»
units.en: Muadh bin Jabal said, the Prophet took hold of my hand, and said, "verily I love thee, O Muadh!" and I said, "I love thee, O Prophet of God." He said, "never abandon this supplication at the end of every prayer: O my defender assist me in remembering thee, and being grateful to thee, and in worshipping thee excessively."
units.en2: Muʿādh ibn Jabal narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took my hand and said, "O Muʿādh, indeed I love you!" I said, "And I love you, O Messenger of Allah!" He said, "Never fail to say at the end of every prayer: 'My Lord, help me to remember You, to give You thanks, and to worship You in the best manner.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ: «السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ» حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ: «السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ» حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ الْأَيْسَرِ
units.en: Abdullah bin Mas'ud said, "verily the Prophet used to give the Salam from his right, and said, 'peace be with you and the compassion of God;' so that we saw the whiteness of his right cheek, and then gave the Salam on his left, and said, 'peace be with you and the compassion of God;' so that we saw the whiteness of his left cheek."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give the Salām to his right: "Al-salāmu ʿalaykum wa-raḥmatullāh" until the whiteness of his right cheek was visible, and to his left: "Al-salāmu ʿalaykum wa-raḥmatullāh" until the whiteness of his left cheek was visible.

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يُصَلِّي الْإِمَامُ فِي الْمَوْضِعِ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ حَتَّى يَتَحَوَّلَ»
units.en: Ata Khorasani relates, from Mughairah, that the Prophet said, "an Imam must not pray in the same place that he shall have prayed before, till he move from that place to some other."
units.en2: ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī narrates from al-Mughīra that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "An Imām must not pray in the exact spot where he just led prayer until he has moved to another place."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَضَّهُمْ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفُوا قَبْلَ انْصِرَافِهِ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
units.en: Anas said, "verily the Prophet excited men to say their prayers in multitudes, and prohibited them finishing their prayers and retiring before him."
units.en2: Anas narrates: The Prophet ﷺ urged the people to congregation and forbade them from departing before he had concluded and turned from prayer.

units.ar: وَعَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الثَّبَاتَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ وَحُسْنَ عِبَادَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ قَلْبًا سَلِيمًا وَلِسَانًا صَادِقًا وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تَعْلَمُ»
units.en: Sheddad said, 'the Prophet used, after making the profession of faith, to say, "O Lord! I supplicate thee for firmness in faith and inclination towards the straight way, and to aid me in being grateful to thee, and in worshipping thee in every good way; and I supplicate thee for an innocent heart, which shall not incline to wickedness; and I supplicate thee for a true tongue, and for that virtue, which thou knowest to be so, and to defend me from that vice, which thou knowest to be so; and for forgiveness of those faults which thou knowest."'
units.en2: Shaddād ibn Aws narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say in his prayer: "O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in faith and resolve upon righteousness. I ask You for gratitude for Your blessings and the best of worship. I ask You for a sound heart and a truthful tongue. I ask You of the good of what You know, I seek refuge with You from the evil of what You know, and I seek Your forgiveness for what You know."

units.ar: وَعَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ فِي صَلَاتِهِ بَعْدَ التَّشَهُّدِ: «أَحْسَنُ الْكَلَامِ كَلَامُ اللَّهِ وَأَحْسَنُ الْهَدْيِ هَدْيُ مُحَمَّدٍ»
units.en: Jabir said, "the Prophet used to say, that in prayers after the profession of faith, the best of all words is the word of God, and the best dispositions those of Muhammed, the elect."
units.en2: Jābir narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say in his prayer after the Tashahhud: "The best of speech is the Speech of Allah, and the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad ﷺ."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُسَلِّمُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ تَسْلِيمَةً تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ تَمِيلُ إِلَى الشِّقِّ الْأَيْمَنِ شَيْئًا
units.en: Aayeshah said, 'the Prophet gave one Salam fronting the Kiblah; then inclined a little to his right side.'
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to conclude prayer with a single Salām facing forward, then turning slightly to the right.

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ: أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ نَرُدَّ عَلَى الْإِمَامِ وَنَتَحَابَّ وَأَنْ يُسَلِّمَ بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ
units.en: Samurah said, "the Prophet ordered us to return the Salam on the Imam, and to Salam to one another."
units.en2: Samura ibn Jundab narrates: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to return the Salām to the Imām, to love one another, and to greet each other with peace."

sections.heading: On What Should Be Repeated after Prayers (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XIX)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XIX of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 199-204. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on dhikr after prayer (reports 959-977); Matthews omits reports 961 and 976.

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَعْرِفُ انْقِضَاءَ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ
units.en: Ibn Abbas. "I used to know the conclusion of the Prophet's prayers by his repeating the Tacbir, with a loud voice."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates: "I used to know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had concluded the prayer by the sound of the Takbīr (Allāhu Akbar)."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ لَمْ يَقْعُدْ إِلَّا مِقْدَارَ مَا يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ»
units.en: Aayeshah said, when the Prophet gave the Salam he did not sit longer than just to say these words, "O Lord! thou art secure from all defects, and from thee proceeds the safety of thy servants from all calamities and fears: thou art mighty, O Lord of glory and of beneficence."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the Salām, he would not sit except long enough to say: "O Allah, You are Peace, and from You comes peace; blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor!"

units.ar: وَعَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ»
units.en: Mughairah-bin-Shu'bah said, "verily the Prophet used to say, after every one of those prayers which are prescribed in the Koran: 'There is no God but one God, who hath no partner: for him is dominion, and for him praise; he is powerful over all things. O Lord! there is no one to withhold what thou hast given, nor one to give what thou hast withheld: neither does the greatness of the great profit against thee; from thee alone is greatness.'"
units.en2: Al-Mughīra ibn Shuʿba narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say at the conclusion of every prescribed prayer: "There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no possessor of worldly fortune can benefit against You; from You alone is true majesty."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ يَقُولُ بِصَوْتِهِ الْأَعْلَى: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Zubair said, "when the Prophet gave the Salam after his prayers, he would say with a loud voice: 'There is no God except one God, who hath no partner: for him is dominion and praise; and he is powerful over all things. There is no power or strength except in God: there is no God but God: we worship none but him: from him are benefits, and for him is excellence, for him is all good praise: there is no God but God: religion is for him, although the unbelievers dislike it.'"
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Zubayr narrates: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the Salām after his prayer, he would say in an audible voice: "There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. There is no might nor power except with Allah; there is no true deity except Allah, and we worship none but Him. To Him belongs all blessing, all favor, and all worthy praise; there is no true deity except Allah, sincere to Him in devotion though the disbelievers may detest it."

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَعْدٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُعَلِّمُ بَنِيهِ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ وَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَتَعَوَّذُ بِهِنَّ دُبُرَ الصَّلَاةِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ»
units.en: Sa'd-bin-Abi-Wakkas used to teach his children these words; and would say, "verily the Prophet of God used to seek protection with God by repeating these words, after every prayer: 'O Lord! I seek protection with thee from cowardice, and from avarice, and from decrepitude, and from the strife of the world, and punishment of the grave.'"
units.en2: Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ used to teach these words to his children, saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to seek refuge with them after prayer: "O Allah, I seek refuge with You from cowardice, I seek refuge with You from avarice, I seek refuge with You from being returned to the feeblest old age, I seek refuge with You from the tribulations of the world, and I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: إِنَّ فُقَرَاءَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ أَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالُوا: ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الدُّثُورِ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلَى وَالنَّعِيمِ الْمُقِيمِ فَقَالَ: «وَمَا ذَاكَ؟» فَقَالُوا: يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ وَلَا نَتَصَدَّقُ وَيُعْتِقُونَ وَلَا نُعْتِقُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَفَلَا أُعَلِّمُكُمْ شَيْئًا تُدْرِكُونَ بِهِ مَنْ سَبَقَكُمْ وَتَسْبِقُونَ بِهِ مَنْ بَعْدَكُمْ وَلَا يَكُونُ أَحَدٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا مَنْ صَنَعَ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعْتُمْ؟» قَالُوا: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: «تُسَبِّحُونَ وَتَحْمَدُونَ وَتُكَبِّرُونَ خَلْفَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ» قَالَ سُمَيٌّ: فَرَجَعَ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالُوا: سَمِعَ إِخْوَانُنَا أَهْلُ الْأَمْوَالِ بِمَا فَعَلْنَا فَفَعَلُوا مِثْلَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «ذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the poor people of the Muhajirun came to the Prophet and said, 'verily the rich have obtained great rewards and the pleasure of God;' and the Prophet said, 'what is this?' They said, 'they say their prayers like unto us, and fast as we do, and give alms; but that which we have not in our power, they free their slaves, and we have none to set free.' Then the Prophet said, 'shall I not teach you an act by which you may attain the greatness of those who have gone before you; and by which you will precede your posterity; and not one will be more excellent than you, excepting those who do as you may do?' Then they said, 'instruct us, O Prophet of God.' He said, 'repeat after every prayer Subhan Allah thirty-three times, and Allahu Akbar thirty-three times, and Alhamdulillah thirty-three times.' And Sumayy said, the poor refugees returned again to the Prophet, and said, 'our rich brethren heard us repeat what you ordered, and did the like, therefore their excellence is greater than ours.' Then the Prophet said, 'the greatness of the rich over you is by the favor of God; he giveth to whom he wills.'"
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: The poor among the Emigrants (Muhājirūn) came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "The wealthy have taken the highest ranks and everlasting bliss!" He asked, "How so?" They replied, "They pray as we pray, they fast as we fast, but they give in charity while we have no wealth to give, and they emancipate slaves while we cannot." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Shall I not teach you something by which you can catch up with those who preceded you, get ahead of those who come after you, and no one will be superior to you unless they do the like of what you do?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "Glorify Allah (Subḥān Allāh), praise Him (al-Ḥamdu lillāh), and magnify Him (Allāhu Akbar) thirty-three times after every prayer." Sumayy said: The poor Emigrants later returned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "Our wealthy brothers heard what we were doing and have done the same!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills."

units.ar: وَعَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مُعَقِّبَاتٌ لَا يَخِيبُ قَائِلُهُنَّ أَوْ فَاعِلُهُنَّ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ: ثَلَاثٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ تَسْبِيحَةً وَثَلَاثٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ تَحْمِيدَةً وَأَرْبَعٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ تَكْبِيرَةً»
units.en: Cab-bin-Ujrah said, the Prophet of God said, "there are certain concluding sentences, the repeaters and actors of which, after every divine prayer, need not be hopeless; Subhan Allah, thirty-three times, Alhamdulillah, thirty-three times, and Allahu Akbar, thirty-four times."
units.en2: Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are concluding devotions whose reciter will never be disappointed after every obligatory prayer: thirty-three glorifications (Subḥān Allāh), thirty-three praises (al-Ḥamdu lillāh), and thirty-four magnifications (Allāhu Akbar)."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "That person who repeats Subhan Allah, thirty-three times after every prayer, and Alhamdulillah, thirty-three, and Allahu Akbar, thirty-three, in all ninety-nine times; and shall repeat these words to complete one hundred, 'there is no God but one God, who hath no partner; for him is dominion and praise, and he is powerful over all things, he gives life and death;' the sins of that person will be forgiven; although they may be numerous as the waves of the ocean."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever glorifies Allah (Subḥān Allāh) thirty-three times after every prayer, praises Allah (al-Ḥamdu lillāh) thirty-three times, and magnifies Allah (Allāhu Akbar) thirty-three times — making ninety-nine — and then completes the hundred by saying: 'There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs dominion and all praise, and He has power over all things' — his sins will be forgiven, even if they were like the foam of the sea."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ قَالَ: قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الدُّعَاءِ أَسْمَعُ؟ قَالَ: «جَوْفُ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرِ وَدُبُرَ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْمَكْتُوبَاتِ»
units.en: Abu Umamah said, the companions asked the Prophet, at what times supplications were heard and approved. He said, "in the middle of the latter part of the night, and after divine prayers."
units.en2: Abū Umāma narrates: It was asked, "O Messenger of Allah, which supplication is most heard and answered?" He said: "In the depth of the latter part of the night, and following the obligatory prayers."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ: أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
units.en: Ukbah said, "the Prophet ordered me to repeat the two chapters of the Koran which prescribe taking refuge with God, after every prayer."
units.en2: ʿUqba ibn ʿĀmir narrates: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to recite the chapters of refuge (al-Muʿawwidhat — Sūrat al-Falaq and Sūrat al-Nās) after every prayer."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَلَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَةً»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "Verily my sitting with a multitude who discourse concerning God, after morning prayer, till sun-rise, is more lovely to me, than giving liberty to four men of the children of Ismail; and my sitting with people who discourse of God, after afternoon prayer, till sun-set, is what I like better than emancipating four men of the children of Ismail."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "That I sit with a group remembering Allah from the dawn prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four descendants of Ismāʿīl; and that I sit with a group remembering Allah from the afternoon prayer (ʿAṣr) until sunset is more beloved to me than freeing four."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ كَانَتْ لَهُ كَأَجْرِ حَجَّةٍ وَعُمْرَةٍ تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "That person who says morning prayer with a group, then sits discoursing of God, till sun-rise; and afterwards performs two Racats Sunnat: his reward will be equal to that of a pilgrimage to Mecca."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays the dawn prayer (Fajr) in congregation, then remains seated remembering Allah until the sun rises, and then performs two rakʿahs, will have the reward of a complete, complete, complete Ḥajj and ʿUmrah."

units.ar: عَنِ الْأَزْرَقِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا إِمَامٌ لَنَا يُكْنَى أَبَا رِمْثَةَ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ أَوْ مِثْلَ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ يَقُومَانِ فِي الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَكَانَ رَجُلٌ قَدْ شَهِدَ التَّكْبِيرَةَ الْأُولَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّى نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ حَتَّى رَأَيْنَا بَيَاضَ خَدَّيْهِ ثُمَّ انْفَتَلَ كَانْفِتَالِ أَبِي رِمْثَةَ يَعْنِي نَفْسَهُ فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي أَدْرَكَ مَعَهُ التَّكْبِيرَةَ الْأُولَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ يَشْفَعُ فَوَثَبَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ بِمَنْكِبَيْهِ فَهَزَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: اجْلِسْ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يُهْلِكْ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَ صَلَاتِهِمْ فَصْلٌ فَرَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَصَرَهُ فَقَالَ: «أَصَابَ اللَّهُ بِكَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ»
units.en: Arzak bin-Kais said, "Abu Rimthah said prayers with us as Imam, and said, 'I repeated the noon-day prayers with the Prophet, and Abubacr and Omer stood in the front rank, on the right of the Prophet; and there was a man present at prayer: and the Prophet finished his prayers, after which he gave the Salam to his right and left, so that we saw the whiteness of both his cheeks: after which he changed his place; and the man rose up also with an intention of saying the Sunnat prayers where he was: and Omer took him by the shoulder, and shook him, and said, "sit down; verily God ruined the people of the book because they did not change their place during their prayers." Then the Prophet lifted up his eyes and said, "O Omer! may God always keep you in the straight road."'"
units.en2: Al-Azraq ibn Qays narrates: An Imām of ours whose kunyah was Abū Rimtha led us in prayer, and said: "I prayed this prayer with the Prophet ﷺ, and Abū Bakr and ʿUmar were standing in the front row on his right. A man had caught the opening Takbīr of the prayer. When the Prophet ﷺ finished the prayer and gave the Salām to his right and left until we saw the whiteness of both his cheeks, he turned around. The man who had caught the opening Takbīr stood up immediately to pray voluntary rakʿahs, so ʿUmar jumped up, grasped him by the shoulders, shook him, and said: 'Sit down! The People of the Book were only destroyed because there was no interval between their prayers!' The Prophet ﷺ raised his gaze and said: 'Allah has guided you rightly, O Ibn al-Khaṭṭāb!'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ: أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نُسَبِّحَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَنَحْمَدَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَنُكَبِّرَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ فَأُتِيَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فِي مَنَامِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَمَرَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ تُسَبِّحُوا فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتَحْمَدُوا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتُكَبِّرُوا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ. قَالَ: فَاجْعَلُوهَا خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ وَاجْعَلُوا فِيهَا التَّهْلِيلَ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ: «افْعَلُوا»
units.en: Zaid-ibn-Thabit said, "the Prophet ordered me to repeat Subhan Allah thirty-three times after every prayer, and Allahu Akbar thirty-four times, and Alhamdulillah thirty-three times. And a man of the assistants saw an angel in his sleep, who said, 'did the Prophet order you to say Subhan-Allah after every prayer so many times?' He said, 'yes.' And the angel said, 'make each twenty-five times, and "there is no God but God" twenty-five times, that the number of one hundred be complete.' And when the assistant got up in the morning, he went to the Prophet and told him his dream; who said, 'then do ye so.'"
units.en2: Zayd ibn Thābit narrates: We were commanded to glorify Allah thirty-three times, praise Him thirty-three times, and magnify Him thirty-four times after every prayer. Then a man from the Anṣār had a vision in his sleep, in which it was said to him: "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to glorify Allah thirty-three times, praise Him thirty-three times, and magnify Him thirty-four times after every prayer?" He said, "Yes." The visitor said: "Make each twenty-five times, and include the Tahlīl (Lā ilāha illā Allāh) twenty-five times, so that they make one hundred." In the morning he came to the Prophet ﷺ and related this to him, whereupon the Prophet ﷺ said: "Do so."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى أَعْوَادِ الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأَ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ لَمْ يَمْنَعْهُ مِنْ دُخُولِ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَّا الْمَوْتُ وَلَا يُوَاظِبُ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا صِدِّيقٌ أَوْ عَابِدٌ وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ آمَنَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَجَارِهِ وَجَارِ جَارِهِ وَالْأَبْيَاتِ حَوْلَهُ»
units.en: Ali-ibn-Abi-Talib said, 'I heard the Prophet say in the pulpit, "that person who repeats Ayat al-Cursi after every prayer, nothing prevents him entering into paradise but life: and whoever says Ayat-al-Cursi when he goes to his bed-chamber, God will keep him in safety, his house, and the house of his neighbour."'
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say from the pulpit: "Whoever recites the Throne Verse (Āyat al-Kursī, Qur'an 2:255) after every prescribed prayer, nothing stands between him and entering Paradise except death; and whoever recites it upon retiring to bed, Allah grants safety to him, to his house, and to the homes of his neighbors round about."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ قَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ وَيَثْنِيَ رِجْلَهُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ عَشْرُ سَيِّئَاتٍ وَرُفِعَ لَهُ عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَكَانَتْ حِرْزًا مِنْ كُلِّ مَكْرُوهٍ وَحِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَلَمْ يَحِلَّ لِذَنْبٍ يُدْرِكُهُ إِلَّا الشِّرْكُ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ النَّاسِ عَمَلًا إِلَّا رَجُلًا يَفْضُلُهُ يَقُولُ أَفْضَلَ مِمَّا قَالَ»
units.en: Abdul-Rahman-bin-Ghanm relates from the Prophet, who said, "that person who, before rising up from the sun-set and the morning prayers, shall ten times repeat the following words: 'There is no God but one God, to whom there is no partner, to whom is dominion and praise, in whose hand is every good; he gives life and death; and he is powerful over all things,' there will be written in the book of his actions, an atonement for every one of these; he will receive ten rewards; and ten faults will be blotted out, and he will gain ten steps; and there will be for him an asylum from every bad deed; and he will be defended from the wickedness of the devil."
units.en2: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ghanm narrates from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: "Whoever says ten times, before shifting from his sitting posture after the sunset (Maghrib) and dawn (Fajr) prayers: 'There is no true deity except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs dominion and to Him belongs praise, in His hand is all good, He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things' — for every repetition ten good deeds will be recorded for him, ten evil deeds erased, and his rank raised by ten degrees; it will serve as a shield against all harm and a protection from the accursed Satan; no sin can overtake him to destroy his deeds except idolatry, and he will be among the best in deed of all people, unless someone recites even more."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَ بَعْثًا قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَغَنِمُوا غَنَائِمَ كَثِيرَةً وَأَسْرَعُوا الرَّجْعَةَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ: مَا رَأَيْنَا بَعْثًا أَسْرَعَ رَجْعَةً وَلَا أَعْظَمَ غَنِيمَةً مِنْ هَذَا الْبَعْثِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِقَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ غَنِيمَةً وَأَسْرَعَ رَجْعَةً؟ قَوْمٌ شَهِدُوا صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَأُولَئِكَ أَسْرَعُ رَجْعَةً وَأَعْظَمُ غَنِيمَةً»
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khattab. "Verily the Prophet sent an army towards Najd, and they brought great wealth, and returned soon from the war. And a man said, 'I never saw any army return so quick from the wars as this, or that brought so much plunder.' Then the Prophet said, 'shall I shew you a multitude superior in plunder, and quicker of return; a multitude which is present at morning prayer and afterwards sits and converses respecting God till sunrise: then this assembly are quicker in return, and have carried away more plunder than that army; because they have in one Saat obtained immense rewards, and have returned quicker to their houses.'"
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: The Prophet ﷺ dispatched an expedition toward Najd; they gained abundant spoils and returned swiftly. A man exclaimed, "We have never seen an expedition return more swiftly or bring greater spoils than this!" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Shall I not tell you of a people who gain far greater spoils and return even more swiftly? A people who attend the dawn prayer (Fajr), then remain seated remembering Allah until sunrise — they are swifter in return and have attained greater spoils!"

sections.heading: On Supplications to Be Made at Night (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XXXIII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XXXIII of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 258-261. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on supplications when rising at night for Tahajjud and night awakenings (reports 1211-1218).

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَتَهَجَّدُ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ وَقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ وَمُحَمَّدٌ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ»
units.en: Ibn Abbas said, 'when the Prophet got up to prayer in the night, he repeated this supplication: "O Lord! praise be to thee; thou art the fixer of the heavens and the earth, and every thing which is between them; the angels, Genii and man: thou art the maker of light, of the heavens and earth, and every thing between them; and thou art king of the heavens and earth, and of every thing therein; and thou art the truth, and thy promise of rewards and punishments to thy servants is right, and the sight of thee at the resurrection is true. Thy word is true, heaven is true, and hell is true, all the Prophets are true, and Muhammed is true, and the resurrection is true. O Lord! I worship thee, and believe in thee, and put my whole trust in thee; and my return is to thee, and I fight by thy strength with the enemies of religion. Then pardon my faults which I have been guilty of, and which I may commit henceforward; and forgive the sins I have concealed and disclosed, and those which thou knowest better than I. Thou art the beginning and thou art the end: there is no God but thee."'
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ arose at night to perform the Tahajjud prayer, he would say: "O Allah, to You belongs all praise; You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all who dwell within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all who dwell within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Sovereign of the heavens and the earth and all who dwell within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Truth, Your promise is true, the meeting with You is true, Your word is true, Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the Prophets are true, Muḥammad is true, and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, to You I submit, in You I believe, upon You I rely, unto You I turn in repentance, for Your sake I contend, and to Your judgment I appeal. Forgive me my past and future sins, what I have kept secret and what I have made open, and that which You know better than I. You are the Advancer and You are the Deferrer; there is no god but You, and none worthy of worship besides You."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ افْتَتَحَ صَلَاتَهُ فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ»
units.en: Aayeshah said, when his highness got up at night, he began with prayer, and then said; "O God! thou art the cherisher of Gabriel, of Michael, and Israfil, the creator of the heavens and the earth: thou knowest the hidden and the revealed; and thou orderest, between thy servants, in that which they vary in worship: verily thou directest those thou willest to the straight way."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ arose at night, he would commence his prayer saying: "O Allah, Lord of Jibrīl, Mīkāʾīl, and Isrāfīl, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they differ. Guide me by Your leave to the truth about which men have differed; surely You guide whomsoever You will to a straight path."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي - أَوْ قَالَ: ثُمَّ دَعَا - اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَصَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلَاتُهُ»
units.en: Ubadah-ibn-Samit said, A. G. S. "Whoever awakes in the night, and says, 'there is no God, but one God; to whom there is no partner; for him is dominion and praise; and he is powerful over all things: immaculate God! and all praise to God! there is no God but God; great God! there is no power or strength except in God:' after which says, 'O my defender, pardon my faults;' his supplication will be approved. Then if he perform Wadu, and say prayers, they will be accepted."
units.en2: ʿUbāda ibn al-Ṣāmit narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever awakens at night and says: 'There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs sovereignty and all praise, and He is capable of all things. Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power or might except with Allah,' and then says: 'O Lord, forgive me,' or supplicates, his prayer will be answered. If he then makes ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِذَنْبِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَتَكَ اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا وَلَا تُزِغْ قَلْبِي بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنِي وَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ»
units.en: Aayeshah said, 'when the Prophet awoke in the night, he would say, "there is no God but thee immaculate. O Lord! I praise thee and ask thee forgiveness of my sins, and ask thy mercy. O Lord! encrease my knowledge, and incline me not from Islam to infidelity, after thou hast shewn me the right road. Grant me thy compassion; verily thou art the giver of favours."'
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ woke during the night, he would say: "There is no god but You; glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. I ask forgiveness for my sins and ask for Your mercy. O Allah, increase me in knowledge, and do not cause my heart to deviate after You have guided me, and grant me mercy from Yourself; truly You are the Bestower."

units.ar: وَعَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَبِيتُ عَلَى ذِكْرٍ طَاهِرًا فَيَتَعَارُّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ خَيْرًا إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ»
units.en: Muadh-bin-Jabal. A. G. S. "There is not a Musleman who goes to sleep on the remembrance of God, and awakes in the night and asks a good of God, but God will grant it him."
units.en2: Muʿādh ibn Jabal narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no Muslim who goes to sleep while in a state of purity and remembering Allah, then awakens during the night and asks Allah for any good of this world or the hereafter, except that Allah gives it to him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ شَرِيقٍ الْهَوْزَنِيِّ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلْتُهَا: بِمَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَفْتَتِحُ إِذَا هَبَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ؟ فَقَالَتْ: سَأَلْتَنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ مَا سَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَكَ، كَانَ إِذَا هَبَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ كَبَّرَ عَشْرًا، وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَشْرًا، وَقَالَ: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ» عَشْرًا، وَقَالَ: «سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ» عَشْرًا، وَاسْتَغْفَرَ عَشْرًا، وَهَلَّلَ عَشْرًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيقِ الدُّنْيَا وَضِيقِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ» عَشْرًا، ثُمَّ يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلَاةَ
units.en: Shuraih Hawzani said, 'I went to Aayeshah, and asked her what the Prophet began doing when he awoke in the night. She said, you have asked me a thing which nobody ever did before. When the Prophet awoke in the night, he would say, "God is very great," ten times; and, "praise be to God," ten times; then, "God is most pure," and "praise be to him," ten times; and would say, "pure is the most holy king," ten times; and, "I ask pardon of God," ten times; and, "there is no God but God," ten times: after which, "I look to thee for protection from the punishments of the world and the resurrection," ten times; after which he began his prayers.'
units.en2: Shurayḥ al-Hawzanī narrates: I visited ʿĀʾisha and asked her, "With what did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ begin when he woke up at night?" She replied, "You have asked me about something no one before you has asked. When he arose at night, he would say 'Allāhu Akbar' ten times, praise Allah (al-ḥamdu lillāh) ten times, say 'Subḥān Allāh wa bi-ḥamdih' ten times, say 'Subḥān al-Malik al-Quddūs' ten times, seek forgiveness (astaghfirullāh) ten times, declare the oneness of Allah (lā ilāha illā Allāh) ten times, and then say: 'O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the straitness of this world and the distress of the Day of Resurrection' ten times, and then he would commence the prayer."

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ» ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا» ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ»
units.en: Abu Said Al-Khudri said, 'when the Prophet got up in the night, he said the Tacbir; then "pure art thou, our God, and praise be to thee, and great is thy name; and there is no God besides thee;" after which he would say, "thou great and mighty God;" then would say, "I take protection with God, the hearing and the wise from the cast out devil, from his craft, his pride, and his enchantment."'
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up in the night to pray, he would pronounce the Takbīr and then say: "Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god other than You." Then he would say: "Allāhu akbaru kabīrā (Allah is most Great, exceedingly)," followed by: "I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan: from his madness, his arrogance, and his poetry."

units.ar: وَعَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ أَبِيتُ عِنْدَ حُجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَكُنْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَقُولُ: «سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» الْهَوِيَّ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ» الْهَوِيَّ
units.en: Rabiah-bin-Cab said, 'I slept one night near the Prophet's room, and heard him say, when he rose in the night, "pure is the Lord of the worlds." This he repeated a long time; then repeated, "pure is God, praise to him," a long time.'
units.en2: Rabīʿah ibn Kaʿb al-Aslamī narrates: I used to stay the night near the apartment of the Prophet ﷺ, and when he arose in the night, I would hear him reciting: "Subḥāna Rabb al-ʿĀlamīn (Glory be to the Lord of the Worlds)" for a long portion of the night, and then: "Subḥān Allāh wa bi-ḥamdihi (Glory and praise be to Allah)" for a long portion of the night.

sections.heading: In Explanation of Qunūt (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XXXVII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XXXVII of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 274-276. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on Qunūt (reports 1288-1293); Matthews omits report 1294.

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ أَوْ يَدْعُوَ لِأَحَدٍ قَنَتَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ، فَرُبَّمَا قَالَ إِذَا قَالَ: «سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ»: «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَعَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ، وَاجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ» يَجْهَرُ بِذَلِكَ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي بَعْضِ صَلَاتِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ فُلَانًا وَفُلَانًا» لِأَحْيَاءٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: {لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ}
units.en: Abuhurairah. Verily, whenever the Prophet wished to supplicate, to either the detriment or advantage of any person, he would do it after Rucau; and he often prayed in this way: 'Hear, O God! him who praiseth thee: Lord! to thee all praise is due:' he would then supplicate for the liberation of some of his companions that were in the infidels' prisons, and say, 'O my Lord! free Walid-bin-Walid, and Salmah-bin-Husham, and Ayyash-bin-Abi-Rabiah.' And he would say for the detriment of infidels, 'O Lord! tread under foot Mudar-un-Nazar, and cause for them a famine, like that which happened in the time of Joseph.' And the Prophet would say, in some of his prayers, 'O Lord! remove far from thy mercy such and such tribes of Arabia, that are unbelievers.'
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intended to pray for someone or invoke against someone, he would recite the Qunūt after rising from rukūʿ. Frequently, after saying 'Samiʿa Allāhu liman ḥamidah, Rabbanā laka al-ḥamd (Allah hears the one who praises Him; our Lord, to You belongs all praise),' he would say: 'O Allah, rescue al-Walīd ibn al-Walīd, Salamah ibn Hishām, and ʿAyyāsh ibn Abī Rabīʿah. O Allah, intensify Your grip upon the tribe of Muḍar, and send upon them years of famine like the years of Yūsuf.' He would recite this aloud, and in some prayers he would pray against specific Arab tribes of disbelievers, until Allah revealed: {It is not for you to decide whether He pardons them or punishes them} (3:128).

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ كَانَ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ؟ قَالَ: قَبْلَهُ، إِنَّمَا قَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا، إِنَّهُ كَانَ بَعَثَ أُنَاسًا يُقَالُ لَهُمُ الْقُرَّاءُ سَبْعُونَ رَجُلًا فَأُصِيبُوا، فَقَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَيْهِمْ
units.en: Aasim-ul-Ahwal said, 'I asked Anas-bin-Malic, about saying the Kunit in prayers, whether before Rucau or after it. He said, "before Rucau; and the Prophet never performed Kunit after Rucau, except one month. Verily the Prophet sent out seventy persons that were uncommonly well read in the Koran, and they were all killed: then the Prophet said Kunit, after Rucau, for the space of a month, when he supplicated God's anger on the murderers of those men."'
units.en2: ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal narrates: I asked Anas ibn Mālik about the Qunūt in prayer, whether it is recited before the bowing (rukūʿ) or after it. He said: 'Before it. The Prophet ﷺ recited Qunūt after rukūʿ for only one month, when he had dispatched seventy reciters of the Qur'an who were betrayed and martyred; the Messenger of Allah ﷺ then supplicated after rukūʿ for a month invoking against their killers.'

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: قَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَهْرًا مُتَتَابِعًا فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ وَصَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ إِذَا قَالَ: «سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ» مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ الْآخِرَةِ، يَدْعُو عَلَى أَحْيَاءٍ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ: عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَذَكْوَانَ وَعُصَيَّةَ، وَيُؤَمِّنُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ
units.en: Ibn Abbas said, 'the Prophet supplicated Kunit every day during a whole month, at noon and afternoon, sun-set, evening and morning; when he said in the last Racat, "Hear, O God! him who praiseth thee." He then prayed against some of the tribes of Bani Salim, viz. Ril, Dhacwan and Usaiyah; and all those standing behind the Prophet would say Amen.'
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Qunūt consecutively for a month in the Zuhr, ʿAṣr, Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ, and Ṣubḥ prayers, after saying 'Samiʿa Allāhu liman ḥamidah' in the final rakʿah, supplicating against clans of the Banū Sulaym — Riʿl, Dhakwān, and ʿUṣayyah — while those behind him said 'Āmīn.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَنَتَ شَهْرًا ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ
units.en: Anas said, 'verily the Prophet repeated Kunit one month, and then left it off.'
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Prophet ﷺ recited the Qunūt for a month, and then discontinued it.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي: يَا أَبَتِ إِنَّكَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ هَهُنَا بِالْكُوفَةِ نَحْوًا مِنْ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ أَكَانُوا يَقْنُتُونَ؟ قَالَ: «أَيْ بُنَيَّ مُحْدَثٌ»
units.en: Abu Malic-ul-Ashjai. 'I said to my father, "O father! verily you have said prayers after the Prophet, Abu'Bakr, Omer, Othman, and Ali, at Cufah, for nearly fifty years: did they say the Kunit in the five times of prayer, like as some men do now?" He said, "O my son! that which they do constantly is an innovation in the religion; as the Prophet's saying the Kunit (at those times) was only during one month."'
units.en2: Abū Mālik al-Ashjaʿī narrates: I said to my father, 'O my father, you prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān, and behind ʿAlī here in Kūfah for nearly five years; did they recite the Qunūt in the daily prayers?' He replied, 'O my son, it is an innovation (to practice it continuously).'

units.ar: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ جَمَعَ النَّاسَ عَلَى أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً وَلَا يَقْنُتُ بِهِمْ إِلَّا فِي النِّصْفِ الْبَاقِي، فَإِذَا كَانَتِ الْعَشْرُ الْأَوَاخِرُ تَخَلَّفَ فَصَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهِ فَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: أَبَقَ أُبَيٌّ
units.en: Hasan Basri relates, that, 'verily Omer-ibn-al-Khattab said, "let Ubai-ibn-Cab act as Imam, and the people follow him:" and this order happened in the fast of Ramdan; and he did so twenty nights; but did not say the Kunit to them, except in the latter half of the month: and when the last ten nights remained, Ubai did not come to the Masjid, but said prayers in his own house; and the people used to say, with marks of astonishment, "Ubai has run away."'
units.en2: Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī narrates that ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb gathered the people behind Ubayy ibn Kaʿb in prayer during the fast of Ramaḍān. He led them for twenty nights and did not recite the Qunūt with them except during the second half of the month; when the last ten nights arrived, he remained behind and prayed in his home, so the people would say: 'Ubayy has fled.'

sections.heading: In Explanation of the Duhà Prayers (Matthews, Book IV, Ch. XXXIX)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter XXXIX of his Book IV (On Prayer), printed 1809, pages 282-284. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on the Ḍuḥā prayer (reports 1309-1321); Matthews omits reports 1312, 1314 and 1318.

units.ar: عَن أم هَانِئ قَالَتْ: إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ بَيْتَهَا يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ فَاغْتَسَلَ وَصَلَّى ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَلَمْ أَرَ صَلَاةً قَطُّ أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ. وَقَالَتْ فِي رِوَايَة أُخْرَى: وَذَلِكَ ضحى
units.en: Omm Hani said, "verily the Prophet came into my house on the day of taking Mecca, bathed, and performed eight Racats of prayer. And I never saw any prayers so light and easy; and he did not attend to the established rules and regulations in these Racats, excepting in the Rucuu and prostrations: and this was at the time of Duha."
units.en2: Umm Hāniʾ narrates: The Prophet ﷺ entered my house on the day of the conquest of Mecca, bathed, and prayed eight rakʿahs. I never saw a prayer lighter or easier, except that he completed the bowings and prostrations — and this was in the forenoon (Ḍuḥā) time.

units.ar: وَعَن معَاذَة قَالَتْ: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ: كَمْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي صَلَاةَ الضُّحَى؟ قَالَتْ: أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَيَزِيدُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ
units.en: Muadh'ah said, "I asked Aa'yeshah how many Racats the Prophet performed in Duha." She said, "four, and he sometimes added more, according to the pleasure of God."
units.en2: Muʿādha narrates: I asked ʿĀʾisha, "How many rakʿahs did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray at Ḍuḥā?" She said, "Four — and he sometimes added more, as God willed."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «يُصْبِحُ عَلَى كُلِّ سُلَامَى مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ صَدَقَةٌ فَكُلُّ تَسْبِيحَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَحْمِيدَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَهْلِيلَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَكُلُّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ صَدَقَةٌ وَأَمْرٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ صَدَقَةٌ وَنَهْيٌ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ صَدَقَةٌ وَيُجْزِئُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ رَكْعَتَانِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا من الضُّحَى»
units.en: Abu'd'har. A. G. s. "God hath fixed an offering for every joint of each of you; therefore every repetition of these ejaculations, O! holy God! God is very great!
