And in one tradition it is thus: "a rememberer of God amongst the negligent, is like a green tree in the middle of dry ones; and the rememberer of God, in the centre of the negligent, is like a lamp in a dark house; to the rememberer of God amongst the negligent, God shews his sitting place in paradise, either when awake or asleep; and a rememberer of God amongst the negligent, shall have his faults forgiven in number equal to men and beasts."
units.en2: Mālik said: It reached me that the Prophet ﷺ used to say, "A rememberer of God among the heedless is like a fighter after the fleeing; and a rememberer among the heedless is like a green branch on a dry tree." In another narration: "A rememberer of God among the heedless is like a green tree among dry ones, and like a lamp in a dark house; God shows the rememberer among the heedless his seat in Paradise, awake or asleep; and the rememberer of God among the heedless will have his faults forgiven, as many as men and beasts."

units.ar: وَعَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ: مَا عَمِلَ الْعَبْدُ عَمَلًا أَنْجَى لَهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
units.en: Muabit-bin-Jamal said, "no servant has done any act, tending more to redeem him from the punishments of God than the remembering of God."
units.en2: Muʿādh ibn Jabal narrates: "No servant has done any deed more redeeming from God's punishment than the remembrance of God."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَ عَبْدِي إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي وتحركت بِي شفتاه "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily God says, I am with my servant when he remembers me; and his lips shake in repeating my name."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God says: I am with My servant when he remembers Me and his lips move repeating My name."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ صِقَالَةٌ وَصِقَالَةُ الْقُلُوبِ ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَنْجَى مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ» قَالُوا: وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «وَلَا أَنْ يَضْرِبَ بِسَيْفِهِ حَتَّى يَنْقَطِعَ»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Omer said, "the Prophet would say, there is a polish for every thing that takes rust; and the polish for the heart is the remembrance of God; and there is no act that redeems from God's punishments so much as the remembrance of him." The companions said, "is not fighting with the infidels also like this?" He said, "no, although he fight until his sword be broken."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "Everything that rusts has a polish, and the polish of the heart is the remembrance of God; and no deed redeems from God's punishment like remembering Him." The Companions said, "Is not fighting the unbelievers the same?" He said, "No — not even if he fights until his sword breaks."

sections.heading: On the Names of God (Matthews, Book X, Ch. I)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter I of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 542-546. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on the names of God (reports 2287-2293), including the full enumeration of the ninety-nine names with Matthews' own glosses. His translation of the enumeration is a translation of the list as printed in the Mishkāt; scholars note that the detailed list was added by the narrators, not the Prophet's words.

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمًا مِائَةً إِلَّا وَاحِدًا مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ» . وَفِي رِوَايَة: «وَهُوَ وتر يحب الْوتر»الْفَصْل الثَّانِي
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily there are ninety-nine names of God; whoever remembers them shall enter into paradise." And in one tradition they have added, "God is a unit, and likes unity."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God has ninety-nine names; whoever keeps them alive shall enter Paradise." In one narration it is added: "God is One, and loves oneness."

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ اسْمًا مَنْ أَحْصَاهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَه هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ الْغَفَّارُ الْقَهَّارُ الْوَهَّابُ الرَّزَّاقُ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الْخَافِضُ الرَّافِعُ الْمُعِزُّ الْمُذِلُّ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ الْحَكَمُ الْعَدْلُ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ الْحَلِيمُ الْعَظِيمُ الْغَفُورُ الشَّكورُ العَلِيُّ الكَبِيرُ الحَفيظُ المُقِيتُ الْحَسِيبُ الْجَلِيلُ الْكَرِيمُ الرَّقِيبُ الْمُجِيبُ الْوَاسِعُ الْحَكِيمُ الْوَدُودُ الْمَجِيدُ الْبَاعِثُ الشَّهِيدُ الْحَقُّ الْوَكِيلُ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِينُ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ الْمُحْصِي الْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ الْمُحْيِي المُميتُ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ الواجِدُ الماجِدُ الواحِدُ الأحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الْقَادِرُ الْمُقْتَدِرُ الْمُقَدِّمُ الْمُؤَخِّرُ الْأَوَّلُ الْآخِرُ الظَّاهِرُ الْبَاطِنُ الْوَالِي الْمُتَعَالِي الْبَرُّ التَّوَّابُ الْمُنْتَقِمُ العَفُوُّ الرَّؤوفُ مَالِكُ الْمُلْكِ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ الْمُقْسِطُ الْجَامِعُ الْغَنِيُّ الْمُغْنِي الْمَانِعُ الضَّارُّ النَّافِعُ النُّورُ الْهَادِي الْبَدِيعُ الْبَاقِي الْوَارِثُ الرَّشِيدُ الصَّبُورُ» وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيّ: هَذَا حَدِيث غَرِيب
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily there are ninety-nine names for God; and whoever counts them shall enter into paradise. He is Allaho, that which there is no other; Al-Rah'man-ul-Rahimo, the compassionate and merciful; Al-Maliko, the king; the dominions of both worlds are in his power and possession; Al-Kudu'so, wholly pure and far from defect; Al-Salam, that is, his nature is secure from defect; Al-Momino, the giver of asylum to the creation; Al-Muhaimino, the witness of servants' actions; Al-Azizo, the powerful and incomparable; Al-Jabbaro, the benefactor of servants; Al-Mutacabbiro, the mighty doer; Al-Khaliko, Al-Ba'rio, Al-Musawwiro, the fixer of quantity before creating, the creator, the giver of likeness; Al-Ghaffa'ro, the pardoner of servant's sins; Al-Kahha'ro, the breaker of the backs of tyrants; Al-Wahha'bo, the perpetual bestower, whose gifts are without end; Al-Razza'ko, the sender of daily bread to the creation; Al-Fatta'ho, the opener of the doors of mercy on his servants; Al-Alimo, the omniscient; Al-Ka'ardo, the straitener of daily bread on whom he wills, and the taker of souls; Al-Ba's'to, the opener of daily bread on whom he wills; Al-Kharibo, the sinker of the infidels to the lowest earth; Al-Rafio, the raiser up of true believers to the highest paradise; Al-Mizzo, the giver of greatness in the world to whom he wills; Al-Mu'dhillo, the ruiner of whom he wills in the world. Now ruin is in avarice and ambition. It is related that two boys were playing together; one had dry bread, and the other had bread and meat; the first said to the second, give me something to eat with my bread. The other said, come, be my dog and I will. They agreed; and the other tied a string round his neck, and led him along. Fatah Maus Ali saw it, and said, if this boy had been content with his dry bread, he would not have become the dog of his friend. Al-Sami'o, the hearer, not by the ear; Al-Basiro, the seer, not with the eye; Al-Hacamo, the orderer, amongst the creation in the expulsion of oppression; Al-Ablo, the just; Al-Latifo, the doer of good to the creation; Al-Khabiro, the knower; Al-Halimo, the clement; Al-Adhimo, the great; Al-Ghafu'ro, the great pardoner; Al-Stacu'ro, the giver of rewards to the grateful; Al-Azio, the most high; Al-Cabiro, the Lord of greatness; Al-Hafidho, the guardian of every thing in the universe; Al-Mukito, the giver of strength; Al-Hasibo, the taker of accounts of the creation on the day of resurrection; Al-Jalilo, the glorious; Al-Carimo, the munificent, whose favours precede hope, and whoever has hope in him, does not turn away disappointed; Al-Rakibo, the keeper of watch; Al-Mujibo, the approver of supplications; Al-Wa'sio, the expander; Al-Hakimo, the knower of the realities of things; Al-Wabu'do, the friend of true believers; Al-Majido, the lord of glory; Al-Ba'itho, the raiser up of the dead from the graves, and awakener of the hearts of the lethargick from the sleep of lethargy and pride; Al-Shahido, the giver of witness, on the actions of servants on the day of resurrection; Al-Hakko, the truth; Al-Wacilo, the taker on himself the affairs of servants; Al-Kawiyo, Al-Matino, the strong and firm; Al-Waliyo, the assister of true believers; Al-Hamido, the praiser of his own nature; Al-Muhsi, the counter; Al-Mu'bdio, Al-Mui'do, the creator of new and causer of return; Al-Muhiyo, Al-Mumito, the causer of life and death; Al-Haryo, the living one, who never dies nor declines; Al-Kaiyu'mo, the maker alive of the creation; Al-Wajido, the finder of all perfections; Al-Majido, the grand: Al-Wahido, the one; Al-Samado, from the court of whom all desires are supplicated, and he in need of no one; Al-Kadiro, Al-Maktadiro, the Lord of power; Al-Mukaddimo, Al-Mawakhkhiro, the bringer before, and after; Al-Awwalo, Al-Akhro, the first and the last; Al-Dhahiro, Al-Ba'tino, whose existence is clear, and realities hidden; Al-Walio, the master of all; Al-Muta'ali, the sublime of degree; Al-Barro, the doer of good; Al-Tawwa'bo, the accepter of repentance; Al-Muntakimo, the taker of revenge; Al-Aruwo, the erazer of sins; Al-Rawu'fo, the benefiter; Malic-ul-Mulci, the ruler of countries; D'hu'l-Jala'l-w'al Icram, the Lord of glory and greatness; Al-Muksi'to, the giver of justice; Al-Ja'mio, the assembler of the creation; Al-Ghanio, Al-Mughnio, the independent, and the maker of independence; Al-Mua'ti, Al-Ma'nio, the giver to whom he wills, and with-holder from whom he wills; Al-Darro, Al-Na'fio, the creator of profit and loss; Al-Nu'ro, the maker of light of the regions with stars, and giver of light to the earth with Prophets, friends of God, and sages; Al-Hadi, the director; Al-Badi'o, the incomparable; Al-Ba'ki, of eternal existence; Al-Wa'ritho, the heir; Al-Rashido, the shewer of the straight road; Al-Sabu'ro, the most patient in the punishment of sins."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God has ninety-nine names; whoever counts them shall enter Paradise." He is Allah, than whom there is no other; al-Raḥmān, al-Raḥīm — the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful; al-Malik — the King; al-Quddūs — the Wholly Holy, far from defect; al-Salām — the Flawless, the Peace; al-Muʾmin — the Giver of security; al-Muhaymin — the Watcher over His servants' deeds; al-ʿAzīz — the Almighty, beyond compare; al-Jabbār — the Restorer, the Compeller; al-Mutakabbir — the Supremely Great; al-Khāliq, al-Bāriʾ, al-Muṣawwir — the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner of forms; al-Ghaffār — the great Pardoner of sins; al-Qahhār — the Breaker of tyrants; al-Wahhāb — the constant Giver whose gifts never end; al-Razzāq — the Provider of the creation; al-Fattāḥ — the Opener of the doors of mercy; al-ʿAlīm — the All-Knowing; al-Qābiḍ — the Withholder; al-Bāsiṭ — the Expander of provision; al-Khāfiḍ — the Abaser; al-Rāfiʿ — the Raiser of true believers; al-Muʿizz — the Giver of honour; al-Mudhill — the Humiliator; al-Samīʿ — the All-Hearing; al-Baṣīr — the All-Seeing; al-Ḥakam — the Arbiter among creation; al-ʿAdl — the Just; al-Laṭīf — the Kind, the Subtle; al-Khabīr — the All-Aware; al-Ḥalīm — the Forbearing; al-ʿAẓīm — the Magnificent; al-Ghafūr — the All-Forgiving; al-Shakūr — the Rewarder of the grateful; al-ʿAlī — the Most High; al-Kabīr — the Great; al-Ḥafīẓ — the Guardian of all things; al-Muqīt — the Giver of strength; al-Ḥasīb — the Reckoner of creation on the Day of Resurrection; al-Jalīl — the Majestic; al-Karīm — the Generous, whose favours outrun hope; al-Raqīb — the Watchful; al-Mujīb — the Answerer of supplications; al-Wāsiʿ — the All-Embracing; al-Ḥakīm — the All-Wise; al-Wadūd — the Loving, friend of the believers; al-Majīd — the Glorious; al-Bāʿith — the Raiser of the dead from their graves; al-Shahīd — the Witness over the deeds of His servants; al-Ḥaqq — the Truth; al-Wakīl — the Trustee of His servants' affairs; al-Qawī, al-Matīn — the Strong, the Firm; al-Walī — the Helper of the believers; al-Ḥamīd — the All-Praiseworthy; al-Muḥṣī — the Counter of all things; al-Mubdiʾ, al-Muʿīd — the Beginner and the Returner; al-Muḥyī, al-Mumīt — the Giver of life and death; al-Ḥayy — the Ever-Living, who never dies; al-Qayyūm — the Self-Subsisting, Sustainer of creation; al-Wājid — the Finder, possessor of all perfections; al-Mājid — the All-Glorious; al-Wāḥid — the One; al-Ṣamad — the one to whom all needs are brought, who needs no one; al-Qādir, al-Muqtadir — the Lord of power; al-Muqaddim, al-Muʾakhkhir — the Advancer and the Delayer; al-Awwal, al-Ākhir — the First and the Last; al-Ẓāhir, al-Bāṭin — the Manifest and the Hidden; al-Wālī — the Master of all; al-Mutaʿālī — the Supremely Exalted; al-Barr — the Doer of good; al-Tawwāb — the Accepter of repentance; al-Muntaqim — the Avenger; al-ʿAfuww — the Effacer of sins; al-Raʾūf — the All-Kind; Mālik-ul-Mulk — the Ruler of the kingdom; Dhū'l-Jalāl wa'l-Ikrām — Lord of majesty and honour; al-Muqsiṭ — the Giver of justice; al-Jāmiʿ — the Gatherer of creation; al-Ghanī, al-Mughnī — the Independent, the Enricher; al-Muʿṭī, al-Māniʿ — the Giver and the Withholder; al-Ḍārr, al-Nāfiʿ — the Author of harm and benefit; al-Nūr — the Light; al-Hādī — the Guide; al-Badīʿ — the Incomparable Originator; al-Bāqī — the Everlasting; al-Wārith — the Heir; al-Rashīd — the Guide to the straight way; al-Ṣabūr — the Most Patient with the sins of His servants.

units.ar: وَعَن بُرَيْدَةَ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ: «دَعَا اللَّهَ بِاسْمِهِ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى وَإِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ»
units.en: Buraidah said, "his highness heard a man say, O Lord! I ask from thee, by this means that thou art God, the only God, the eternal; all wants, all needs, shall return to thee; thou art neither begotten nor begetting; nor is there anyone like unto thee." Then the Prophet said, "this servant has called on God by that name which is the greatest of all, that name which, being asked by, God grants; and when supplicated by, God accepts and approves."
units.en2: Burayda narrates: The Prophet ﷺ heard a man say, "O Lord, I ask You — for You are God, the only God, the Everlasting; to You all wants and needs return; You beget not nor are begotten; and none is like You." The Prophet said: "This man has called upon God by His greatest name — the name by which, when asked, God grants, and when supplicated, God answers."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَجُلٌ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَسْأَلُكَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «دَعَا اللَّهَ بِاسْمِهِ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى»
units.en: Anas said, "I was sitting with the Prophet in the Masjid, when a man was performing his prayers, and said, O Lord! I supplicate thee, by the means, that for thee is all praise, there is no God but thee, the kind, and giver of benefits, the creator of the heavens and the earth; O Lord! of greatness and glory, O the living one! O the maker of life! I supplicate thee." Then the Prophet said, "this man has called on God by the greatest of all his names; a name which being called by, he approves, and gives when supplicated by."
units.en2: Anas narrates: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ in the mosque when a man was praying, and said: "O Lord, I supplicate You — for Yours is all praise; there is no god but You, the Kind, the Giver of benefits, Creator of the heavens and the earth; O Lord of greatness and glory, O Ever-Living, O Giver of life." The Prophet said: "This man has called upon God by His greatest name — the name by which, when called, He answers, and when asked, He gives."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " اسْمُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ فِي هَاتَيْنِ الْآيَتَيْنِ: (وَإِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحيمُ) وفاتحة (آل عمرانَ) : (آلم اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ)
units.en: Asm'a-bint-Yezid. A. G. s. "The greatest of God's names is in these two revelations: your God is one, there is no God, but the compassionate and the merciful; God! there is no other God but he, the living one, the giver of life."
units.en2: Asmāʾ bint Yazīd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God's greatest name is in these two revelations: 'Your God is one God; there is no god but He, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful'; and 'God — there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَعْدَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: دَعْوَةُ ذِي النُّونِ إِذا دَعَا رَبَّهُ وَهُوَ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ (لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظالمينَ) لَمْ يَدْعُ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ فِي شَيْءٍ إلاَّ استجابَ لَهُ "
units.en: Sa'd. A. G. s. "When Jonas, the Prophet, supplicated whilst in the fish's belly, in these words: there is no God but thee; verily I am of the unjust, no Musleman has supplicated for any thing with this supplication, but God has approved."
units.en2: Saʿd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Jonah the Prophet supplicated from within the fish's belly with these words — 'There is no god but You; truly I am among the wrongdoers' — no Muslim has ever supplicated for anything with these words without God answering him."

units.ar: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَسْجِدَ عِشَاءً فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ يَقْرَأُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَقُولُ: هَذَا مُرَاءٍ؟ قَالَ: «بَلْ مُؤْمِنٌ مُنِيبٌ» قَالَ: وَأَبُو مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيُّ يَقْرَأُ وَيَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَتَسَمَّعُ لِقِرَاءَتِهِ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ أَبُو مُوسَى يَدْعُو فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَحَدًا صَمَدًا لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَقَدْ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ بِاسْمِهِ الَّذِي إِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى وَإِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ» قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُخْبِرُهُ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ لِي: أَنْتَ الْيَوْمَ لِي أَخٌ صَدِيقٌ حَدَّثْتَنِي بِحَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
units.en: Buradah said, "I came with the Prophet, into the Masjid, at the time of evening prayer; and unexpectedly a man was repeating in a loud voice: and I said, O messenger of God! do you say, that this person acts the hypocrite?" The Prophet said, "no; but he is a Musleman, and returner to God." And the person was Abu-Mu'sa Ashari. Then the Prophet stood up listening to his reading. After that, Abu Musa sat down, and supplicated, in these words, "O Lord! I take thee to witness that thou art God, the only one, and without need; thou art not the son of any one, nor is any one the son of thee, nor is there any one like unto thee." Then the Prophet said, "verily Abu-Mu'sa has supplicated God by a name, by which being supplicated, he grants; and accepts when asked." I said, "O messenger of God! may I inform Abu Mu'sa of what I have heard from you?" He said, "yes, tell him." And I did so; and he said to me, "you are my brother and friend to-day, for having told me a saying of the Prophet's."
units.en2: Burayda narrates: I entered the mosque with the Prophet ﷺ at the time of evening prayer, and unexpectedly a man was reciting in a loud voice. I said, "O Messenger of God, do you think this man is acting the hypocrite?" The Prophet said, "No — he is a Muslim, a returner to God." The man was Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī. The Prophet stood listening to his recitation. Then Abū Mūsā sat and supplicated: "O Lord, I call You to witness that You are God, the only One, without need; You are no one's son, nor is anyone Your son, nor is anyone like You." The Prophet said: "Abū Mūsā has supplicated God by a name by which, when supplicated, He grants, and when asked, He gives." I said, "O Messenger of God, may I tell Abū Mūsā what I heard from you?" He said, "Yes, tell him." I did so, and he said to me, "You are my brother and friend today, for having told me a saying of the Prophet ﷺ."

sections.heading: On the Rewards of Tasbíh, Tahmíd, Tahlíl and Tacbír (Matthews, Book X, Ch. II)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter II of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 547-553. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on the rewards of glorifying and praising God (reports 2294-2322), complete. Matthews' 'fig-trees' in one report renders the Mishkāt's نخلة (a date-palm).

units.ar: عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " أَفْضَلُ الْكَلَامِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ " وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: " أَحَبُّ الْكَلَامِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ "
units.en: Samurah-bin-Jundub. A. G. s. "The best words are four, Subhan allah, Alh'amdo-Lillahi, La ilaho ill-allahi; allaho Acber." (And in one tradition, "the words which God likes best are four," as above mentioned.) "It is of no detriment to you beginning with whichever of those you like."
units.en2: Samura ibn Jundub narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of words are four: Glory be to God, Praise be to God, There is no god but God, and God is greatest." (In one narration: "The words most beloved to God are four" — as above.) "It does you no harm whichever of them you begin with."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَأَنْ أَقُولَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْس "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily, my repeating these four words, is more liked by me, than every thing which the sun has risen upon; I mean the world and whatever is in it."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For me to say these four words — Glory be to God, Praise be to God, There is no god but God, God is greatest — is dearer to me than everything the sun has risen upon: the world and all that is in it."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Whoever says Subhan-allah and Bih'amdihi, a hundred times in a day, his faults shall be silenced; though they be great as the waves of the sea."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says 'Glory be to God and praise be to Him' a hundred times in a day, his faults will be wiped away, though they be as great as the foam of the sea."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ وَحِينَ يُمْسِي: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ لَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ)
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Whoever says, morning and evening, Subhan-allah and Bih'amdihi an hundred times, no one will bring a better deed than his on the day of resurrection; except one who shall have said like him, or added any thing to it."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says 'Glory be to God and praise be to Him' a hundred times, morning and evening — no one will bring a better deed than his on the Day of Resurrection, except one who said the same or added to it."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَهُ الله وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ الله الْعَظِيم "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "There are two expressions, light upon the tongue, and heavy in the scale of actions; which are Subhan-allah and Bihamdihi, Subh'an-allah iladhim."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are two expressions light on the tongue and heavy in the scale of deeds, beloved of the Merciful: 'Glory be to God and praise be to Him; Glory be to God the Magnificent.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ: قَالَ: كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟» فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ: كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: «يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنهُ ألفُ خطيئةٍ» . رَوَاهُ مُسلم وَفِي كِتَابه: فِي جَمِيعِ الرِّوَايَاتِ عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ: «أَوْ يُحَطُّ» قَالَ أَبُو بكر البرقاني وَرَوَاهُ شُعْبَةُ وَأَبُو عَوَانَةَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقطَّان عَن مُوسَى فَقَالُوا: «ويحُطُّ» بِغَيْر ألف هَكَذَا فِي كتاب الْحميدِي
units.en: Sa'd-bin-Abu-Wakk'as said, "we were near his highness, and he said, is it impossible for one of you to obtain a thousand virtues every day?" Then one of the persons sitting with him asked, "how can any one of us gain a thousand virtues every day?" His highness said, "repeat Subh'an-allah a hundred times, and then a thousand virtues shall be written for him, ten virtuous deeds for each repetition, or a thousand faults shall be put away from him."
units.en2: Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ narrates: We were with the Prophet ﷺ and he said, "Is it impossible for one of you to earn a thousand good deeds every day?" One of those sitting with him asked, "How can one of us gain a thousand good deeds a day?" He said: "Say 'Glory be to God' a hundred times, and a thousand good deeds will be written for him — ten for each repetition — or a thousand faults will be put away from him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَيُّ الْكَلَامِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: " مَا اصْطَفَى اللَّهُ لِمَلَائِكَتِهِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ "
units.en: Abu-D'har Ghaffari said, "the Prophet was asked, what is the best word?" He said, "the best word is a word which God has chosen for his own angels; Subh'an-allah and Bihamdihi."
units.en2: Abū Dharr al-Ghifārī narrates: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "What is the best of words?" He said: "The best of words is the word God chose for His angels: 'Glory be to God, and praise be to Him.'"

units.ar: وَعَن جوَيْرِية أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا بُكْرَةً حِينَ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَهِيَ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَضْحَى وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ قَالَ: «مَا زِلْتِ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي فَارَقْتُكِ عَلَيْهَا؟» قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاته "
units.en: Juwairiyah said, "verily, the Prophet went out from me, when he had performed morning prayer, and I was sitting in my place of prayer; after that he returned, at breakfast time, while I was still sitting at my place of prayer, and said, are you always in the state in which I left you, I mean from daybreak till this time, which is breakfast time, are you still sitting remembering God?" I said, "yes." The Prophet said, "verily I repeated, after leaving you, four words thrice; and if they were weighed with any thing which you have said and repeated to-day, verily they would be equal: they are these words, I remember thee, with purity and praise, to the number of thy creations; and in such a manner as shall be pleasing to thee, and by the weight of thy imperial throne, which is stupendous; and in number equal to thy words."
units.en2: Juwayriyya narrates: The Prophet ﷺ went out from me after performing the morning prayer while I was sitting in my prayer place; then he returned at breakfast time while I was still sitting there, and said, "Have you remained in the state in which I left you — sitting, remembering God, from daybreak until now?" I said, "Yes." The Prophet said: "Since leaving you I have repeated four words three times — and if they were weighed against all you have said today, they would outweigh it: 'I glorify You and praise You as many times as the number of Your creation, in a manner pleasing to You, with the weight of Your Throne, and as many times as Your words.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: " من قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ وَكُتِبَتْ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ عَمِلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "The person who says, there is no God but one, to whom there is no partner; for him is dominion and praise, and he is powerful over all things, a hundred times, there shall be rewards equal to the emancipating of ten slaves; and a hundred good actions shall be written for him; and a hundred misdeeds shall be blotted out from him; and these words shall be an asylum for him from the devil and his wickedness; in that in which he shall have repeated them, unto the evening; nor will any one bring a better deed than this at the day of resurrection; except a man who has done more than he."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says 'There is no god but God alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is powerful over all things' a hundred times — it equals freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are written for him, a hundred misdeeds are blotted from him, and those words are a refuge for him from the devil and his wickedness until the evening; and no one will bring a better deed on the Day of Resurrection, except one who did more than he."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَجْهَرُونَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَا تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلَا غَائِبًا إِنَّكُمْ تَدْعُونَ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ وَالَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ عُنُقِ رَاحِلَتِهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى: وَأَنَا خَلْفَهُ أَقُولُ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فِي نَفْسِي فَقَالَ: «يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ؟» فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ»الْفَصْل الثَّانِي
units.en: Abu Musa-al-Ashari said, "we were with the Prophet on a journey, and some men stood up repeating Allaho-Acber aloud; and the Prophet said, O men! be easy on yourselves, and do not distress yourselves by raising your voices; verily you do not repeat to one deaf or absent, but verily to one who heareth and seeth; and he is with you; and he to whom you pray is nearer to you than the neck of your camel."
units.en2: Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī narrates: We were with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey, and some men stood up proclaiming 'God is greatest' aloud. The Prophet said: "Men! Be easy on yourselves; do not strain your voices — you are not calling on one who is deaf or absent, but on One who hears and sees; and He is with you; the One you call upon is nearer to you than the neck of your camel."

units.ar: عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»
units.en: Jabir. A. G. s. "He who says subhan-allah-al-izim and Bihamdihi, fig-trees shall be planted for him in paradise."
units.en2: Jābir narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says 'Glory be to God the Magnificent, and praise be to Him,' a date-palm will be planted for him in Paradise."

units.ar: وَعَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ صَبَاحٍ يُصْبِحُ الْعِبَادُ فِيهِ إِلَّا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي سَبِّحُوا الْمَلِكَ القدوس»
units.en: Al-Zubair. A. G. s. "There is no morning in which servants rise, but a crier proclaims, Subhan-al-Malic-al-kudus."
units.en2: Al-Zubayr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No morning comes upon the servants without a crier proclaiming: 'Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " أَفْضَلُ الذِّكْرِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَفْضَلُ الدُّعَاءِ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ "
units.en: Jabir. A. G. s. "The best remembrance is La-ilaho-ill-allahi, and the best call is Al-Hamdo-Lillahi."
units.en2: Jābir narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best remembrance is 'There is no god but God,' and the best supplication is 'Praise be to God.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الْحَمْدُ رَأْسُ الشُّكْرِ مَا شَكَرَ اللَّهَ عَبْدٌ لَا يحمده»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Amer. A. G. s. "The praise of God is the head of gratitude; a servant has not shewn perfect gratitude to God who has not praised him."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The praise of God is the head of gratitude; a servant has not shown perfect gratitude to God who has not praised Him."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُدْعَى إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الَّذِينَ يَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ» . رَوَاهُمَا الْبَيْهَقِيُّ فِي شُعَبِ الْإِيمَان
units.en: Ibn-Abbas. A. G. s. "The first person that will be called and taken towards paradise on the day of resurrection, will be he who praises and is grateful to God; when pleased or displeased; that is, in all situations."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The first to be called and taken toward Paradise on the Day of Resurrection will be those who praised God in every state — when pleased and when displeased."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " قَالَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: يَا رَبِّ عَلِّمْنِي شَيْئًا أَذْكُرُكَ بِهِ وَأَدْعُوكَ بِهِ فَقَالَ: يَا مُوسَى قُلْ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَبِّ كلُّ عبادكَ يقولُ هَذَا إِنَّما أيد شَيْئًا تَخُصُّنِي بِهِ قَالَ: يَا مُوسَى لَوْ أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعَ وَعَامِرَهُنَّ غَيْرِي وَالْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعَ وُضِعْنَ فِي كِفَّةٍ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فِي كِفَّةٍ لَمَالَتْ بِهِنَّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ "
units.en: Abu-Sa'id-al-Khudri. A. G. s. "Moses said, O my patron! teach me in what terms to call on thee." God said, "say, O Moses! La-ilaho ill-allahi." Then Moses said, "O my cherisher! every one of thy servants says this, and I wish for nothing but a thing particularly for me." God said, "O Moses! if the seven regions and their inhabitants, and the seven earths, were put into one scale, and La-ilaho-ill-allahi in another; verily the scale in which these words are placed, would preponderate."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Moses said, 'O my Lord! Teach me in what terms to call upon You.' God said, 'Say, O Moses: There is no god but God.' Moses said, 'O my Cherisher! every one of Your servants says this; I wished for something particular to me.' God said, 'O Moses! If the seven heavens and their inhabitants and the seven earths were put in one scale, and "There is no god but God" in another, the scale in which these words are placed would outweigh them."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَا: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ صَدَّقَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا وَأَنَا أَكْبَرُ وَإِذَا قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا وَحْدِي لَا شَرِيكَ لِي وَإِذَا قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا لِيَ الْمُلْكُ وَلِيَ الْحَمْدُ وَإِذَا قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله وَلَا وحول وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ قَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِي " وَكَانَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَالَهَا فِي مَرَضِهِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ لَمْ تَطْعَمْهُ النَّارُ»
units.en: Abu-Sa'id, and Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "The person who says La-ilaho-ill'-allahi, and allaho-Acber, his cherisher holds him as a teller of truth; and God says, there is no God but me, and I am the most great. And when a servant says, there is no God but God, one, to whom there is no partner, God says, there is no God but me, I am one, there is no partner with me. And when a servant says: La-ilaho-ill-allahi Lihu'l-Mudco-wa-lihu'l-hamdo, God says, there is no God but me; mine is dominion and praise. And when a servant says La-ilaho-ill-allahi La-Hawlo wa la Kuwwato-illa-B'illahi, God says, there is no God but me; and there is no power and strength except in me." And his highness used to say, "the person who repeats these words, in sickness, and dies in it, the fire of hell will not eat him."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd and Abū Hurayra narrate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a servant says 'There is no god but God, and God is greatest,' his Lord holds him truthful, and God says, 'There is no god but Me, and I am the Most Great.' And when a servant says, 'There is no god but God, One, without partner,' God says, 'There is no god but Me; I am One, without partner.' And when a servant says, 'There is no god but God; His is the dominion and His is the praise,' God says, 'There is no god but Me; Mine is the dominion and the praise.' And when a servant says, 'There is no god but God; there is no power and no strength except in God,' God says, 'There is no god but Me, and there is no power and no strength except in Me.'" And the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "Whoever repeats these words in sickness and dies in it, the fire of Hell will not consume him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا نَوًى أَوْ حَصًى تُسَبِّحُ بِهِ فَقَالَ: «أَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ بِمَا هُوَ أَيْسَرُ عليكِ مِنْ هَذَا أَوْ أَفْضَلُ؟ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ»
units.en: Sad-bin-Abu-Wakkas said, "I came with the Prophet to a woman; and she had date kernels near her, and was using them as a rosary: and the Prophet said, shall I not inform you, O woman! of a rosary easier for you than these kernels, and better than them? It is the repetition of these words: immaculate God! in number equal to the things which thou hast created in the regions, and immaculate God! in number equal to the things which thou hast created in the earth; and immaculate God! in number equal to the things, which are between the heavens and the earth; and immaculate God! in number equal to the things which thou art the creator of; and the greatness of God, in number equal to the things which are in the regions and on earth: and say praise be to God, like that; and there is no God but God, like that; and there is no power or strength except in God, like that."
units.en2: Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ narrates: I came with the Prophet ﷺ to a woman who had date-stones beside her and was using them as a rosary. The Prophet said, "Shall I tell you, O woman, of a rosary easier for you than these stones, and better? It is saying: Glory be to God, as many times as what He has created in the heavens; Glory be to God, as many times as what He has created in the earth; Glory be to God, as many times as what is between them; Glory be to God, as many times as what He creates; and God is greatest, as many times as what is in the heavens and the earth; and praise be to God likewise; and there is no god but God likewise; and there is no power or strength except in God likewise."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ مِائَةً بِالْغَدَاةِ وَمِائَةً بِالْعَشِيِّ كَانَ كَمَنْ حَجَّ مِائَةَ حَجَّةٍ وَمَنْ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ مِائَةً بِالْغَدَاةِ وَمِائَةً بِالْعَشِيِّ كَانَ كَمَنْ حَمَلَ عَلَى مِائَةِ فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ هَلَّلَ اللَّهَ مِائَةً بِالْغَدَاةِ وَمِائَةً بِالْعَشِيِّ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ مِائَةَ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَمَنْ كَبَّرَ اللَّهَ مِائَةً بِالْغَدَاةِ وَمِائَةً بِالْعَشِيِّ لَمْ يَأْتِ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ أَحَدٌ بِأَكْثَرِ مِمَّا أَتَى بِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَى مَا قَالَ وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيب
units.en: Omer-bin-Showaib relates from his fore-fathers, that the Prophet said, "he who repeats Subhan allah one hundred times in the morning and evening, shall be like a person having performed ten pilgrimages; and he who says al-hamdo Lillahi, a hundred times, morning and evening, shall be like the person who has mounted men upon a hundred horses in the road of God; and he who says La-ilaho-ill-illahi a hundred times, morning and evening, shall be like one that has freed a hundred slaves of the children of Israel; and he who says Allaho Acber one hundred times, morning and evening, no one will produce on that a better deed, except one that has said the like, having added to it."
units.en2: ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb relates from his father from his grandfather that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says 'Glory be to God' a hundred times, morning and evening, is like one who has performed ten pilgrimages; whoever says 'Praise be to God' a hundred times, morning and evening, is like one who has mounted a hundred horses in God's way; whoever says 'There is no god but God' a hundred times, morning and evening, is like one who has freed a hundred slaves of the children of Israel; and whoever says 'God is greatest' a hundred times, morning and evening — no one will bring a better deed that day, except one who said the same and added to it."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «التَّسْبِيحُ نِصْفُ الْمِيزَانِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ يَمْلَؤُهُ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهَا حِجَابٌ دُونَ اللَّهِ حَتَّى تَخْلُصَ إِلَيْهِ» وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ وَلَيْسَ إِسْنَاده بِالْقَوِيّ
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Amer. A. G. s. "Saying Subhan-allah is half the scale of actions; and saying al-hamdo L'illahi fills the scale; and La-ilaho ill'illahi leaves no curtain between him, and, God, till he reaches him."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Saying 'Glory be to God' is half the scale of deeds; saying 'Praise be to God' fills the scale; and 'There is no god but God' leaves no curtain between him and God until it reaches Him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا قَالَ عَبْدٌ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصًا قَطُّ إِلَّا فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى يُفْضِيَ إِلَى الْعَرْشِ مَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ» وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيث غَرِيب
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "No servant has said La-ilaho-ill-illahi, with an unsullied heart, but the doors of the regions are opened for him, until he reaches the imperial throne; that is, God: so long as he abstains from great crimes."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No servant says 'There is no god but God' with an unsullied heart without the doors of the heavens being opened for him until it reaches the Throne — that is, God — so long as he abstains from the great sins."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَقِيتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَيْلَةَ أُسَرِيَ بِي فَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَقْرِئْ أُمَّتَكَ مِنِّي السَّلَامَ وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ طَيِّبَةُ التُّرْبَةِ عَذْبَةُ الْمَاءِ وَأَنَّهَا قِيعَانٌ وَأَنَّ غِرَاسَهَا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ " وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ إِسْنَادًا
units.en: Abu-Masu'ud. A. G. s. "I met Abraham, in the night of my ascension; and he said, give my Salam to your sect, and inform them that paradise and its earth is sweet and pure, and its water sweet and pleasant; its lands level, and without trees; and there is no verdure in it; and acquaint them that its trees are these words, Subhan-allah and al-hamdo-L'illahi, and La-ilaho-ill-allahi; allaho-Acher; that is, trees are planted there in rewards for men's actions; every word which is said of these words has a tree planted for it in paradise."
units.en2: Abū Masʿūd narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: "I met Abraham on the night of my Ascension, and he said: Give my greeting of peace to your community, and tell them that Paradise's soil is sweet and pure, its water sweet and pleasant, its lands level — and its trees are these words: 'Glory be to God, and praise be to God, and there is no god but God, and God is greatest': trees are planted there as rewards for men's deeds; every one of these words that is said has a tree planted for it in Paradise."

units.ar: وَعَنْ يُسَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ قَالَتْ: قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «عَلَيْكُنَّ بِالتَّسْبِيحِ وَالتَّهْلِيلِ وَالتَّقْدِيسِ واعقِدْنَ بالأناملِ فإِنهنَّ مسؤولات مُسْتَنْطَقَاتٌ وَلَا تَغْفُلْنَ فَتَنْسَيْنَ الرَّحْمَةَ»
units.en: Yusairah (and she was one of the women, who accompanied the Prophet in his flight from Mecca to Medinah,) said, "the Prophet said to us, may ye, O assemblage of women! remember God with purity, and say Subhan-ala-Malic-al-kudus, and count it upon your fingers; because verily a finger will be asked on the day of resurrection, what it obtained, and it will be made to speak: be not negligent, O women! in remembrance of God; if ye are, ye will be forgotten and disappointed of the mercy of God; I mean you will not meet with God's mercy."
units.en2: Yusayra — one of the women who emigrated with the Prophet ﷺ from Mecca to Medina — narrates: The Prophet said to us, "Assembly of women! Glorify God and say 'Glory be to the King, the Most Holy,' and count it on your fingers, for on the Day of Resurrection a finger will be asked what it earned, and it will be made to speak. Do not be heedless of the remembrance of God, women, lest you be forgotten and deprived of God's mercy."

units.ar: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلَامًا أَقُولُهُ قَالَ: «قُلْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَى بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ» . فَقَالَ فَهَؤُلَاءِ لِرَبِّي فَمَا لِي؟ فَقَالَ: «قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَعَافِنِي» . شَكَّ الرَّاوِي فِي «عَافِنِي»
units.en: Sad-bin-Abu Wakkas said, "an Aarabi came to the Prophet, and said, teach me something to say." His highness said, "say La ilaho-ill'allahi, one to whom there is no partner; great God, very much; and Al-Hamdo-Lillahi, very much; and Subhan-allah Rabb-ul-Aalamin. and La hawlo-wa-la-Hawwato illa Billahit-ali-il-Azim." The Aarabi said, "these are for God, his praise and glory; then what is for me to supplicate with?" His highness said, say, "O Lord! forgive me, and have mercy upon me, and shew me the straight way, and give me sustenance and health."
units.en2: Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ narrates: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Teach me something to say." He said, "Say: There is no god but God, the One without partner; God is greatest, abundantly; and Praise be to God, abundantly; and Glory be to God, Lord of the worlds; and there is no power and no strength except in God, the Most High, the Magnificent." The Bedouin said, "Those are for God — His praise and glory; what is for me to supplicate with?" He said, "Say: O Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me on the straight way, and grant me provision and health."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ عَلَى شَجَرَةٍ يَابِسَةِ الْوَرَقِ فَضَرَبَهَا بِعَصَاهُ فَتَنَاثَرَ الْوَرَقُ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ تُساقطُ ذُنوبَ العَبدِ كَمَا يتَساقطُ وَرَقُ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ» وَقَالَ: هَذَا حديثٌ غَرِيب
units.en: Anas. The Prophet passed near a tree, whose leaves were dry; and he struck it with a stick which was in his hand; and its leaves fell, and were scattered: then the Prophet said, "verily saying Al-hamdo Lillahi, and La-ilaho-ill-allahi and Allaho-acber, throws down the faults of servants, like as drop the leaves of this tree."
units.en2: Anas narrates: The Prophet ﷺ passed by a tree whose leaves were dry, and he struck it with a stick in his hand, and its leaves fell scattering. Then the Prophet said: "Saying 'Praise be to God,' and 'There is no god but God,' and 'God is greatest,' throws down a servant's faults as the leaves of this tree dropped."

units.ar: وَعَن مَكحولِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " أَكْثِرْ مِنْ قَوْلِ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ كَنْزِ الْجَنَّةِ ". قَالَ مَكْحُولٌ: فَمَنْ قَالَ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا مَنْجًى مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ كَشَفَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ سَبْعِينَ بَابًا مِنَ الضُّرِّ أَدْنَاهَا الْفَقْرُ وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ لَيْسَ إِسْنَادُهُ بِمُتَّصِلٍ وَمَكْحُولٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
units.en: Mac'hul said, Ab'uhurairah said, that the Prophet said to me, "say very much La-hawlo-wa-la-Kuwwato illa Billahi, because these words are one of the treasures of paradise; then he who repeats them, and La Manjaa min-illahi-illa-ilaihi, God opens for him seventy doors from harm, the least of which is poverty."
units.en2: Makhūl said that Abū Hurayra said that the Prophet ﷺ said to me: "Say often: 'There is no power and no strength except in God,' for these words are one of the treasures of Paradise; and whoever repeats them, and 'There is no refuge from God except to Him,' God opens for him seventy doors against harm, the least of which is poverty."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ دَوَاءٌ مِنْ تِسْعَةٍ وَتِسْعِينَ دَاء أيسرها الْهم»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G.s. "La Hawlo-wa-La-kuwwato-illa-B'illahi is a medicine for ninety-nine pains, the easiest of which is melancholy."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "'There is no power and no strength except in God' is a medicine for ninety-nine pains, the least of which is anxiety."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْعَرْشِ مِنْ كَنْزِ الْجَنَّةِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: أَسلَمَ عَبدِي واستسلم ". رَوَاهُمَا الْبَيْهَقِيّ فِي الدَّعْوَات الْكَبِير
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Shall I not shew you the way to a word which came down from under the imperial throne? It is this: La-h'awlo-wa-La-kuwwato illa B'illahi; and when a servant repeats it, God says, my servant has adored me, and resigned his work to me."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Shall I not show you a word that came down from beneath the Throne? It is: 'There is no power and no strength except in God.' When a servant repeats it, God says: My servant has worshipped Me and surrendered his affair to Me."

units.ar: وَعَن ابْن عمر أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ هِيَ صَلَاةُ الْخَلَائِقِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَلِمَةُ الشُّكْرِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ كَلِمَةُ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ تَمْلَأُ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِذَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: أسلم عَبدِي واستَسلَم
units.en: Ibn Omer. A. G. s. "Subhan allah is the adoration of the creation; and Al-hamdo Lillahi is a word of thanksgiving; and La ilaho-ill' allahi, is a word of unity; and Allaho-acber, fills what is between the regions and the earth; when a servant says La Hawl-wa-la Kuwwato-illa-Billahi, God says my servant has worshipped me, and resigned his work to me."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "'Glory be to God' is the adoration of all creation; 'Praise be to God' is the word of thanksgiving; 'There is no god but God' is the word of unity; and 'God is greatest' fills what is between the heavens and the earth. When a servant says, 'There is no power and no strength except in God,' God says: My servant has worshipped Me and resigned his affair to Me."

sections.heading: On Asking Pardon and Repentance (Matthews, Book X, Ch. III)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter III of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 554-562. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on asking forgiveness and repentance (reports 2323-2363); Matthews omits the cross-reference note 2337 and report 2349.

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لِأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سبعينَ مرَّةً»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "I swear by God, that verily I ask pardon of God, and turn from sin towards him, more than seventy times daily."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By God, I ask God's pardon and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day."

units.ar: وَعَنِ الْأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْم مائَة مرّة»
units.en: Agharro-al-Muzani. A. G. s. "Verily, my heart is veiled with melancholy, and sadness for my sect; and verily I ask pardon of God one hundred times a day."
units.en2: Al-Agharr al-Muzanī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A veil comes over my heart, and I ask God's pardon a hundred times a day."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ مائةَ مرِّةٍ»
units.en: Agharro Muzani. A. G. s. "O men repent and turn to God; for verily I repent towards him one hundred times a day."
units.en2: Al-Agharr al-Muzanī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O men, repent and turn to God — for I repent toward Him a hundred times a day."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَرْوِي عَنِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «يَا عِبَادِي إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الظُّلْمَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَجَعَلْتُهُ بَيْنَكُمْ مُحَرَّمًا فَلَا تَظَالَمُوا يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ ضَالٌّ إِلَّا مَنْ هَدَيْتُهُ فَاسْتَهْدُونِي أَهْدِكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ جَائِعٌ إِلَّا مَنْ أَطْعَمْتُهُ فَاسْتَطْعِمُونِي أُطْعِمْكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ عَارٍ إِلَّا مَنْ كَسَوْتُهُ فَاسْتَكْسُونِي أَكْسُكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ تُخْطِئُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَأَنَا أَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا فَاسْتَغْفِرُونِي أَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَبْلُغُوا ضَرِّي فَتَضُرُّونِي وَلَنْ تَبْلُغُوا نَفْعِي فَتَنْفَعُونِي يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وإنسكم وجنكم كَانُوا أَتْقَى قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْكُمْ مَا زَادَ ذَلِكَ فِي مُلْكِي شَيْئًا يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَإِنْسَكُمْ وَجِنَّكُمْ كَانُوا عَلَى أفجر قلب وَاحِد مِنْكُم مَا نقص مِنْ مُلْكِي شَيْئًا يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَإِنْسَكُمْ وَجِنَّكُمْ قَامُوا فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَسَأَلُونِي فَأَعْطَيْتُ كُلَّ إِنْسَانٍ مَسْأَلَتَهُ مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا عِنْدِي إِلَّا كَمَا يَنْقُصُ الْمِخْيَطُ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ الْبَحْرَ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَعمالكُم أحصها عَلَيْكُمْ ثُمَّ أُوَفِّيكُمْ إِيَّاهَا فَمَنْ وَجَدَ خَيْرًا فَلْيَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ وَمِنْ وَجَدَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَلُومن إِلَّا نَفسه»
units.en: Abu Dhar Ghaffari. A. G. s. "God said, O my servants! verily I have forbidden myself oppression, and have ordained that oppression amongst you be forbidden: then oppress not each other. O my servants! ye have all strayed except those to whom I have shewn the road; then ask me for directions, that I may shew you the way. O my servants! ye are all hungry, except those to whom I give food; then ask me for food, that I may give it unto you. O my servants! ye are all naked except him whom I clothe, then ask me for garments, that I may give them unto you. O my servants! verily you offend night and day, and I pardon all; then ask me for forgiveness, that I may forgive you. O my servants! verily no detriment happens to you, until you sin; nor doth a benefit reach you, until you worship. O my servants! if the first and last of you, your men and Genii, were abstinent, it would increase nothing in my reign. O my servants! if the first and last of you, your men and Genii, were disobedient, and sinful, it would not lessen any thing of my reign. O my servants! if your first and your last, your men and Genii, were to stand on one plain, and supplicate, and ask me for whatever they wished, and I gave to every one his wish, this giving would not lessen what I have, except as a needle diminishes the water of the sea, when taken out of it. O my servants! there are none of you good, or bad actions which I do not know; after which I give you their rewards; then he who gets good reward must thank me; and he who gets a bad reward, must reproach himself."
units.en2: Abū Dharr al-Ghifārī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: God said, "O My servants, I have forbidden Myself oppression and have made it forbidden among you — so do not oppress one another. O My servants, you have all strayed except those I have guided — so ask Me for guidance, and I will guide you. O My servants, you are all hungry except those I feed — so ask Me for food, and I will feed you. O My servants, you are all naked except those I clothe — so ask Me for clothing, and I will clothe you. O My servants, you err by night and by day, and I pardon all — so ask Me for forgiveness, and I will forgive you. O My servants, no harm befalls you until you sin, and no benefit reaches you until you worship. O My servants, if the first and last of you, your men and your jinn, were all pious, that would add nothing to My kingdom; and if the first and last of you, your men and your jinn, were all disobedient and sinful, that would diminish nothing of My kingdom. O My servants, if the first and last of you, your men and your jinn, stood on one plain and asked Me, and I gave everyone his wish, that would not diminish what I have except as a needle diminishes the sea's water when drawn from it. O My servants, there is none of you whose good or bad deeds I do not know, and then I give you their rewards — so whoever finds a good reward, let him thank Me; and whoever finds a bad reward, let him blame himself."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " كَانَ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ رَجُلٌ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ إِنْسَانًا ثُمَّ خَرَجَ يَسْأَلُ فَأَتَى رَاهِبًا فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ: أَلَهَ تَوْبَةٌ قَالَ: لَا فَقَتَلَهُ وَجَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ ائْتِ قَرْيَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَأَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَنَاءَ بِصَدْرِهِ نَحْوَهَا فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ مَلَائِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلَائِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَقَرَّبِي وَإِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَبَاعَدِي فَقَالَ قِيسُوا مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَوُجِدَ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَقْرَبَ بِشِبْرٍ فَغُفِرَ لَهُ "
units.en: Abu Sa'id Khudhri. A. G. s. "There was a man of the children of Israel, who killed ninety-nine people; after which he came out asking if his repentance would be accepted; and having met a monk, he asked him, is there acceptance for my repentance? The monk said, no. Then the man killed the monk, and stood asking people about the approval of his repentance. And a man said to him, come to such a village, in which there is a sage who will open your difficulty. Then the signs of immediate death were upon him, and he tried to reach the village upon his breast, and died. Then the angels of mercy and punishment disputed about him; that is, the angels of mercy said, God will pardon him; and the others, God will punish him. Then God ordered the village, towards which the man had attempted to go, to be near to the corpse; and the village which he had fled from, to be far away from him. Then God said to the angels, compute, and measure the distance between the two villages, relatively to the dead man; which of the two is nearest to him. And it was found that the village towards which he was going was nearer to him by one span; and he was pardoned."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There was a man of the children of Israel who killed ninety-nine people; then he came out asking whether his repentance would be accepted. He met a monk and asked him, 'Is there acceptance for my repentance?' The monk said, 'No.' Then the man killed the monk, and stood asking people about the acceptance of his repentance. A man said to him, 'Go to such-and-such a village, in which there is a sage who will resolve your difficulty.' Then the signs of approaching death were upon him, and he dragged himself toward the village upon his chest, and died. The angels of mercy and the angels of punishment disputed over him — the angels of mercy said, 'God will pardon him,' and the others, 'God will punish him.' Then God ordered the village toward which the man had been heading to draw near his corpse, and the village he had fled to be far from him; and He said to the angels, 'Measure the distance between the two villages relative to the dead man — whichever is nearest to him.' And the village toward which he was going was found nearer by one span — and he was pardoned."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ وَلَجَاءَ بِقَوْمٍ يُذْنِبُونَ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ فَيَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "I swear by God, if you do not sin, verily God will take you; and verily God is ready to forgive a tribe that commits faults and then asks pardon."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By God, if you did not sin, God would take you away and bring a people who do sin, then ask pardon, and God forgives them."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا»
units.en: Abu Mu'sa. A. G. s. "Verily God expands the hands of his compassion in the night, that committers of faults in the day may repent; and expands the hands of mercy in the day, that committers of faults in the night may repent, until the sun shall rise in the west."
units.en2: Abū Mūsā narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God spreads the hand of His compassion by night for those who sinned by day to repent, and spreads the hand of His mercy by day for those who sinned by night to repent — until the sun rises in the west."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: «إِنَّ الْعَبَدَ إِذَا اعْتَرَفَ ثُمَّ تَابَ تَابَ الله عَلَيْهِ»
units.en: Aayeshah. A. G. s. "Verily, when a servant confesses his faults, and repeats, and turns to the court of God, God approves of his repentance."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a servant confesses his faults and repents, God turns to him in forgiveness."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا تَابَ الله عَلَيْهِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "He who repents before the sun rises in the west, God accepts his repentance."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever repents before the sun rises in the west, God accepts his repentance."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كانَ رَاحِلَتُهُ بِأَرْضٍ فَلَاةٍ فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَأَيِسَ مِنْهَا فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ كذلكَ إِذ هُوَ بِهَا قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ أَخْطَأَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ "
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "God is verily glad at the repentance of his servants, when they repent and turn to him; more than one of you, whose riding camel, having run away, and left him in a desart without food or water; he comes under a tree, and lays himself down under its shade, full of sorrow; having lost all hope of his camel: when, all at once, he beholds his camel, standing near him; and takes him by the rope; and then says, from excessive pleasure, O God thou art my servant, and I am thy lord; having made a blunder from the excess of his joy."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God rejoices at His servant's repentance when he repents and turns to Him, more than one of you whose riding camel runs away and leaves him in a desert without food or water: he comes to a tree and lies down in its shade in despair, having lost all hope of his camel — when all at once he sees his camel standing near him, takes it by the rope, and says from excess of joy, 'O God, You are my servant and I am Your lord' — blundering from the excess of his joy."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ عَبْدًا أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا فَقَالَ: رَبِّ أَذْنَبْتُ فَاغْفِرْهُ فَقَالَ رَبُّهُ أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي ثُمَّ مَكَثَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا فَقَالَ: رَبِّ أَذْنَبْتُ ذَنْبًا فَاغْفِرْهُ فَقَالَ رَبُّهُ: أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي ثُمَّ مَكَثَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَذْنَبَ ذَنبا قالَ: رب أذنبت ذَنبا آخر فَاغْفِر لِي فَقَالَ: أَعَلِمَ عَبْدِي أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي فَلْيَفْعَلْ مَا شَاءَ "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily, a servant committed a fault, and said, O my patron! I have erred, then pardon me." And God says to the angels, "did my servant know that verily there is a defender for him, who pardons his faults, and punishes on account of them? I have pardoned him by this." After that, the servant has been a long time without committing a fault; as long as God willed; and then offended another time, and said, O my cherisher! I have offended, pardon it. And God says, "did my servant know, that there is a cherisher who forgives and punishes; I have pardoned him." Then he does not offend, as long as God wills; after which he commits a fault, and says, O my patron! I have been guilty of a fault; forgive it. God says to the angels, "did my servant know that he had a defender who forgives and punishes? I have pardoned him: then tell my servant to commit faults as often as he likes, as long as he asks pardon."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A servant committed a fault and said, 'O my Lord! I have erred — pardon me.' And God says to the angels, 'Did My servant know that he has a Lord who pardons faults and punishes for them? I have pardoned him.' Then the servant went a long time without sinning, as long as God willed, then offended again and said, 'O my Cherisher! I have offended — pardon it.' And God says, 'Did My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives and punishes? I have pardoned him.' Then he did not offend as long as God willed, after which he committed a fault and said, 'O my Lord! I have been guilty of a fault — forgive it.' God says to the angels, 'Did My servant know that he has a Lord who forgives and punishes? I have pardoned him — tell My servant to do as he likes, as long as he asks pardon.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ جُنْدُبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدَّثَ: " أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَا يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِفُلَانٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَالَ: مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَتَأَلَّى عَلَيَّ أَنِّي لَا أَغْفِرُ لِفُلَانٍ فَإِنِّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِفُلَانٍ وَأَحْبَطْتُ عَمَلَكَ ". أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ
units.en: Jundub. A. G. s. "Verily a man said, by God, God will not forgive such a one. And verily God said, who is it that swears by me I will not pardon such a one? verily I have pardoned him, and have made vain the actions of the liar."
units.en2: Jundub narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man said, 'By God, God will not forgive so-and-so.' And God said, 'Who is it that swears by Me that I will not pardon so-and-so? I have pardoned him, and made vain the deeds of the one who swore.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " سَيِّدُ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعَتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ". قَالَ: «وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ»
units.en: Shaddad-bin-Aws. A. G. s. "This is the most excellent for you to say, in asking pardon, O Lord! thou art my cherisher; there is no true God but thee; thou didst create me; and I am firm in the promise I made thee, to the utmost of my power; I seek protection with thee from the badness of my faults; I confess to thee, thy benefits to me, and the constancy of my existence; and I confess my faults; then pardon me; for verily no person forgives faults but thee." His highness said, "then any one that shall say these words in the day, when having sincerity and dependance in them, and dies in that day, before reaching the evening, is of the people of paradise; and whoever says them in the night, when knowing them as true, and dies before the morning, is of the people of paradise."
units.en2: Shaddād ibn Aws narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The most excellent way of asking pardon is to say: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no true god but You; You created me and I am Your servant; I am firm in Your covenant and promise as far as I am able; I seek Your protection from the evil of my deeds; I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my faults — so pardon me, for no one forgives faults but You." He said: "Whoever says these words in the day, with sincerity and reliance upon them, and dies that day before evening, is of the people of Paradise; and whoever says them at night, knowing them to be true, and dies before morning, is of the people of Paradise."

units.ar: عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ مَا دَعَوْتَنِي وَرَجَوْتَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَكَ عَلَى مَا كَانَ فِيكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي يَا ابنَ آدمَ إِنَّك لَوْ بَلَغَتْ ذُنُوبُكَ عَنَانَ السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ اسْتَغْفَرْتَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ لَوْ لَقِيتَنِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا ثُمَّ لَقِيتَنِي لَا تُشْرِكُ بِي شَيْئًا لَأَتَيْتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مغْفرَة "
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. God said, "O children of Adam! verily, so long as ye supplicate me, to be pardoned, and for hope, I will forgive you every bad act, that may be on you; and I fear not. O children of Adam! if your faults reach the regions, and fill all their quarters, and you ask me for forgiveness, verily I pardon you; and I have no fear. O children of Adam! verily, if you come before me with faults equal to the full of the earth; and then come before me without associating any thing with me, verily I will come before you with the earth full of pardon; that is, I will pardon any quantity of sins you commit."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: God said, "O children of Adam! As long as you supplicate Me with hope of pardon, I will forgive you every bad deed upon you, and I do not mind. O children of Adam! If your faults reached the heavens and filled their quarters, and you asked Me for forgiveness, I would pardon you, and I do not mind. O children of Adam! If you came before Me with faults equal to the fill of the earth, and then came before Me associating nothing with Me, I would come before you with an earth-full of pardon."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا عَنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: مَنْ عَلِمَ أَنِّي ذُو قُدْرَةٍ عَلَى مَغْفِرَةِ الذُّنُوبِ غَفَرْتُ لَهُ وَلَا أُبَالِي مَا لم تشرك بِي شَيْئا "
units.en: Ibn-Abbas relates, from the Prophet, that God said, "he who has known that I have the power to forgive him, I will pardon; and I have no fear, as long as he does not associate any thing with me."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās relates from the Prophet ﷺ that God said: "Whoever knows that I have the power to forgive him, I will pardon him — and I do not mind — so long as he associates nothing with Me."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ لَزِمَ الِاسْتِغْفَارَ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقٍ مَخْرَجًا وَمِنْ كُلِّ هَمٍّ فَرَجًا وَرَزَقَهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ»
units.en: Ibn-Abb'as. A. G. s. "He who asks pardon continually, God releases from every constraint; and makes him a pleasure for every melancholy, and sends him sustenance, from that place which he neither supposed or had hope from."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever continually asks pardon, God releases him from every constraint, gives him relief from every sorrow, and sends him sustenance from a place he neither supposed nor hoped for."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا أَصَرَّ مَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ وَإِنْ عَادَ فِي الْيَوْمِ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً»
units.en: Abu-Bakr. A. G. s. "An incessant sinner, has not sinned, that has asked pardon; although he may have sinned seventy times a day; because asking pardon is their coverer."
units.en2: Abū Bakr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "An incessant sinner has not truly persisted in sin if he has asked pardon — though he may have sinned seventy times a day — because asking pardon covers them."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "The most of the sons of Adam are sinners, and the best of sinners are repenters."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Most of the children of Adam are sinners, and the best of sinners are the repenters."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنِ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا أَذْنَبَ كَانَتْ نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فِي قَلْبِهِ فَإِنْ تَابَ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ صُقِلَ قَلْبُهُ وَإِنْ زَادَ زَادَتْ حَتَّى تَعْلُوَ قَلْبَهُ فَذَلِكُمُ الرَّانُ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى (كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يكسِبونَ)
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily, when a true believer commits a fault, a black spot is created in his heart; therefore, if he repents, and asks pardon of God, the black spot is polished from his heart; and, if he increases his sinning, the black spot increases; so that it takes hold of the whole heart. Then this spot is a rust, which God has mentioned in the revelation, their hearts became rusty from their works."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a true believer commits a fault, a black spot is created in his heart; if he repents and asks God's pardon, the spot is polished from his heart; but if he goes on sinning, the spot grows until it seizes the whole heart. This spot is the rust God mentioned in the revelation: 'Their hearts became rusty from their works.'"

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبَلُ تَوْبَةَ الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ»
units.en: Ibn-Omer. A. G. s. "Verily God accepts of the repentance of his servant, as long as his soul does not come into his throat."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God accepts His servant's repentance as long as his soul has not come into his throat."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَالَ: وَعِزَّتِكَ يَا رَبِّ لَا أَبْرَحُ أُغْوِي عِبَادَكَ مَا دَامَتْ أَرْوَاحُهُمْ فِي أَجْسَادِهِمْ فَقَالَ الرَّبُّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي وَارْتِفَاعِ مَكَانِي لَا أَزَالُ أَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَغْفَرُونِي "
units.en: Abu-Sa'id-Khudhri. A. G. s. "Verily the devil said, I swear by thy greatness, O cherisher! I always lead your servants astray, so long as the soul is in their bodies."
