Then God said, "I swear by my greatness, my might, and sublime eminence, I always forgive my servants, as long as they ask pardon of me."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Satan said, 'I swear by Your greatness, O Lord — I will always lead Your servants astray as long as their souls are in their bodies.' Then God said, 'I swear by My greatness, My might, and My sublime eminence — I will always forgive My servants as long as they ask My pardon.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى جَعَلَ بِالْمَغْرِبِ بَابًا عَرْضُهُ مَسِيرَةُ سَبْعِينَ عَامًا لِلتَّوْبَةِ لَا يُغْلَقُ مَا لم تطلع عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: (يَوْمَ يَأْتِي بَعْضُ آيَاتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنْفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَانُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ آمَنَتْ مِنْ قبل)
units.en: Safwan-bin-Assal. A. G. s. "Verily God has made a door in the west, the breadth of which is seventy years' journey, for repentance; which will not be shut so long as the sun rises not in the west."
units.en2: Ṣafwān ibn ʿAssāl narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God has made a door in the west, seventy years' journey wide, for repentance; it will not be shut until the sun rises in the west."

units.ar: وَعَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا تَنْقَطِعُ الْهِجْرَةُ حَتَّى يَنْقَطِع التَّوْبَةُ وَلَا تَنْقَطِعُ التَّوْبَةُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا»
units.en: Muaviah. A. G. s. "Flight from sin towards repentance shall not be cut off, until the sun rises in the west."
units.en2: Muʿāwiya narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Migration will not be cut off until repentance is cut off; and repentance will not be cut off until the sun rises in the west."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ كَانَا فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُتَحَابَّيْنِ أَحدهمَا مُجْتَهد لِلْعِبَادَةِ وَالْآخَرُ يَقُولُ: مُذْنِبٌ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ: أَقْصِرْ عَمَّا أَنْتَ فِيهِ فَيَقُولُ خَلِّنِي وَرَبِّي حَتَّى وَجَدَهُ يَوْمًا عَلَى ذَنْبٍ اسْتَعْظَمَهُ فَقَالَ: أَقْصِرْ فَقَالَ: خَلِّنِي وَرَبِّيَ أَبُعِثْتَ عَلَيَّ رَقِيبًا؟ فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَا يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكَ أَبَدًا وَلَا يُدْخِلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِمَا مَلَكًا فَقَبَضَ أَرْوَاحَهُمَا فَاجْتَمَعَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لِلْمُذْنِبِ: ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ بِرَحْمَتِي وَقَالَ لِلْآخَرِ: أَتَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَحْظِرَ عَلَى عَبْدِي رَحْمَتِي؟ فَقَالَ: لَا يَا رَبِّ قَالَ: اذْهَبُوا بِهِ إِلَى النَّار "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily there were two men of the children of Israel, who had a friendship for each other; one of them laboured in adoration, and the other was a sinner; and the adorer said to the sinner, return from sinning. He said, leave me to my cherisher. At length he found him committing a very great sin, and said, return from sinning. The sinner said, leave me to my cherisher; were you sent as a guard over me? The adorer said, I swear by God, he will not forgive your faults always, and will not bring you into paradise. Then God sent an angel to them, who took both their souls; and they were near God together; and God said to the sinner, come into paradise; and to the other, can you prevent my compassion on my servant? He said, I cannot, O my defender! God said to the angels, carry him towards the fire."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There were two men of the children of Israel who were friends: one laboured in worship and the other was a sinner. The worshipper said to the sinner, 'Turn from sinning.' He said, 'Leave me to my Lord.' At length he found him committing a very great sin and said, 'Turn from sinning.' The sinner said, 'Leave me to my Lord — were you sent as a guard over me?' The worshipper said, 'By God, He will not always forgive your faults, and will not bring you into Paradise.' Then God sent an angel who took both their souls, and they stood together before God; and God said to the sinner, 'Enter Paradise'; and to the other, 'Can you bar My compassion from My servant?' He said, 'I cannot, O my Protector!' God said to the angels, 'Take him toward the Fire.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم يقْرَأ: (يَا عبَادي الَّذِي أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا) وَلَا يُبَالِي
units.en: Asma'a-bint-Yezid said, "I heard the Prophet repeating this revelation: O my servants! those who injure themselves, from committing faults, shall not be hopeless of God's mercy; verily, God pardons all faults, and has no fear."
units.en2: Asmāʾ bint Yazīd narrates: I heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting this revelation: "O My servants who have injured themselves by committing faults — do not despair of God's mercy; truly, God pardons all faults."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ ضَالٌّ إِلَّا مَنْ هَدَيْتُ فَاسْأَلُونِي الْهُدَى أَهْدِكُمْ وَكُلُّكُمْ فُقَرَاءُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَغْنَيْتُ فَاسْأَلُونِي أُرْزَقْكُمْ وَكُلُّكُمْ مُذْنِبٌ إِلَّا مَنْ عَافَيْتُ فَمَنْ عَلِمَ مِنْكُمْ أَنِّي ذُو قُدْرَةٍ عَلَى الْمَغْفِرَةِ فَاسْتَغْفَرَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَهُ وَلَا أُبَالِي وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَحَيَّكُمْ وَمَيِّتَكُمْ وَرَطْبَكُمْ وَيَابِسَكُمُ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَى أَتْقَى قَلْبِ عَبْدٍ مِنْ عبَادي مَا زَاد فِي ملكي جنَاح بعوضةولو أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَحَيَّكُمْ وَمَيِّتَكُمْ وَرَطْبَكُمْ وَيَابِسَكُمُ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَى أَشْقَى قَلْبِ عَبْدٍ مِنْ عِبَادِي مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ مُلْكِي جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ. وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَحَيَّكُمْ وَمَيِّتَكُمْ وَرَطْبَكُمْ وَيَابِسَكُمُ اجْتَمَعُوا فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَسَأَلَ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْكُمْ مَا بَلَغَتْ أُمْنِيَّتُهُ فَأَعْطَيْتُ كُلَّ سَائِلٍ مِنْكُمْ مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ مُلْكِي إِلَّا كَمَا لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ مَرَّ بِالْبَحْرِ فَغَمَسَ فِيهِ إِبْرَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا ذَلِكَ بِأَنِّي جَوَادٌ مَاجِدٌ أَفْعَلُ مَا أُرِيدُ عَطَائِي كَلَامٌ وَعَذَابِي كَلَامٌ إِنَّمَا أَمْرِي لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ لَهُ (كُنْ فَيَكُونُ)
units.en: Abu Dhar Ghaffari. A. G. s. God says, "O my servants! you have all strayed, except him to whom I shew the road; then ask of me the straight road, that I may shew it you: and all are poor, except him whom I have made rich: then ask from me, that I may give you daily bread; and you are all sinners, except him whom I save from sinning: then he who knows that I am the Lord of power on pardoning sins, then asks me for pardon, that I may forgive him; and have no fear. Then if the whole of my servants be abstinent, they will not increase in my reign the wing of a gnat; and if all servants be sinners, it will not diminish in my reign the wing of a gnat; and if all my servants were assembled on one plain, and every man of you supplicated a thing to the utmost of his wishes, I would give him whatever he asked; this giving would not decrease any thing in my reign, but as much as the water of a river would be diminished, if one of you passed through that river and dipped a needle into it, after that took it up, with the quantity of water that would be upon it. Verily I am a giver, and a great giver; I do whatever I wish; my giving is a word, and my punishment a word; my order is not for a thing when I wish it, otherwise than my saying be, and it is."
units.en2: Abū Dharr al-Ghifārī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: God says, "O My servants! You have all strayed except the one I have shown the road — so ask Me for the straight road and I will show it you; and you are all poor except the one I have made rich — so ask of Me and I will give you your daily bread; and you are all sinners except the one I save from sinning — so whoever knows that I am the Lord of power to pardon sins, let him ask My pardon and I will forgive him, and I do not mind. If the whole of My servants were pious, they would not increase My kingdom by a gnat's wing; and if all My servants were sinners, they would not diminish My kingdom by a gnat's wing; and if all My servants assembled on one plain and every man supplicated a thing to the utmost of his wishes, and I gave each whatever he asked, that giving would not decrease anything of My kingdom except as much as the water of a river is diminished if one of you passed through it, dipped a needle, and drew it out — the quantity upon it. Truly I am a giver, a great giver; I do whatever I will; My giving is a word, and My punishment a word; My command for a thing when I will it is only that I say 'Be,' and it is."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ (هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَة) قَالَ: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ أَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أُتَّقَى فَمَنِ اتَّقَانِي فَأَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أَغْفِرَ لَهُ "
units.en: Anas relates, that his highness repeated this revelation: "God is endowed with continence, and possessed of pardon." Then the Prophet explained the meaning of this revelation: "your cherisher said, I am worthy of those that abstain from my punishment: then he who fears me, and abstains from my punishment, it is fit for me to pardon him."
units.en2: Anas relates that the Prophet ﷺ recited this revelation — "He is worthy of being feared, and worthy of forgiveness" — and the Prophet explained its meaning: "Your Lord said: I am worthy to be feared; so whoever fears Me and abstains from My punishment — it is fitting that I should pardon him."

units.ar: وَعَن ابْن عمر قَالَ: إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَعُدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ يَقُولُ: «رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ» مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "verily we counted the Prophet's saying in an assembly, O Lord! pardon us and accept our repentance; verily thou art the approver of repentance, and pardoner, a hundred times."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar said: "We counted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying in one assembly, 'O Lord! Pardon me and accept my repentance; truly You are the Accepter of repentance, the Pardoner' — a hundred times."

units.ar: وَعَن بِلَال بن يسَار بن زيدٍ مَوْلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ جَدِّي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: " مَنْ قَالَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ "
units.en: Bilal-bin-Yesar relates from his forefathers, I heard the Prophet say, "he who says, I wish for God's forgiveness, that God besides whom there is no other God; he is alive, and the lives of others are from him, God shall pardon his faults, although he may have run away from fighting with infidels."
units.en2: Bilāl ibn Yasār relates from his father: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "Whoever says, 'I ask God's forgiveness — God, besides whom there is no other god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him,' God shall pardon his faults, even if he had fled from the battle."

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَيَرْفَعُ الدَّرَجَةَ لِلْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَيَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ أَنَّى لِي هَذِهِ؟ فَيَقُولُ: باستغفار ولدك لَك "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily, God most certainly exalts the degree of a virtuous servant in paradise; and the virtuous servant says, O my patron: from whence is this exalted degree for me?" God says, "it is on account of your children asking pardon for you."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God most certainly exalts the degree of a virtuous servant in Paradise, and the servant says, 'O my Lord — whence is this exalted degree for me?' God says, 'It is on account of your children asking pardon for you.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا الْمَيِّتُ فِي الْقَبْرِ إِلَّا كَالْغَرِيقِ الْمُتَغَوِّثِ يَنْتَظِرُ دَعْوَةً تَلْحَقُهُ مِنْ أَبٍ أَوْ أُمٍّ أَوْ أَخٍ أَوْ صَدِيقٍ فَإِذَا لَحِقَتْهُ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لَيُدْخِلُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقُبُورِ مِنْ دُعَاءِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ أَمْثَالَ الْجِبَالِ وَإِنَّ هَدِيَّةَ الْأَحْيَاءِ إِلَى الْأَمْوَاتِ الِاسْتِغْفَارُ لَهُمْ»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Abbas. A. G. s. "There is no dead in the grave, but is like a person over his head in water, and calls to somebody to take him by the hand; has hope that his father or mother will pray for him, or his brother or friend; then when the prayer reaches the dead, it is more loved by him than the world, and any thing in it; and verily God most certainly gives to the dead (on account of the prayers of the people of the earth) rewards like mountains; and verily the presents of the living to the dead, is asking forgiveness for them."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Every dead person in the grave is like one sunk over his head in water, calling out for someone to take him by the hand — hoping his father or mother will pray for him, or his brother or friend; and when the prayer reaches the dead, it is dearer to him than the world and all that is in it. God most certainly gives the dead, on account of the prayers of the people of the earth, rewards like mountains; and the present of the living to the dead is asking forgiveness for them."

units.ar: وَعَن عبد الله بن يسر قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «طُوبَى لِمَنْ وَجَدَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ اسْتِغْفَارًا كَثِيرًا» . رَوَاهُ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ وَرَوَى النَّسَائِيُّ فِي «عملِ يَوْم وَلَيْلَة»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Bushr. A. G. s. "Joy be to him, who has asked much pardon in the day and night."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Yusr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Joy to him who finds much asking of pardon in his record."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الَّذِينَ إِذا أحْسَنوا استبشَروا وإِذا أساؤوا اسْتَغْفَرُوا»
units.en: Aayeshah relates, that his highness used to repeat this supplication: "O Lord! make me of those who are glad, when they do good, and when they do wrong, ask forgiveness."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha relates that the Prophet ﷺ used to repeat this supplication: "O Allah! Make me of those who rejoice when they do good, and when they do wrong, ask forgiveness."

units.ar: وَعَن الْحَارِث بن سُويَدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ حَدِيثَيْنِ: أحدُهما عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالْآخِرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَأَنَّهُ قَاعِدٌ تَحْتَ جَبَلٍ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّ الْفَاجِرَ يَرَى ذُنُوبَهُ كَذُبَابٍ مَرَّ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ فَقَالَ بِهِ هَكَذَا أَيْ بِيَدِهِ فَذَبَّهُ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم يَقُول: " لَلَّهُ أَفْرَحُ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ نَزَلَ فِي أَرْضٍ دَوِيَّةٍ مَهْلَكَةٍ مَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ عَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ نَوْمَةً فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ رَاحِلَتُهُ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرُّ وَالْعَطَشُ أَوْ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَالَ: أَرْجِعُ إِلَى مَكَانِي الَّذِي كُنْتُ فِيهِ فَأَنَامُ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى سَاعِدِهِ لِيَمُوتَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ فَإِذَا رَاحِلَتُهُ عِنْدَهُ عَلَيْهَا زَادُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ الْعَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ هَذَا بِرَاحِلَتِهِ وَزَادِهِ ". رَوَى مُسْلِمٌ الْمَرْفُوع إِلَى رَسُول صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْهُ فَحَسْبُ وَرَوَى البُخَارِيّ الموقوفَ على ابنِ مَسْعُود أَيْضا
units.en: Harith-bin-Suwaid said, "Abdullah-bin-Masu'ud related two traditions to me; one of them from the Prophet himself, and the other from himself; which is this: verily a Momin sees his own faults, whether great or small like mountains, and sees himself, as if he were sitting under a hill, he fears its falling upon him: and verily, a wicked man sees his wickedness, like a fly that has passed over his nose, and he has driven it away." After that Ibn Mas'ud said, "I heard the Prophet of God say, verily God is gladder at the repentance of his servant, a Momin, than a man in a desart (which is a place of destruction) who had a riding camel with him, and on it his water and food, and the man lay down to sleep, and awoke when his camel had run away; and he sought him until oppressed with heat and thirst, and said, I will return to the place in which I was, and go to sleep till I die: then he laid his head upon his arm to die, and awoke, and unexpectedly saw his camel ready near him, with victuals and drink. Then God is happier than this man at finding his camel with his food and water."
units.en2: Al-Ḥārith ibn Suwayd said: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd related two traditions to me — one from the Prophet ﷺ himself and one from himself. His own: "The believer sees his own faults, great or small, as mountains, and sees himself as if sitting beneath a hill, fearing it will fall upon him; and the wicked man sees his wickedness as a fly that passed over his nose, which he has driven away." Then Ibn Masʿūd said: I heard the Prophet of God ﷺ say: "God is gladder at the repentance of His believing servant than a man in a desert — a place of destruction — who had a riding camel carrying his water and food: the man lay down to sleep and awoke to find his camel had run away; he sought it until oppressed by heat and thirst, then said, 'I will return to the place where I was and sleep until I die'; he laid his head on his arm to die, then awoke — and there was his camel standing ready beside him, with his food and drink. God is happier than this man at finding his camel with his food and water."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ المؤمنَ المفتَّنَ التوَّابَ»
units.en: Ali-ibn-Abu't'alib. A. G. s. "Verily God befriends a Musleman servant, who has sinned and repented."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God loves the believing servant who is sorely tried and ever repentant."

units.ar: وَعَنْ ثَوْبَانَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي الدُّنْيَا بِهَذِهِ الْآيَةِ (يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرفُوا على أنْفُسِهم لَا تَقْنَطوا) الْآيَةَ» فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: فَمَنْ أَشْرَكَ؟ فَسَكَتَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أَلا وَمن أشرَكَ» ثَلَاث مرَّاتٍ
units.en: Thawban. A. G. s. "I would not value having the whole wealth of the world in the place of this revelation: Say, O Muhammed! O my servants those who have oppressed their own souls shall not be hopeless of the mercy of God." A man said, "what is the condition of him who has associated any thing with God?" The Prophet remained silent; after that he said, "know that God forgives him also; but on repentance." This he repeated thrice.
units.en2: Thawbān narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I would not weigh the whole wealth of the world against this revelation: 'Say, O Muhammad: O My servants who have oppressed their own souls — do not despair of the mercy of God.'" A man said, "What of him who has associated partners with God?" The Prophet remained silent; then he said, "Know that God forgives him also — but upon repentance." This he repeated three times.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لَيَغْفِرُ لِعَبْدِهِ مَا لَمْ يَقَعِ الْحِجَابُ» . قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا الْحِجَابُ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ تَمُوتَ النَّفْسُ وَهِيَ مُشْرِكَةٌ» رَوَى الْأَحَادِيثَ الثَّلَاثَةَ أَحْمَدُ وَرَوَى الْبَيْهَقِيُّ الْأَخِيرَ فِي كِتَابِ الْبَعْثُ والنشور
units.en: Abu Dhar Ghaffari. A. G. s. "Verily God pardons his servant, as long as a veil is not between him and God's mercy." The companions said, "what is a veil, O Prophet?" He said, "it is this, that a servant dies whilst associating any thing with God."
units.en2: Abū Dharr al-Ghifārī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God pardons His servant as long as no veil stands between him and God's mercy." The Companions said, "What is the veil, O Prophet?" He said, "It is that a servant dies while associating partners with God."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْدِلُ بِهِ شَيْئًا فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ جِبَالٍ ذُنُوبٌ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ»
units.en: Abu Dhar Ghaffari. A. G. s. "He who comes before God in futurity, not having associated any thing with him whilst in the world, and shall have sins like mountains upon him, God forgives them."
units.en2: Abū Dharr al-Ghifārī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever comes before God in the hereafter having associated nothing with Him in the world, though he bear sins like mountains — God forgives them."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «التَّائِبَ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ» وَفِي (شَرْحِ السُّنَّةِ) رَوَى عَنْهُ مَوْقُوفًا قَالَ: النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةٌ والتَّائبُ كمن لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Masu'ud. A. G. s. "A repenter of faults, is like him who has committed none."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The one who repents of his faults is like the one who committed none."

sections.heading: On the Abundance of God's Mercy (Matthews, Book X, Ch. IV)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter IV of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 563-567. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on the breadth of God's mercy; Matthews prints a selection of them (reports 2364-2380 of 2364-2415).

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ كِتَابًا فَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ عَرْشِهِ: إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي سَبَقَتْ غَضَبِي «. وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ» غَلَبَتْ غَضَبي "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "When God created the creation, he wrote a book, which is near him upon the imperial throne; and what is written in it is this: verily my compassion overcomes my anger."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When God decreed creation, He wrote a book, which is with Him above the Throne; and written in it is this: 'My mercy precedes My anger.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: «إِنَّ للَّهِ مائةَ رَحْمَةٍ أَنْزَلَ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ وَالْهَوَامِّ فَبِهَا يَتَعَاطَفُونَ وَبِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُونَ وَبِهَا تَعْطُفُ الْوَحْشُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَأَخَّرَ اللَّهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً يَرْحَمُ بِهَا عِبَادَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَة»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Verily for God are one hundred mercies: one of which he has sent down amongst man and the Genii, amongst quadrupeds and every moving thing upon the face of the earth: then by it they are kind to each other, and forgive one another; and by it the animals of the wilds are kind to their young; and God has reserved ninety-nine favors, by which he will be gracious to his servants, on the day of resurrection."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God has a hundred mercies: one of them He sent down among mankind and jinn, beasts and every moving thing on the face of the earth — by it they are kind to one another and forgive one another, and by it the wild animals are kind to their young; and God has reserved ninety-nine mercies by which He will be gracious to His servants on the Day of Resurrection."

units.ar: وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِمُسْلِمٍ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ نَحْوُهُ وَفِي آخِرِهِ قَالَ: «فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْمَلَهَا بِهَذِهِ الرَّحْمَة»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "If a Momin knew anything of God's punishments, he would not hope for paradise; and if an infidel knew any thing of God's compassion, he would not be hopeless of his paradise, not one of them; that is, if true believers could imagine God's resentment, not one of them could hope for paradise, and if infidels look on his mercies they may not be hopeless of paradise."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If a believer knew the full measure of God's punishments, he would not hope for Paradise; and if an unbeliever knew the full measure of God's compassion, he would not despair of His Paradise — that is, if true believers could conceive God's resentment, not one of them could hope for Paradise; and if unbelievers beheld His mercy, none of them would despair of Paradise."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْعُقُوبَةِ مَا طَمِعَ بِجَنَّتِهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَوْ يُعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ مَا قَنَطَ من جنته أحد»
units.en: Ibn Masu'ud. A. G. s. "Paradise is nearer to one of you than the thongs of your shoes; and hell is like it: that is, he who has done a good act, paradise is near to him, and he who has done a bad thing, hell is near unto him."
units.en2: Ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Paradise is nearer to one of you than the thong of his shoe, and Hell is like it — that is, whoever does a good deed, Paradise is near him, and whoever does an evil thing, Hell is near him."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الْجَنَّةُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ وَالنَّارُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "A man said (who had never done a good act) to his family, (and in one tradition it is this, that a man injured himself, and sinned beyond bounds; and when dying said to his sons,) when I am dead, burn me, and throw one half of my ashes into the river, and the other into the desert; and said, I swear by God, if he orders me to be punished, verily I shall be punished in a way in which no one of the creation ever was, or will be. Then, when the man died, his family or sons did as he ordered them: and God ordered the river, which collected every part of his ashes; and he ordered the desart, which collected every part of his ashes in it. After that, God said to the man, after giving him life; what did you make this bequest for? He said, for fear of your punishment, O God! and you knew best my condition, which was full of sins. Then God pardoned him."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man who had never done a good deed said to his family — and in one narration, a man had injured himself and sinned beyond bounds, and when dying said to his sons — 'When I am dead, burn me, and throw half of my ashes into the river and half into the desert'; and he said, 'By God, if He orders me to be punished, I shall be punished as no one in creation ever was or will be.' When the man died, his family did as he had ordered; and God ordered the river, and it collected every part of his ashes, and He ordered the desert, and it collected every part of his ashes in it. Then God said to the man, after giving him life: 'Why did you make this bequest?' He said, 'For fear of Your punishment, O God — and You knew best my condition, full of sins.' Then God pardoned him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: " قَالَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ لِأَهْلِهِ وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ أَسْرَفَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ أَوْصَى بَنِيهِ إِذَا مَاتَ فَحَرِّقُوهُ ثُمَّ اذْرُوا نِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَنِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ فو الله لَئِنْ قَدَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ لَيُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا لَا يُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ فَعَلُوا مَا أَمَرَهُمْ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَحْرَ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ وَأَمَرَ الْبَرَّ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ: لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا؟ قَالَ: مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ "
units.en: Omer Ibn-al-Khattab said, "some captives were brought before the Prophet; and lo! one of the women's breasts were full of milk, in such a manner that they run in streams, when she was running about looking for her child: and when she found a child amongst the captives, she took it, with the lovingness of her own child, and pressed it to her breast, and gave it milk. Then the Prophet said, do you suppose that this woman will cast her own child into the fire? We said, no. His highness said, verily God is more compassionate on his servants, than this woman on her own child."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: Some captives were brought before the Prophet ﷺ, and there was a woman whose breasts were full of milk, running about looking for her child; and when she found a child among the captives, she took it with the love of her own child, pressed it to her breast, and gave it milk. The Prophet said: "Do you suppose this woman would cast her own child into the fire?" We said, "No." He said: "God is more compassionate to His servants than this woman to her own child."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ: قَدِمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَبْيٌ فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ السَّبْيِ قَدْ تَحَلَّبَ ثديُها تسْعَى إِذا وَجَدَتْ صَبِيًّا فِي السَّبْيِ أَخَذَتْهُ فَأَلْصَقَتْهُ بِبَطْنِهَا وَأَرْضَعَتْهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَتُرَوْنَ هَذِهِ طَارِحَةً وَلَدَهَا فِي النَّارِ؟» فَقُلْنَا: لَا وَهِيَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ لَا تَطْرَحَهُ فَقَالَ: «لَلَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ بِوَلَدِها»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "The actions of no one of you ever redeem you, but redemption is on the compassion of God." The companions said (in the way of a question) "do you also, O Prophet! not get redemption from your own actions?" He said, "I also, unless that God covers me with his compassion; therefore let your actions be upright, and observe a medium, and act morning and evening, and something in the night, so that you may reach your desires."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The actions of none of you ever redeem you — redemption is by the compassion of God." The Companions asked, "Do you too, O Prophet, not win redemption by your own actions?" He said: "I too — unless God covers me with His compassion. So let your actions be upright, keep the middle way, act morning and evening and something of the night, so that you may reach your desires."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَنْ يُنْجِيَ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ» قَالُوا: وَلَا أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «وَلَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ فَسَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا واغْدُوا وروحوا وشيءٌ من الدُّلْجَةِ والقَصدَ القصدَ تبلغوا»
units.en: Ja'bir. A. G. s. "The actions of no one of you bring you into paradise, nor free you from hell fire; neither do I enter into paradise, nor become free from hell, but by the compassion of God."
units.en2: Jābir narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The actions of none of you bring you into Paradise, nor free you from the Fire; nor do I enter Paradise or become free from Hell except by the compassion of God."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِذَا أَسْلَمَ الْعَبْدُ فَحَسُنَ إِسْلَامُهُ يُكَفِّرُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ كَانَ زَلَفَهَا وَكَانَ بَعْدَ الْقِصَاصِ: الْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَالسَّيِّئَةُ بِمِثْلِهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَجَاوَزَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا "
units.en: Abu-Sa'id Khudhri. A. G. s. "When a man is brought to Islam, and he performs it well, God covers all his former faults; after which he gets ten rewards for every good act, to seven hundred, and also more than that; whereas the reward of misdeeds is as one to one; unless, God passes that over likewise."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a man is brought to Islam and performs it well, God covers all his former faults; after that he gets ten rewards for every good deed, up to seven hundred, and more than that; whereas the reward of misdeeds is one for one — unless God passes that over likewise."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الحسناتِ والسيِّئاتِ: فَمَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لهُ عندَهُ حَسَنَة كَامِلَة فَإِن هم بعملها كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ عِنْدَهُ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَمَنْ هَمَّ بسيئة فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كَتَبَهَا اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حَسَنَةً كَامِلَةً فَإِن هُوَ هم بعملها كتبهَا الله لَهُ سَيِّئَة وَاحِدَة "الْفَصْل الثَّانِي
units.en: Ibn Abbas. A. G. s. "Verily, God wrote the good acts and the bad ones; therefore, he who intends the good, and does not practice them, God writes them as perfect good; and, if he intends good, and puts it into practice, God writes for him, near himself, ten good acts to seven hundred, and also more than that; and he who intends evil, and has not done it, God writes perfect good for; but if he has intended bad, and done it, God writes one evil act for each."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "God wrote the good deeds and the bad ones: whoever intends a good deed and does not do it, God writes it as a perfect good deed; and if he intends good and does it, God writes for him, near Himself, ten good deeds up to seven hundred, and more than that; and whoever intends evil and does not do it, God writes a perfect good deed for him; but if he has intended evil and done it, God writes one evil deed for each."

units.ar: [12] عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ مَثَلَ الَّذِي يعْمل السَّيئَة ثُمَّ يَعْمَلُ الْحَسَنَاتِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ دِرْعٌ ضَيِّقَةٌ قَدْ خَنَقَتْهُ ثُمَّ عَمِلَ حَسَنَةً فَانْفَكَّتْ حَلْقَةٌ ثُمَّ عَمِلَ أُخْرَى فَانْفَكَّتْ أُخْرَى حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ»
units.en: Ukbah-bin-Aamir. A. G. s. "Verily the condition of that person who does evil, and after that, good deeds, is like the condition of a man with tight armour, which has vexed him; after that, has done a good deed, then the rings of the armour become open: after that, has done another good act, so that the armour falls from his body."
units.en2: ʿUqba ibn ʿĀmir narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The condition of one who does evil, and after that good deeds, is like a man in tight armour that has vexed him: he does a good deed, and the rings of the armour open; then he does another good deed, and the armour falls from his body."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُول: (ولِمنْ خافَ مقامَ رَبِّهِ جنَّتانِ) قُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ؟ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ الثَّانِيَةَ: (وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جنَّتان) فقلتُ الثانيةَ: وإِنْ زنى وسرق؟ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ الثَّالِثَةَ: (وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ) فَقُلْتُ الثَّالِثَةَ: وَإِنْ زَنَى وسرق؟ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أبي الدَّرْدَاء»
units.en: Abu Dard'aa said, "I heard the Prophet giving advice on the pulpit, and he said, for him who fears God are two paradises." I said, in the way of question, "although he commits adultery and steals, O Prophet of God?" He said the same a second time; and I said a second time, "although he commits adultery and steals?" He repeated the same a third time, and I said a third time, "although he commits adultery and steals;" The Prophet said, "yes, although you think it bad."
units.en2: Abū al-Dardāʾ narrates: I heard the Prophet ﷺ giving counsel on the pulpit, and he said, "For him who fears God are two paradises." I asked, "Even if he commits adultery and steals, O Prophet of God?" He said the same a second time, and I asked again, "Even if he commits adultery and steals?" He repeated it a third time, and I asked a third time, "Even if he commits adultery and steals?" The Prophet said, "Yes — even though you think ill of it."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَامِرٍ الرَّامِ قَالَ: بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَهُ يَعْنِي عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذْ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ كِسَاءٌ وَفِي يَدِهِ شَيْءٌ قَدِ الْتَفَّ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَرَرْتُ بَغِيضَةِ شَجَرٍ فَسَمِعْتُ فِيهَا أَصْوَاتَ فِرَاخِ طَائِرٍ فَأَخَذْتُهُنَّ فَوَضَعْتُهُنَّ فِي كِسَائِي فَجَاءَتْ أُمُّهُنَّ فَاسْتَدَارَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِي فَكَشَفْتُ لَهَا عَنْهُنَّ فَوَقَعَتْ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَلَفَفْتُهُنَّ بِكِسَائِي فَهُنَّ أُولَاءِ مَعِي قَالَ: «ضَعْهُنَّ» فَوَضَعْتُهُنَّ وَأَبَتْ أُمُّهُنَّ إِلَّا لُزُومَهُنَّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " أتعجبون لرحم أم الْفِرَاخ فراخها؟ فو الَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ: لَلَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ أُمِّ الْفِرَاخ بِفِرَاخِهَا ارْجِعْ بِهِنَّ حَتَّى تَضَعَهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهُنَّ وَأُمُّهُنَّ مَعَهُنَّ ". فَرَجَعَ بِهِنَّ
units.en: Amir-ar-Ram said, "while I was sitting near the Prophet, a man came before him with a carpet upon him, and a thing in his hand covered with the carpet; and he said, O Prophet! I passed through a forest of trees, and heard the voices of the young of birds; and I took them, and put them into my carpet; and their mother came flying around my head, and I uncovered the young, and the mother fell down upon them, then I wrapped them up in my carpet; and there are the young which I have." Then the Prophet said, "put them down," which I did, when their mother joined them: and the Prophet said, "do you wonder at the affection of the mother for her young? I swear by him who has sent me on truth, verily God is more affectionate to his servants, than the mother of these young to them. Return them into the place from whence you took them, and let their mother be with them." The man returned them.
units.en2: ʿĀmir al-Rām narrates: While I was sitting near the Prophet ﷺ, a man came before him with a cloth over him and something in his hand covered with the cloth. He said, "O Prophet! I passed through a stand of trees and heard the voices of young birds; I took them and put them in my cloth; their mother came flying around my head; I uncovered the young and the mother fell down upon them; then I wrapped them up in my cloth — and here are the young ones." The Prophet said, "Put them down" — I did, and their mother joined them. The Prophet said, "Do you wonder at the affection of the mother for her young? I swear by Him who sent me with the truth — God is more affectionate to His servants than the mother of these young ones is to them. Return them to the place you took them from, and let their mother be with them." The man returned them.

units.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَعْضِ غَزَوَاتِهِ فَمَرَّ بِقَوْمٍ فَقَالَ: «مَنِ الْقَوْمُ؟» قَالُوا: نَحْنُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَامْرَأَةٌ تَحْضِبُ بِقِدْرِهَا وَمَعَهَا ابْنٌ لَهَا فَإِذَا ارْتَفَعَ وَهَجٌ تَنَحَّتْ بِهِ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» قَالَتْ: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ؟ قَالَ: «بَلَى» قَالَتْ: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ أَرْحَمَ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنَ الْأُم على وَلَدهَا؟ قَالَ: «بَلَى» قَالَتْ: إِنَّ الْأُمَّ لَا تُلْقِي وَلَدَهَا فِي النَّارِ فَأَكَبَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَبْكِي ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَيْهَا فَقَالَ: " إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُعَذِّبُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِلَّا الْمَارِدَ الْمُتَمَرِّدَ الَّذِي يَتَمَرَّدُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله "
units.en: Abdullah-ibn-Omer said, "we were with the Prophet, in some of his wars with the infidels, and he passed by a crowd, and said, who are they? They said, we are Muslemans. And a woman was lighting a fire under her pot; and she had a son with her, and when the fire burnt up, and got hot, she put her son away from it, that he might not be hurt by it. Then the woman came to the Prophet, and asked, are you the Prophet of God? He said, yes, I am. And the woman said, (may my father and mother be sacrificed for you!) is not God the most affectionate of the affectionate? He said, yes. The woman said, is not God more affectionate to his servants than a mother to her child? He said, yes. The woman said, a mother does not throw her child into the fire; then how can God throw his servants into fire? Then the Prophet held down his head in tears; after that he raised it up towards the woman, and said, verily God punishes those that refuse to confess his unity."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar narrates: We were with the Prophet ﷺ on one of his expeditions against the unbelievers, and he passed by a crowd and said, "Who are they?" They said, "We are Muslims." And a woman was lighting a fire under her pot, with a son beside her, and when the fire blazed up and grew hot, she put her son away from it so he would not be hurt. Then the woman came to the Prophet and asked, "Are you the Prophet of God?" He said, "Yes, I am." The woman said — may my father and mother be sacrificed for you — "Is not God the most affectionate of the affectionate?" He said, "Yes." She said, "Is not God more affectionate to His servants than a mother to her child?" He said, "Yes." The woman said, "A mother does not throw her child into the fire — then how can God throw His servants into the fire?" Then the Prophet bowed his head in tears; after that he raised it toward the woman and said, "God punishes those who refuse to confess His unity."

units.ar: وَعَنْ ثَوْبَانَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَلْتَمِسُ مَرْضَاةَ اللَّهِ فَلَا يَزَالُ بِذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لجبريل: إِن فلَانا عَبدِي يتلمس أَنْ يُرْضِيَنِي أَلَا وَإِنَّ رَحْمَتِي عَلَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ جِبْرِيلُ: رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى فُلَانٍ وَيَقُولُهَا حَمَلَةُ العرشِ ويقولُها مَن حَولهمْ حَتَّى يَقُولُهَا أَهْلُ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ ثُمَّ تَهْبِطُ لَهُ إِلى الأَرْض "
units.en: Thawban relates, from the Prophet, "verily a servant wishes for the satisfaction of God; then, on that account, God always says to Gabriel, verily such a servant of mine wishes to please me; know verily my compassion is upon him." And Gabriel says, "God's compassion is upon such a servant;" and the bearers of the imperial throne say, "God's compassion is upon him," and all the angels that are around it, until all the people of the seven regions repeat the same. After that, compassion is brought down to the earth for him."
units.en2: Thawbān relates from the Prophet ﷺ: "When a servant wishes for God's good pleasure, on that account God says to Gabriel, 'Such a servant of Mine wishes to please Me — know that My compassion is upon him.' And Gabriel says, 'God's compassion is upon that servant'; and the bearers of the Throne say, 'God's compassion is upon him,' and all the angels around it, until all the people of the seven heavens repeat the same; and after that, compassion is brought down to the earth for him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: (فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سابقٌ بالخيراتَ) قَالَ: كُلُّهُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ "
units.en: Usamah-bin-Zaid relates, from the Prophet, in the word of God, "after that I gave a book of laws, to those that were selected from my servants; then some of these servants injure their own souls, and some of them observe a medium in their actions, and some of them are swift in goodness." The Prophet said, "all of them are in paradise, agreeable to their difference in eminence and degree."
units.en2: Usāma ibn Zayd relates from the Prophet ﷺ on God's word, "Then I gave the book as inheritance to those I selected from My servants: and some of them injure their own souls, some keep a middle course in their actions, and some are swift in goodness." The Prophet said: "All of them are in Paradise, according to their difference in rank and degree."

sections.heading: On What Should Be Said in the Morning, Evening, and Time of Sleep (Matthews, Book X, Ch. V)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter V of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 568-578. The reports correspond to the second half of the Mishkāt's chapter on the breadth of God's mercy and the chapter of supplications at set times (reports 2381-2415); Matthews omits the cross-reference notes 2383, 2388, 2394 and 2401.

units.ar: عَن عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ: «أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ» وَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ أَيْضًا: «أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ» . وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّار وَعَذَاب فِي الْقَبْر»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Masu'ud said, "the Prophet used, in the evening, to say, we have reached the night, and so have all other inhabitants of God's empire: praised be God; and there is no other God but God; one; to whom there is no partner; for him is dominion and praise, and he is powerful over all things: O Lord! I supplicate thee for the good of this night; and for every good that is in it; and I seek protection with thee, from the evils of this night, and from every evil that may be in it; O Lord verily, I seek protection with thee from sickness, from age and pride; and from the contentions and calamities of the world, and from the punishments of the grave." And when the Prophet reached the morning, he would repeat the same; but in place of "we have reached the night," he said, "we have reached the morning."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates: In the evening the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "We have reached the night, and so has all creation in God's kingdom; praise be to God; there is no god but God, One, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is powerful over all things. O Lord! I ask You for the good of this night and every good in it; and I seek Your protection from the evils of this night and every evil in it. O Lord, I seek Your protection from sickness, from old age and pride, from the strifes and calamities of the world, and from the punishments of the grave." And when the Prophet reached the morning, he would repeat the same, but in place of "we have reached the night" he said, "we have reached the morning."

units.ar: وَعَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا» . وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ: «الْحَمْدُ الله الَّذِي أَحْيَانًا بَعْدَمَا مَا أماتنا وَإِلَيْهِ النشور»
units.en: Hudhaifah said, when the Prophet went to his bed-chamber, at night, he would put his right hand under his cheek, and then would say, "O Lord! in thy name do I sleep and wake:" and when he awoke, he would say, "thanksgiving to God, who has awoke me after sleep, and towards him is the resurrection."
units.en2: Ḥudhayfa narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ went to his bed at night, he would put his right hand under his cheek and say, "O Lord! In Your name I sleep and wake"; and when he awoke he would say, "Thanks be to God, who has awoken me after sleep, and to Him is the resurrection."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أرفعه إِن أَمْسَكت نَفسِي فارحمهما وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ ". وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: " ثُمَّ لْيَضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الْأَيْمن ثمَّ ليقل: بِاسْمِك " وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «فَلْيَنْفُضْهُ بِصَنِفَةِ ثَوْبِهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَإِن أَمْسَكت نَفسِي فَاغْفِر لَهَا»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "When any one of you goes to his bed to sleep, he must first dust it with the end of his garment; because he does not know what may have fallen upon it, in his absence; after that, let him say this prayer: In thy name, O my patron! I have laid down my side; and in thy name, I raise it up: if thou take my soul, have mercy upon it, and if thou send it back, then guard it, even as thou guardest thy virtuous servants."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you goes to his bed to sleep, let him first dust it with the end of his garment, for he does not know what may have fallen on it in his absence; then let him say: 'In Your name, O my Lord, I have laid down my side, and in Your name I raise it up; if You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You send it back, then guard it as You guard Your virtuous servants.'"

units.ar: وَعَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ نَامَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الْأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفَسِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ» . وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنْ قَالَهُنَّ ثُمَّ مَاتَ تَحْتَ لَيْلَتِهِ مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ» وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِرَجُلٍ: " يَا فُلَانُ إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الْأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ قُلِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفَسِي إِلَيْكَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: أَرْسَلْتَ " وَقَالَ: «فَإِنْ مِتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ مِتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ وإِن أصبحتَ أصبتَ خيرا»
units.en: Bar'aa-ibn-Aa'zib said, "the Prophet used, when he went to his bed, to sleep upon his right side; after that would say, O Lord! I resigned my soul to thee, and turned to thee, and resigned my work to thee, and relied on thee, and sought protection in thee, on account of shewing my wish towards thee, and of fearing thee: there is no asylum or redemption from thy resentment but in thee: I believed in thy book, which thou didst send down, and Prophets which thou didst send; I mean, I believe in all the books and all the Prophets." And the Prophet said, "whoever repeats these words, and dies in the night in which he has repeated them, dies on the way of religion." (And in one tradition it is thus, that the Prophet said to a man, "O man! when you wish to go to sleep, then do your Wadi, the same as for prayers; after that, lie down upon your right side; and then repeat these words: and if you die in this night, you die on the way of Islám, and if you rise in the morning, you will get much good.")
units.en2: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ went to his bed, he used to lie on his right side and then say: "O Lord! I have surrendered my soul to You, turned to You, entrusted my affair to You, relied on You, and sought refuge in You, in longing for You and in fear of You; there is no refuge or escape from Your displeasure except in You. I believe in Your book which You sent down, and Your prophets whom You sent" — that is, I believe in all the books and all the prophets. And the Prophet said: "Whoever repeats these words and dies in the night in which he repeated them, dies on the way of religion." (And in one narration the Prophet said to a man: "O man! When you wish to sleep, perform your wudu as for prayers, then lie on your right side and repeat these words; and if you die that night, you die on the way of Islam; and if you rise in the morning, you will gain much good.")

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ قَالَ: «الحمدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أطعمنَا وَسَقَانَا وكفانا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مؤوي»
units.en: Anas said, "verily the Prophet would say, when he came to his bed; praise be to God, who has given us to eat, and to drink, and is sufficient for us; then there are a great many men who have no sponsors."
units.en2: Anas narrates that when the Prophet ﷺ came to his bed he would say: "Praise be to God, who has given us to eat and to drink, and is sufficient for us — while there are many men who have no sponsor and no shelter."

units.ar: وَعَن عَليّ: أَن فَاطِمَة أَنْت النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَشْكُو إِلَيْهِ مَا تَلْقَى فِي يَدِهَا مِنَ الرَّحَى وَبَلَغَهَا أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ رَقِيقٌ فَلَمْ تُصَادِفْهُ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِعَائِشَةَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ: فَجَاءَنَا وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا فَذَهَبْنَا نَقُومُ فَقَالَ: عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا فَجَاءَ فَقَعَدَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمِهِ عَلَى بَطْنِي فَقَالَ: «أَلَا أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَا؟ إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضْجَعَكُمَا فَسَبِّحَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَاحْمَدَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَكَبِّرَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ فَهُوَ خير لَكمَا من خَادِم»
units.en: Ali ibn Ab'u'talib relates, that Fatimah Zahr'a came to the Prophet's house, complaining of a pain she felt in her hand, from turning round a grinding stone: and it reached her that some prisoners had come to the Prophet from the wars; and Fatimah did not find the Prophet at home, and she mentioned her case to Aayeshah, saying, "tell it to his highness when he comes." Then, when the Prophet came home, Aayeshah informed him thereof: and when he heard it, Ali says, he came to us, when we had gone to our bed-chamber. Then we attempted to stand up, out of respect to his highness; and he said, "stay in your places." Then he sat himself down, between me and Fatimah, so that I felt the coolness of his highness' foot upon my belly. Then the Prophet said, "shall I not shew you a better road than that which you asked? When you go to your place of sleep, then say 'immaculate God!' thirty-three times; and 'all praise be to God,' thirty-three times; and 'great God,' thirty-four times; then these words are better for you than the servant which you wished for."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib relates that Fāṭima came to the Prophet's ﷺ house complaining of a pain in her hand from turning the grinding-stone, and it had reached her that captives from the wars had come to the Prophet; she did not find the Prophet at home, and she told her case to ʿĀʾisha, saying, "Tell it to him when he comes." When the Prophet came home, ʿĀʾisha informed him; and when he heard it, ʿAlī says, he came to us when we had gone to our bed. We tried to stand up out of respect, and he said, "Stay in your places." Then he sat down between me and Fāṭima, so that I felt the coolness of his foot upon my belly. Then the Prophet said: "Shall I not show you something better than what you asked? When you go to your bed, say 'Glory be to God' thirty-three times, 'All praise be to God' thirty-three times, and 'God is greatest' thirty-four times — these words are better for you than the servant you wished for."

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ» . وَإِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "when the Prophet rose in the morning, he would say, O Lord! in thy name I have reached the morning; and in thy name have reached the evening, and in thy name do I live, and in thy name will I die; and to thee is return." And when he reached the evening, he would say, "O Lord! in thy name have I reached the evening, and in thy name have I reached the morning, and to thee is the rising from the dead."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ rose in the morning, he would say, "O Lord! In Your name I have reached the morning, and in Your name I reach the evening; in Your name I live, and in Your name I die; and to You is the return." And when he reached the evening, he would say, "O Lord! In Your name I have reached the evening, and in Your name I reach the morning; and to You is the rising from the dead."

units.ar: وَعنهُ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَقُولُهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتُ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتُ قَالَ: «قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ قُلْهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ وَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مضجعك»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, that Abu-Bakr said, I said, "O messenger of God! order me a prayer to say morning and evening." He said, say, "O God! the knower of the hidden and the open, the present and the absent, the creator of the regions and the earths, and the cherisher of every thing; the master and king of all; I give evidence that there is no God but thee; I seek protection with thee from the badness of myself, and from the badness of the devil." Say this, morning and evening, and at bed time.
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that Abū Bakr said: I said, "O Messenger of God! Command me a prayer to say morning and evening." He said, say: "O God! Knower of the hidden and the open, the present and the absent, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Cherisher of everything, Master and King of all — I bear witness that there is no god but You; I seek Your protection from the evil of myself and from the evil of the devil." Say this morning and evening and at bedtime.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَقُولُ فِي صَبَاحِ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَمَسَاءِ كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَيَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ» . فَكَانَ أَبَانُ قَدْ أَصَابَهُ طَرَفُ فَالَجٍ فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبَانُ: مَا تَنْظُرُ إِلَيَّ؟ أَمَا إِنَّ الْحَدِيثَ كَمَا حَدَّثْتُكَ وَلَكِنِّي لَمْ أَقُلْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِيُمْضِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ قَدَرَهُ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَابْن مَاجَه وَأَبُو دَاوُد وَفِي رِوَايَته: «لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فُجَاءَةُ بَلَاءٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ فُجَاءَةُ بَلَاءٍ حَتَّى يُمسيَ»
units.en: Aban said, that he heard his father say, that the Prophet said, "whoever shall, in the morning of every day, and in the evening of every day, say these words three times, I have reached the morning and the evening, in the name of God, by which no detriment can happen in the regions or the earth; he is the hearer and the knower; no loss or calamity will happen to him." And Aban was seized with a paralytic stroke; and a man looked at him and said, "you related that whoever repeated these words every day would meet with no misfortune; and you repeated them; notwithstanding which this paralytic misfortune befel you." Then Aban said to the man, "what do you say? take heed; verily the tradition is as I related it to you; but I have not repeated it to-day; so that God's predestination should pass upon me." And in one tradition it is thus; "whoever says this thrice every evening, no sudden calamity will befal, until he reaches the morning: and whoever says them in the morning, no sudden calamity will reach unto the evening."
units.en2: Abān narrates that he heard his father say that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says three times, morning and evening of every day, 'In the name of God, by whose name no harm can happen in the heavens or the earth; He is the Hearer, the Knower' — no loss or calamity will befall him." And Abān was seized with a paralytic stroke, and a man looked at him and said, "You related that whoever repeated these words daily would meet no misfortune, and you repeated them — yet this has befallen you." Abān said to him, "What do you say? Take heed — the tradition is as I related it to you; but I have not repeated it today, so God's predestination passed upon me." And in one narration: "Whoever says this three times every evening, no sudden calamity will befall him until morning; and whoever says it in the morning, no sudden calamity will reach him until evening."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَمْسَى: «أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَمِنْ سُوءِ الْكِبَرِ أَوِ الْكُفْرِ» . وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «مِنْ سُوءِ الْكِبَرِ وَالْكِبْرِ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ» . وَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا: «أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ» . رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِ لم يذكر: «من سوءِ الكفرِ»
units.en: Abdullah-Ibn-Mas'ud said, "verily the Prophet used to say at night, we and all God's kingdom have reached the night; all praise is for God; there is no God besides God; he is one; there is no partner for him; for him is dominion and praise; and he is powerful over all things. O cherisher! I supplicate thee for the good of this night, and for the good after this night; and I seek protection with thee from the evils of this night, and the evils that may be after it. O Lord! defend me from indifference and the wickedness of infidelity." (And in one tradition it is thus: "O Lord! defend me from the wickedness of arrogance, and from the punishments of the fire and the grave.") And in the morning, he would say, "we have reached the morning," and the aforementioned words.
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates that at night the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "We and all God's kingdom have reached the night; all praise is for God; there is no god besides God; He is One, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is powerful over all things. O my Lord! I ask You for the good of this night and the good after it; and I seek Your protection from the evils of this night and the evils after it. O Lord! Defend me from sloth and the evil of unbelief." (And in one narration: "O Lord! Defend me from the evil of arrogance, and from the punishments of the Fire and the grave.") And in the morning he would say, "We have reached the morning," with the aforementioned words.

units.ar: وَعَنْ بَعْضِ بَنَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يُعَلِّمُهَا فَيَقُولُ: " قُولِي حِينَ تُصْبِحِينَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ حُفِظَ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُمْسِي حُفِظَ حَتَّى يصبح "
units.en: There is a tradition, from some of the Prophet's daughters, that verily the Prophet used to teach us, and tell us to say in the morning, "Subhan allah wa bihamdihi; La-hawlo wa la Kuwwato illa B'illahi; what God willed was, and what he willed not, was not; I know that God has power over all things; verily his wisdom encompasseth all things." Then verily, whoever says these words, in the morning, shall be guarded from calamities unto the night; and whoever says them at night, shall be guarded until he reaches the morning.
units.en2: A tradition from some of the Prophet's ﷺ daughters: the Prophet used to teach us and tell us to say in the morning: "Glory be to God and praise be to Him; there is no power and no strength except in God; what God willed was, and what He did not will was not; I know that God has power over all things, and His knowledge encompasses all things." Whoever says these words in the morning is guarded from calamities until the night, and whoever says them at night is guarded until the morning.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " مَنْ قَالَ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَانَ لَهُ عَدْلُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَكُتِبَ لَهُ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ وَحَطَّ عَنْهُ عَشْرَ سَيِّئَاتٍ وَرفع عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَكَانَ فِي حِرْزٍ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِنْ قَالَهَا إِذَا أَمْسَى كَانَ لهُ مثلُ ذَلِك حَتَّى يُصبحَ ". قَالَ حَمَّاد بن سَلمَة: فَرَأَى رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَرَى النَّائِمُ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا عَيَّاشٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْكَ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ: «صَدَقَ أَبُو عَيَّاشٍ»
units.en: Abu-Aya'sh. A. G. s. "Whoever says, in the morning, there is no God but God; one; to whom there is no partner; for him is dominion and praise; and he is powerful over all things; rewards shall be for him, equal to those for emancipating a slave of the children of Israel; and ten good acts shall be written for him, and ten misdeeds deducted from him; and he shall gain ten steps, and shall be protected from the wickedness of the devil, until night: and whoever shall repeat these words at night, shall get the aforementioned rewards until he rises in the morning." Abu-Aya'sh says, that a man saw the Prophet in his sleep, and said, "O messenger of God verily Abu-Ayash relates from you so and so." The Prophet said, "he spoke true."
units.en2: Abū ʿAyyāsh narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning, 'There is no god but God, One, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is powerful over all things' — rewards equal to freeing a slave of the children of Israel are his; ten good deeds are written for him, ten misdeeds are deducted from him, he is raised ten degrees, and he is protected from the evil of the devil until night; and whoever repeats these words at night gets the same rewards until he rises in the morning." Abū ʿAyyāsh says: A man saw the Prophet ﷺ in his sleep and said, "O Messenger of God, Abū ʿAyyāsh relates such-and-such from you." The Prophet said, "He spoke the truth."

units.ar: وَعَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ أَسَرَّ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: «إِذَا انْصَرَفْتَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَقُلْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُكَلِّمَ أَحَدًا اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ مِتَّ فِي لَيْلَتِكَ كُتِبَ لَكَ جَوَازٌ مِنْهَا»
units.en: Harith-bin-Muslim-Tamimi relates, from his father, and he from the Prophet, that his highness told me a secret; and then said, "when you have finished sun-set prayers, and given the Salam, then say (before speaking a word to any one) seven times, O God! defend me from hell fire. Then verily, when you say this, and die in this night, redemption from the fire shall be written for you; and when you have finished morning prayer, say these words seven times; and verily when you repeat them, and die in this day, redemption from the fire shall be written for you."
units.en2: Al-Ḥārith ibn Muslim al-Tamīmī relates from his father, and he from the Prophet ﷺ, that he told me in confidence: "When you have finished the sunset prayers and given the salām, then — before speaking a word to anyone — say seven times: 'O God! Defend me from the Fire of Hell.' Then when you say this and die that night, redemption from the Fire is written for you; and when you have finished the morning prayer, say these words seven times — and when you repeat them and die that day, redemption from the Fire is written for you."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدِي وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَن أُغتالَ من تحتي» . قَالَ وَكِيع يَعْنِي الْخَسْف
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "the Prophet did not abandon these words morning and evening, O God! I beg from thee safety from all calamities, in the world and futurity; O God! I pray to thee for safety in religion, and for my family and property; O God! conceal my vices and guard me from fear; O God! preserve me from before and behind, on my right side and my left; and guard me from above, that is, from calamities and punishments from all sides; and I seek protection in thy greatness, from perishing under myself; i. e. from sinking into the earth."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: The Prophet ﷺ never abandoned these words, morning and evening: "O God! I beg You for safety from all calamities in this world and the next; O God! I pray You for safety in religion, and for my family and property; O God! Conceal my faults and guard me from fear; O God! Preserve me from before and behind, on my right side and my left; and guard me from above — from calamities and punishments from every side; and I seek protection in Your greatness from being swallowed up beneath me — from sinking into the earth."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا نُشْهِدُكَ وَنُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ إِلَّا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا أَصَابَهُ فِي يَوْمِهِ ذَلِكَ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ "
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "Whoever says, in the morning, O God! I have reached the morning, when I take thee to witness, and the bearers of thy imperial throne, and all thine angels, and all thy creation; that verily thou art God; there is no God except thee alone; there is no partner for thee; and I take all these as witnesses, that Muhammed is thy servant, and messenger; God will forgive all his faults of that day; and if he repeats these words at night, God will forgive him any thing which may have been done by him in that night."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning, 'O God! I have reached the morning calling You to witness, and the bearers of Your Throne, and all Your angels, and all Your creation: that You are God — there is no god except You alone, without partner — and I call all these to witness that Muḥammad is Your servant and messenger' — God will forgive all his faults of that day; and if he repeats these words at night, God will forgive him whatever was done by him that night."

units.ar: وَعَنْ ثَوْبَانَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَمْسَى وَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ ثَلَاثًا رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا إِلَّا كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُرْضِيَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَة»
units.en: Thawban. A. G. s. "There is no Musleman who shall say these words thrice, morning and evening, I am satisfied with God that he is the cherisher, and with Islam which is the religion, and with Muhammed, who is the Prophet; but it will be indispensable on God to be pleased with him on the day of resurrection; that is, he will give him such rewards as will please him."
units.en2: Thawbān narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No Muslim says these words three times, morning and evening — 'I am satisfied with God as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muḥammad as my Prophet' — without it being incumbent on God to be pleased with him on the Day of Resurrection: He will give him such rewards as will please him."

units.ar: وَعَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ تَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَجْمَعُ عِبَادَكَ أَوْ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ»
units.en: Hudhaifah said, "his highness used, when wishing to go to sleep, to put his hands under his head; and then say, O God! defend me from thy punishments, in the day on which thou wilt assemble thy servants; I mean the day of rising from the dead."
units.en2: Ḥudhayfa narrates: The Prophet ﷺ, when wishing to sleep, used to put his hands under his head and say, "O God! Defend me from Your punishments on the day You assemble Your servants — the day of rising from the dead."

units.ar: وَعَن حَفصةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْقُدَ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى تَحْتَ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ» . ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ
units.en: Hafsah said, verily, when the Prophet wished to sleep, he would put his right hand under his right cheek, and then would say, three times, "O Lord! defend me from thy punishments, on that day in which thou wilt raise up thy servants."
units.en2: Ḥafṣa narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ wished to sleep, he would put his right hand under his right cheek and say three times: "O Lord! Defend me from Your punishments on that day in which You raise up Your servants."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ مَضْجَعِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بناصيتهِ اللهُمَّ أَنْت تكشِفُ المغرمَ والمأْثمَ اللهُمَّ لَا يُهْزَمُ جُنْدُكَ وَلَا يُخْلَفُ وَعْدُكَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ»
units.en: Ali-Ibn-Abu't'alib said, "verily the Prophet used to say, at sleeping time, O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee, and with thy word, which is perfect and complete; and from the badness of the thing which is in thy choice; O God! remove far from me debt; and that thing by which I should be an offender; O God! thy army shall not be broken; and thou dost not act contrary to thy promise: I remember thee with purity and praise."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates: At sleeping time the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection, and Your word, perfect and complete, from the evil of what You choose; O God! Remove far from me debt and that by which I would be an offender; O God! Your army shall not be broken, and You do not act contrary to Your promise. I remember You with purity and praise."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَأْوِي إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِله إِلا هوَ الحيَّ القيومَ وأتوبُ إِليهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ذُنُوبُهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ أَوْ عَدَدَ رَمْلِ عَالَجٍ أَوْ عَدَدَ وَرَقِ الشَّجَرِ أَوْ عَدَدَ أَيَّامِ الدُّنْيَا "
units.en: Abu-Sain-Khudum. A. G. s. "Whoever shall say, when wishing to go to sleep, I ask forgiveness of that God except whom there is no other, thrice; he is alive and the keeper alive; and I repent to him; God pardons his faults; although they be numerous as the waves of the sea, or in number equal to the sands of the desart, or in number equal to the leaves of the trees, or equal in number to the days of the world."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says, when wishing to sleep, three times: 'I ask forgiveness of that God besides whom there is no other — He is the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting — and I repent to Him' — God pardons his faults, though they be as numerous as the waves of the sea, or the sands of the desert, or the leaves of the trees, or the days of the world."

units.ar: وَعَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: «مَا من مُسْلِمٍ يَأْخُذُ مَضْجَعَهُ بِقِرَاءَةِ سُورَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا وَكَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مَلَكًا فَلَا يَقْرَبُهُ شَيْءٌ يُؤْذِيهِ حَتَّى يَهُبَّ مَتَى هَبَّ»
units.en: Shaddad-bin-Aws. A. G. s. "There is no Musleman who shall repeat a chapter of the book of God at bed time, but God shall appoint an angel for him, and nothing disagreeable shall come near him, until he awakes."
units.en2: Shaddād ibn Aws narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No Muslim repeats a chapter of the book of God at bedtime without God appointing an angel for him, and nothing disagreeable comes near him until he awakes."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «خَلَّتَانِ لَا يُحْصِيهِمَا رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ إِلَّا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ أَلَا وَهُمَا يَسِيرٌ وَمَنْ يَعْمَلُ بِهِمَا قَلِيلٌ يُسَبِّحُ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ عَشْرًا وَيَحْمَدُهُ عَشْرًا ويكبِّرهُ عَشراً» قَالَ: فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعْقِدُهَا بِيَدِهِ قَالَ: «فَتِلْكَ خَمْسُونَ وَمِائَةٌ فِي اللِّسَان وَأَلْفٌ وَخَمْسُمِائَةٍ فِي الْمِيزَانِ وَإِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ يُسَبِّحُهُ وَيُكَبِّرُهُ وَيَحْمَدُهُ مِائَةً فَتِلْكَ مِائَةٌ بِاللِّسَانِ وَأَلْفٌ فِي الْمِيزَانِ فَأَيُّكُمْ يَعْمَلُ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ أَلْفَيْنِ وَخَمْسَمِائَةِ سَيِّئَةٍ؟» قَالُوا: وَكَيْفَ لَا نُحْصِيهَا؟ قَالَ: " يَأْتِي أَحَدَكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ وَهُوَ فِي صِلَاتِهِ فَيَقُولُ: اذْكُرْ كَذَا اذْكُرْ كَذَا حَتَّى يَنْفَتِلَ فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ لَا يَفْعَلَ وَيَأْتِيهِ فِي مَضْجَعِهِ فَلَا يَزَالُ يُنَوِّمُهُ حَتَّى يَنَامَ ". رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي دَاوُدَ قَالَ: «خَصْلَتَانِ أَوْ خَلَّتَانِ لَا يُحَافِظُ عَلَيْهِمَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ» . وَكَذَا فِي رِوَايَتِهِ بَعْدَ قَوْلِهِ: «وَأَلْفٌ وَخَمْسُمِائَةٍ فِي الْمِيزَانِ» قَالَ: «وَيُكَبِّرُ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ» وَيَحْمَدُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَيُسَبِّحُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ ". وَفِي أَكْثَرِ نُسَخِ المصابيح عَن: عبد الله بن عمر
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Amer. A. G. s. "There are two qualities, which being practised by any one, shall enter him into paradise; and know, they are small and easy; and it is easy for any to practise them. One of them is this, saying Subhan-allah, ten times after every prayer; al-hamdo Lillahi, ten times; and allaho-acber, ten times." Abdullah says, "verily I saw the Prophet counting these words on his hand, and he would say, then these words are one hundred and fifty with the tongue, in the day and night, and they are one thousand and five hundred in the scale of action, reckoning ten for one.
