And the second is this: when he goes to his bed-chamber, let him say subhan-allah thirty-three times, and al-hando-Lillaht thirty-three times, and allaho-acber thirty-four times; then that is one hundred on the tongue, and a thousand in the scales. Then which of you is it that commits two thousand five hundred vices in the day and night, so that these words may cover them?" The companions said, "when repeating these words have so many rewards, why should we not say them?" The Prophet said, "the devil comes to one of you when at prayers, and says to him, remember so and so, I mean the kind devil casts evil thoughts into the mind, till you have finished your prayers; and peradventure he forgets to repeat those words: and the devil comes to one of you in your bed-chamber, and is always making you sleep, and you have no opportunity to repeat these words."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There are two qualities which, practised by anyone, will enter him into Paradise — and know, they are small and easy, and easy for anyone to practise. One is saying 'Glory be to God' ten times after every prayer, 'Praise be to God' ten times, and 'God is greatest' ten times." ʿAbdullāh says: I saw the Prophet counting these words on his hand, and he said: "These words are one hundred and fifty on the tongue by day and night, and one thousand five hundred in the scale of deeds, reckoning ten for one. And the second is: when he goes to his bed, let him say 'Glory be to God' thirty-three times, 'Praise be to God' thirty-three times, and 'God is greatest' thirty-four times — that is one hundred on the tongue and a thousand in the scales. Which of you commits two thousand five hundred vices in a day and night, that these words may not cover them?" The Companions said, "When repeating these words has so many rewards, why should we not say them?" The Prophet said, "The devil comes to one of you at prayers and says to him, 'Remember so-and-so' — casting thoughts into your mind until you have finished your prayers, and perhaps you forget to repeat those words; and the devil comes to one of you in your bed and keeps making you sleepy, and you have no opportunity to repeat these words."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ غَنَّامٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: " من قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ فَقَدْ أَدَّى شُكْرَ يَوْمِهِ وَمَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يُمْسِي فَقَدْ أَدَّى شُكْرَ ليلته "
units.en: Aubullah-bin-Ghanm. A. G. s. "Whoever says in the morning, O God! whatever has reached me of thy benefits, and to thy creation, is from thee alone; there is no partner with thee in giving those benefits; then for thee is praise and thanksgiving; verily has performed his gratitude for his day; and whoever says like this at night, verily has discharged his gratitude for his night."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Ghannām narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning, 'O God! Whatever blessing has reached me and Your creation is from You alone; You have no partner in giving those blessings; to You is praise and thanksgiving' — has performed his gratitude for his day; and whoever says the like at night has discharged his gratitude for his night."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى مُنْزِلَ التوراةِ والإِنجيل والقرآنِ أعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَاغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the Prophet would say, when he came to his bed, O God! lord of the regions, and the earth; and O Lord! of every thing; and O splitter of the grain and kernel! and O sender down of the bible, evangelists and Koran; I seek protection with thee from the evil of every evil doer in thy orders; thou art the first, and there is nothing before thee; and thou art the last, and there is nothing after thee; thou art clear, and there is nothing above thee; thou art concealed, and there is nothing more hidden; enable me to discharge debt, and enrich me from poverty."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ came to his bed he would say: "O God! Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything, Splitter of the grain and the kernel, Sender-down of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur'an — I seek Your protection from the evil of every evil-doer in Your command; You are the First, and there is nothing before You; You are the Last, and there is nothing after You; You are the Manifest, and there is nothing above You; You are the Hidden, and there is nothing more hidden; enable me to discharge my debt, and enrich me against poverty."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي الْأَزْهَر الأيماري أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ: «بسمِ اللَّهِ وضعْتُ جَنْبي للَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَاخْسَأْ شَيْطَانِي وَفُكَّ رِهَانِي وَاجْعَلْنِي فِي النَّدِيِّ الْأَعْلَى»
units.en: Abu-al-Az'har-al-Anmari said, verily the Prophet used, when he went to sleep at night, to say, "in the name of God, I have laid down my side: O Lord! pardon my sins, and put the devil far from me; and give me the reward of my actions, and make me of the number of those near thee."
units.en2: Abū al-Azhar al-ʿAnmarī narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used, when he went to sleep at night, to say: "In the name of God I have laid down my side. O Lord! Pardon my sins, put the devil far from me, give me the reward of my deeds, and make me of the number of those near You."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ: «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَفَانِي وَآوَانِي وَأَطْعَمَنِي وَسَقَانِي وَالَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيَّ فَأَفْضَلَ وَالَّذِي أَعْطَانِي فَأَجْزَلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ وَإِلَهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ»
units.en: Ibn Omer said, "verily the Prophet would say, when going to sleep, thanks be to that God who has guarded me, given me food, and drink, and to him who has bestowed on me abundance of benefits; and thanks be to him who has given me great favours; thanks be to God in every state: O God, lord of every thing and master of every thing; and God of every thing; defend me from hell fire."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: When going to sleep the Prophet ﷺ would say: "Thanks be to that God who has guarded me, given me food and drink, and bestowed on me abundance of benefits; and thanks be to Him who has given me great favours; thanks be to God in every state. O God, Lord of everything and Master of everything, God of everything — defend me from the Fire of Hell."

units.ar: وَعَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ قَالَ: شَكَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُول الله مَا أَنَام من اللَّيْلَ مِنَ الْأَرَقِ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظَلَّتْ وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ وَمَا أَقَلَّتْ وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضَلَّتْ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّ خَلْقِكَ كُلِّهِمْ جَمِيعًا أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يَبْغِيَ عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ "
units.en: Buraidah said, "Khalid-bin Walid complained to the Prophet, and said, I cannot sleep at night." And the Prophet said, "when you go to your bed, say these words, O God! lord of the seven regions, and of the things which the regions have cast shadow upon; O God! lord of the earths and of the things which the earths bear, and O God! lord of the devils, and the lord of those whom the devils lead astray; be a neighbour to me, and an asylum from the wickedness of thy creation; and be an asylum to me from their injuring me; thy neighbourhood is strong, and strong is he who is in thy asylum; and great is thy praise; there is no God besides thee, and no other God but thee."
units.en2: Burayda narrates: Khālid ibn al-Walīd complained to the Prophet ﷺ, saying, "I cannot sleep at night." The Prophet said: "When you go to your bed, say these words: 'O God! Lord of the seven heavens and of what the heavens cast their shadow upon; O God! Lord of the earths and of what the earths bear; O God! Lord of the devils and of those whom the devils lead astray — be a neighbour to me, and an asylum from the wickedness of Your creation; be an asylum to me from their injuring me. Strong is Your neighbourhood, and strong is he who is in Your asylum; and great is Your praise; there is no god besides You, and no other god but You.'"

units.ar: وَعَن أَبِي مَالِكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " إِذَا أَصْبَحَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبِرْكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَمْسَى فَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ "
units.en: Abu-Malik-Ash'ari. A. G. s. "When any one of you rises in the morning, he must say, we have reached the morning, and so has the creation of God, that God who is the cherisher of the universe; O Lord! I supplicate thee for the goodness of this day, and that the doors of good may be opened on me this day, and to aid me, and I supplicate thee for brightness of heart, and for increase of thy favors this day; and for the straight road, and to defend me from the evils which are in this day, and from the evils henceforth." After that, when night comes, let him repeat the like.
units.en2: Abū Mālik al-Ashʿarī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you rises in the morning, he should say: 'We have reached the morning, and so has the creation of God — that God who is the Cherisher of the universe. O Lord! I ask You for the goodness of this day, that the doors of good be opened for me this day, and for Your aid; and I ask You for brightness of heart, for increase of Your favours this day, for the straight road, and to defend me from the evils in this day and the evils henceforth.' And when night comes, let him repeat the like."

units.ar: وَعَنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي: يَا أَبَتِ أَسْمَعُكَ تَقُولُ كُلَّ غَدَاةٍ: «اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ» تُكَرِّرُهَا ثَلَاثًا حِينَ تُصْبِحُ وَثَلَاثًا حِين تمسي فَقَالَ: يَا بُنَيَّ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أستن بسننه
units.en: Abdul-Rahman-bin-Abi-Bacrah said, "I said to my father, O my father! I hear you say every morning, O Lord! give health to my body, O Lord! give health in my hearing, O Lord give health in my sight; there is no God but thee, and this you repeat three times morning and evening." Then my father said, "O my son, I heard the Prophet supplicate in these words, and I love to act in the way of his highness."
units.en2: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakra narrates: I said to my father, "O my father! I hear you say every morning, 'O Lord! Give health to my body; O Lord! Give health in my hearing; O Lord! Give health in my sight; there is no god but You' — and you repeat this three times morning and evening." My father said, "My son, I heard the Prophet ﷺ supplicate in these words, and I love to act in his way."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ: «أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَالْعَظَمَةُ لِلَّهِ وَالْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ وَاللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَمَا سَكَنَ فِيهِمَا لِلَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ هَذَا النَّهَارِ صَلَاحًا وَأَوْسَطَهُ نَجَاحًا وَآخِرَهُ فَلَاحًا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ» . ذَكَرَهُ النَّوَوِيُّ فِي كِتَابِ الْأَذْكَارِ بِرِوَايَةِ ابْنِ السّني
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Abi-Awfa said, "the Prophet used to say, in the morning, we have reached the morning, and so has the creation of God; all praise is for God; perfect attributes are for him; and the created and creation is for him; and rule is for him; O Lord! make the beginning of this day good and peaceful, and the middle of it to arrive at our desires, and the latter part of it a redemption from the fire, O the most kind of the kind."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Awfā narrates: In the morning the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "We have reached the morning, and so has the creation of God; all praise is for God; perfect attributes are His; creation is His and rule is His. O Lord! Make the beginning of this day good and peaceful, the middle of it to arrive at our desires, and the latter part of it a redemption from the Fire, O Most Kind of the kind."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ: «أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ»
units.en: Abdul-Rahman-bin-Abza said, "the Prophet used to say, in the morning, we have risen on the religion of Islam, and on the word La-ilaho-ill'-allahi, and on the religion of our Prophet, who is Muhammed; and on the religion of our father, who is Abraham; who was an incliner from the false to the true, and was not of the polytheists."
units.en2: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abzā narrates: In the morning the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "We have risen upon the religion of Islam, upon the word 'There is no god but God,' upon the religion of our Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Abraham — who inclined from the false to the true, and was not of the polytheists."

sections.heading: On Supplications to Be Repeated at Particular Times (Matthews, Book X, Ch. VI)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter VI of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 578-587. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter of supplications for particular occasions (reports 2416-2456); Matthews omits report 2417 and the cross-reference note 2430.

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ يُقَدَّرْ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَدٌ فِي ذَلِكَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْطَانٌ أَبَدًا "
units.en: Ibn Abbas. A. G. s. "If either of you wishes to have connexion with his wife, let him say, in the name of God! O Lord! keep me far from the devil; and keep the devil far from my children." Then if a child shall be given, the devil can never do it any harm.
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If one of you wishes to approach his wife, let him say: 'In the name of God! O Lord, keep me far from the devil, and keep the devil far from my children.' Then if a child is given, the devil can never harm it."

units.ar: وَعَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدَ قَالَ: اسْتَبَّ رَجُلَانِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ عِنْدَهُ جُلُوسٌ وَأَحَدُهُمَا يَسُبُّ صَاحِبَهُ مُغْضَبًا قَدِ احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ» . فَقَالُوا لِلرَّجُلِ: لَا تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ: إِنِّي لستُ بمجنون
units.en: Sulaiman-bin Surad said, "two men abused each other, near the Prophet, and we were sitting with him; one of the two men abused the other in anger, verily his face was quite red; and the Prophet said, verily I most certainly do know a word, which if he said, would remove his anger; it is this: I seek protection with God from the cast out devil." And the companions said to the man, "do not you attend to what the Prophet of God says?" He said, "verily I am not mad."
units.en2: Sulaymān ibn Ṣurad narrates: Two men were abusing each other near the Prophet ﷺ while we were sitting with him; one of them abused the other in anger, his face quite red. The Prophet said: "I most certainly know a word which, if he said it, would remove his anger: 'I seek protection with God from the cast-out devil.'" And the companions said to the man, "Do you not attend to what the Prophet of God says?" He said, "I am not mad."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَسَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانا»
units.en: Ab'uhurairah. A. G. s. "When you hear the cock crow; then supplicate God for an increase of his beneficence; because the cock sees an angel, and crows at the sight. And when you hear an ass bray, seek protection with God from the devil, and say, I take protection with God from the cast out devil, because the ass has seen the devil."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you hear the cock crow, supplicate God for an increase of His beneficence, because the cock sees an angel and crows at the sight. And when you hear an ass bray, seek protection with God from the devil — say, 'I take protection with God from the cast-out devil' — because the ass has seen the devil."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى السَّفَرِ كَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ: (سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ) اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ لَنَا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ والأهلِ ". وإِذا رجعَ قالَهنَّ وزادَ فيهِنَّ: «آيِبُونَ تائِبُونَ عابِدُونَ لربِّنا حامدون»
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "verily the Prophet used (when mounted upon his camel to take a journey) to say, Allah-Acher, thrice; after that he would say, that God is pure who has made this camel obedient to me; for I had not the power myself of bringing him under my obedience; and verily I am a returner to my patron; O Lord I ask thee in this journey for goodness and continence, and for actions by which you shall be pleased. O Lord make this journey easy to me, and shorten for me the distance of this journey; O Lord! thou art a friend and companion in journey, and guardian of our families in our absence; O Lord! I seek protection with thee from the troubles of travelling; O Lord! I seek protection with thee from a sight which may be followed with melancholy and grief; and O Lord! defend me from meeting with, on my return, any thing injurious to my family and property." And when the Prophet returned from a journey, he would say these words; and add this to them, "we are returners, we are repenters, we are worshippers, we are praisers of God."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ mounted his camel to take a journey, he used to say 'God is greatest' three times, then say: "Pure is that God who has made this camel obedient to me, for I had not the power myself to bring it under my obedience; and truly I am a returner to my Lord. O Lord, I ask You on this journey for goodness and piety, and for deeds by which You shall be pleased. O Lord, make this journey easy for me, and shorten its distance for me. O Lord! You are the friend and companion on the journey, and the guardian of our families in our absence. O Lord! I seek Your protection from the troubles of travelling; O Lord! I seek Your protection from a sight that brings melancholy and grief; and O Lord! defend me from meeting on my return with anything injurious to my family and property." And when the Prophet returned from a journey, he would say these words and add to them: "We are returners, we are repenters, we are worshippers, we are praisers of God."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَافَرَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْل وَالْمَال
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Sarjis said, "the Prophet used, when he travelled, to seek protection from the trouble of the journey, and badness of return, and from scarcity after abundance; and would seek protection from the supplications of the oppressed, and from seeing any thing bad in his family and property."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sarjis narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ travelled, he used to seek protection from the trouble of the journey and the badness of the return, and from scarcity after abundance; and he would seek protection from the supplications of the oppressed, and from seeing anything bad in his family and property.

units.ar: وَعَن خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: " مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا فَقَالَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يرحل من منزله ذَلِك "
units.en: Khawlah-bint Hacim said, "I heard the messenger of God say, he who alights at his journey's end, and says, I seek protection in the words of God, which are perfect and complete; from the badness of the thing which God has created; nothing hurtful will happen to him, till he marches from that place."
units.en2: Khawla bint Ḥakīm narrates: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: "Whoever alights at his journey's end and says, 'I seek protection in the words of God, which are perfect and complete, from the evil of what God has created' — nothing hurtful will happen to him until he marches from that place."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَقِيتُ مِنْ عَقْرَبٍ لَدَغَتْنِي الْبَارِحَةَ قَالَ: " أَمَا لَوْ قُلْتَ حِينَ أَمْسَيْتَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خلق لم تَضُرك "
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "a man came to the Prophet, and said, O messenger of God! I have felt much pain and distress from the bite of a scorpion last night." His highness said, "beware, if you had repeated this supplication in the evening; I seek protection in the words of God, which are perfect and complete, from the injury of things which God has created, the scorpion would not have bit you."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of God! Last night I suffered much pain and distress from the bite of a scorpion." He said: "Mind — if you had repeated this supplication in the evening — 'I seek protection in the words of God, perfect and complete, from the injury of the things God has created' — the scorpion would not have bitten you."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ وَأَسْحَرَ يَقُولُ: «سمع سامع يحمد الله وَحسن بلائه علينا وربنا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "when his highness was travelling, and it was day-break, he would say, let the hearers hear our speaking the praise of God, and on the goodness of his benefits to us, so that they may follow us in speaking praise; O Lord! be our companion, and do us good; I say this whilst I am a seeker of protection with God from the fire."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ was travelling and day broke, he would say: "Let the hearers hear our speaking the praise of God and the goodness of His benefits to us, so that they may follow us in speaking praise. O Lord! Be our companion and do us good — I say this while seeking protection with God from the Fire."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ غَزْوٍ أَوْ حَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ ثَلَاثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كلِّ شيءٍ قديرٌ آيِبونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ»
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "the Prophet used (when returned from war pilgrimage, and Umrah) to say thrice, upon every rising ground, allaho acber; after that he would say, La-ilaha-ili-Allaho, one; there is no partner with him, for him is dominion and praise, and he is powerful over all things: we are returners, we are repenters, we are adorers, we are worshippers, we are speakers of praise for God; God has verified his promise, in support of religion, and has assisted his servant, and has broken multitudes of infidels alone, although ten to one, they were defeated."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ returned from war, pilgrimage, or ʿumra, he used to say 'God is greatest' three times upon every rising ground; then he would say: "There is no god but God, One; there is no partner with Him; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is powerful over all things. We are returners, we are repenters, we are adorers, we are worshippers, we are speakers of praise to God. God has verified His promise in support of religion, has assisted His servant, and has broken the hosts of the unbelievers alone — though many to one, they were defeated."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ: دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمِ الأحزابَ اللهُمَّ اهزمهم وزلزلهم»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Abi-Awfa said, "the Prophet supplicated for evil on the polytheists, on the day of the battle of Ahzab;" and said, "O God! the sender of the book, and the quick taker of accounts with thy servants: O Lord! give defeat to these bodies of infidels: O Lord break them, and make their legs to tremble."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Awfā narrates: The Prophet ﷺ supplicated against the polytheists on the day of the battle of the Trenches, saying: "O God! Sender of the book, and quick reckoner with Your servants — O Lord! give defeat to these hosts of unbelievers; O Lord, break them and make their legs tremble."

units.ar: وَعَن عبد الله بن يسر قَالَ: نَزَلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى أَبِي فَقَرَّبْنَا إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا وَوَطْبَةً فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِتَمْرٍ فَكَانَ يَأْكُلُهُ وَيُلْقِي النَّوَى بَيْنَ أُصْبُعَيْهِ وَيَجْمَعُ السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: فَجَعَلَ يُلْقِي النَّوَى عَلَى ظَهْرِ أُصْبُعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَهُ فَقَالَ أَبِي وَأَخَذَ بِلِجَامِ دَابَّتِهِ: ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ واغفرْ لَهُم وارحمهم»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Busr said, "the Prophet alighted near my father, and we approached him with victuals, and a bag of milk, and he ate: after that, dry dates were brought, and he ate of them; and he threw away the kernels, by putting them first upon his fore and middle fingers; after that drinking water was brought, and he drank of it; and my father said to his highness, (and took hold of the bridle of his beast) supplicate God for us." And the Prophet said, "O Lord! increase what thou hast already given to these people; O Lord! pardon and have mercy upon them."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Yusr narrates: The Prophet ﷺ alighted near my father, and we approached him with food and a bag of milk, and he ate; then dry dates were brought and he ate of them, and he set aside the stones, placing them first upon his fore and middle fingers; then drinking-water was brought and he drank of it. My father said to him — and took hold of the bridle of his beast — "Supplicate God for us." And the Prophet said: "O Lord! Increase what You have already given to these people; O Lord! Pardon and have mercy upon them."

units.ar: عَن طلحةَ بنِ عبيدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ» وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ غَرِيبٌ
units.en: Talhah-bin-Ubaidullah said, "verily the Prophet used (when he saw the new moon) to say, O Lord! make the new moon rise upon us, safe from calamities; and firm in faith, and pure in heart, and secure in Islam. O new moon! our lord, and your lord, is God."
units.en2: Ṭalḥa ibn ʿUbaydullāh narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ saw the new moon, he used to say: "O Lord! Make the new moon rise upon us with safety from calamities, firmness in faith, purity of heart, and security in Islam. O new moon! Our Lord and your Lord is God."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَا: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ رَأَى مُبْتَلًى فَقَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا إِلَّا لَمْ يُصِبْهُ ذَلِكَ الْبَلَاءُ كَائِنا مَا كانَ "
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khattab and Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "There is no man who has seen a person entangled in misfortune, and said, thanks be to God, who has given me safety from that by which he has entangled thee, and has given me more than many whom he has created, but will be safe from that misfortune, let it be what it will."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb and Abū Hurayra narrate that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No man sees a person entangled in misfortune and says, 'Thanks be to God, who has given me safety from that by which He has entangled you, and has given me more than many whom He has created,' without being safe from that misfortune, whatever it may be."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَقَالَ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفَ سَيِّئَةٍ وَرَفَعَ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفَ دَرَجَةٍ وَبَنَى لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ ". رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَابْنُ مَاجَهْ وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ وَفِي شَرْحِ السُّنَّةِ: «مَنْ قَالَ فِي سُوقٍ جَامِعٍ يباعُ فِيهِ» بدل «من دخل السُّوق»
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khat'tab. A. G. s. "He who goes into a bazar, and says, there is no God but the one God, he hath no partner; his is the kingdom, to him be the praise; he bringeth to life and causeth to die; and he is the living one, who dieth not; in his hand is every thing good; and his power extendeth over all; God will write for him a million of good acts, and will blot out a million of faults, and exalt him a million steps, and will build a house for him in paradise."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever goes into a bazaar and says, 'There is no god but the one God; He has no partner; His is the kingdom, and His is the praise; He brings to life and causes to die; and He is the Ever-Living who never dies; in His hand is all good; and His power extends over all' — God will write for him a million good deeds, blot out a million faults, exalt him a million degrees, and build a house for him in Paradise."

units.ar: وَعَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ: سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا يَدْعُو يَقُولُ: اللهُمَّ إِني أسألكَ تمامَ النعمةِ فَقَالَ: «أيُّ شَيْءٍ تَمَامُ النِّعْمَةِ؟» قَالَ: دَعْوَةٌ أَرْجُو بِهَا خَيْرًا فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ مِنْ تَمَامِ النِّعْمَةِ دُخُولَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالْفَوْزَ مِنَ النَّارِ» . وَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقُولُ: يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ فَقَالَ: «قَدِ اسْتُجِيبَ لَكَ فَسَلْ» . وَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الصَّبْرَ فَقَالَ: «سَأَلْتَ اللَّهَ الْبَلَاءَ فَاسْأَلْهُ الْعَافِيَةَ»
units.en: Mu'adh-bin-Jabal said, "the Prophet heard a man supplicating, and saying, O Lord! I ask thee for perfect benefits;" and the Prophet said, and asked the man, "what thing is the perfect benefit which you ask for?" He said, "this is a supplication by which I hope for good; and I know wholly that with God are perfect benefits, I ask for them." Then his highness said, "of the most perfect of benefits is entering into paradise, and getting redemption from hell fire." And the Prophet heard a man say, "O master of greatness! O master of generosity!" And the Prophet said, "verily thy supplication is accepted; then ask for any thing you wish." And the Prophet heard another man saying, "O Lord! verily I ask thee for patience:" and the Prophet said, "the patience which you ask of God is like asking for calamity; because patience is for calamity; then ask health of God; that he may guard you from all calamities and mishaps."
units.en2: Muʿādh ibn Jabal narrates: The Prophet ﷺ heard a man supplicating, saying, "O Lord! I ask You for perfect benefits." The Prophet asked the man, "What is the perfect benefit you ask for?" He said, "It is a supplication by which I hope for good; and I know for certain that with God are the perfect benefits — I ask for them." Then the Prophet said: "The most perfect of benefits is entering Paradise and gaining redemption from the Fire of Hell." And the Prophet heard a man say, "O Master of greatness! O Master of generosity!" The Prophet said, "Your supplication is accepted — ask for anything you wish." And the Prophet heard another man saying, "O Lord! I ask You for patience." The Prophet said, "The patience you ask of God is like asking for calamity, because patience is for calamity — instead ask God for health, that He may guard you from all calamities and mishaps."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ جَلَسَ مَجْلِسًا فَكَثُرَ فِيهِ لَغَطُهُ فَقَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا كَانَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ ذَلِكَ "
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Whoever sits in an assembly, and there talks much idly, and says, before standing up, O God thou art immaculate, and I praise thee, and give evidence that there is no God besides thee, I ask thee for pardon, and I repent to thee, he will be forgiven his faults, which have happened therein."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sits in an assembly and talks much idly, and says before standing up, 'O God, You are immaculate, and I praise You; and I bear witness that there is no god besides You; I ask You for pardon, and I repent to You' — he will be forgiven the faults that happened in it."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ: أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِدَابَّةٍ لِيَرْكَبَهَا فَلَمَّا وضَعَ رِجْلَه فِي الركابِ قَالَ: بسمِ اللَّهِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: (سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبنَا لمنُقلِبون) ثُمَّ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ثَلَاثًا وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثَلَاثًا سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ فَقِيلَ: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ ضَحِكْتَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَنَعَ كَمَا صَنَعْتُ ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ فَقُلْتُ: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ ضَحِكْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: " إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْجَبُ مِنْ عَبْدِهِ إِذَا قَالَ: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَقُولُ: يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ غَيْرِي "
units.en: Ali-ibn-Abi Talib said, "a horse was brought for me to ride upon, and I put my foot in the stirrup, and said, in the name of God! and when I sat upon his back, I said, all praise to God! After that I said, thou art pure, O God! who hast made this horse obedient to me; for I had not the power of bringing him under my obedience; and verily, I am a returner towards my patron." Then I said, "all praise to God!" thrice; "great God!" thrice; and I said, I remember thee, O God! with purity; verily I have injured myself from neglect in adoration; then forgive me, because no one pardons faults but thee." After that I laughed, and it was said, "what has made you laugh?" I said, "I saw the Prophet do as I have done;" after which his highness laughed; and I said, "what did you laugh at, O messenger of God?" He said, "on this account, that thy cherisher, verily is pleased and satisfied with his servant, when he says, O Lord! pardon my faults: God says, the servant knows that no person forgives faults but me." Then the Prophet laughed at the word of God, and I in following him."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates: "A horse was brought for me to ride, and I put my foot in the stirrup and said, 'In the name of God!'; and when I sat upon its back I said, 'All praise to God!' Then I said, 'You are pure, O God, who have made this horse obedient to me, for I had not the power to bring it under my obedience; and truly I am a returner to my Lord.' Then I said 'All praise to God!' three times, 'God is greatest!' three times, and I said, 'I remember You, O God, with purity; truly I have injured myself by neglect in adoration — so forgive me, for no one pardons faults but You.' After that I laughed, and it was said, 'What made you laugh?' I said, 'I saw the Prophet ﷺ do as I have done,' at which he laughed; and I said, 'What did you laugh at, O Messenger of God?' He said, 'At this: your Lord is pleased and satisfied with His servant when he says, "O Lord! Pardon my faults" — God says, "The servant knows that no one forgives faults but Me."' Then the Prophet laughed at the word of God, and I at following him."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا وَدَّعَ رَجُلًا أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ فَلَا يَدَعُهَا حَتَّى يَكُونَ الرَّجُلُ هُوَ يَدَعُ يَدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَيَقُولُ: «أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَآخِرَ عَمَلِكَ» وَفِي رِوَايَة «خَوَاتِيم عَمَلِكَ» . رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ وَابْنُ مَاجَهْ وَفِي روايتهما لم يذكر: «وَآخر عَمَلك»
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "when the Prophet gave any man permission to go away, he would take him by the hand, and would not quit it till the man let go his; and would say, I commit to God's care your religion and property, and your last actions."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ gave any man permission to leave, he would take him by the hand and not release it until the man let go of his, and would say: "I commit to God's care your religion and your property, and your last actions."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخَطْمِيِّ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْتَوْدِعَ الْجَيْشَ قَالَ: «أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكُمْ وأمانتكم وخواتيم أَعمالكُم»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Yezid-Khatmi said, "the Prophet used (when about to bid farewell to any army) to say, I commit to the care of God your religion, your faith, and last actions."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Yazīd al-Khaṭmī narrates: When about to bid farewell to any army, the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "I commit to the care of God your religion, your faith, and your last actions."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ سَفَرًا فَزَوِّدْنِي فَقَالَ: «زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى» . قَالَ: زِدْنِي قَالَ: «وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ» قَالَ: زِدْنِي بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي قَالَ: «وَيَسَّرَ لكَ الْخَيْر حيثُما كُنْتَ»
units.en: Anas said, "a man came to the Prophet, and said, O messenger of God! verily I intend to take a journey; then give me a wallet: I mean, supplicate for me." Then the Prophet said, "may God make thee a wallet of abstinence; because it is a wallet for the last road." The man said, "supplicate more for me." He said, "God forgive your faults." The man said, ("may my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Prophet of God!") "supplicate more for me." The Prophet said, "may God grant thee attainment of good, wherever thou art."
units.en2: Anas narrates: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of God! I intend to take a journey — give me provisions; I mean, supplicate for me." The Prophet said, "May God make piety your provision, for it is the provision for the last road." The man said, "Supplicate more for me." He said, "God forgive your faults." The man said — may my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Prophet of God — "Supplicate more for me." The Prophet said, "May God grant you the attainment of good, wherever you are."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُسَافِرَ فَأَوْصِنِي قَالَ: «عَلَيْكَ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَالتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى كل شرف» . قَالَ: فَلَمَّا وَلَّى الرَّجُلُ قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ اطْوِ لَهُ الْبعد وهون عَلَيْهِ السّفر»
units.en: Ab'uhurairah relates, that a man said, "O messenger of God! verily I wish to make a journey, then advise me." The Prophet said, "be always abstinent, and always say, allaho acber, when you get upon a high spot;" and when the man turned his back, the Prophet prayed for him, "O Lord! make the distance of his journey short, and make his journey easy to him."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra relates that a man said, "O Messenger of God! I wish to make a journey — advise me." The Prophet said, "Be always God-fearing, and always say 'God is greatest' when you come upon high ground"; and when the man turned away, the Prophet prayed for him: "O Lord! Make the distance of his journey short, and make his journey easy for him."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَأَقْبَلَ اللَّيْلُ قَالَ: «يَا أَرْضُ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكِ اللَّهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّكِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيكِ وَشَرِّ مَا خُلِقَ فِيكِ وَشَرِّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَيْكِ وَأَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَأَسْودَ وَمِنَ الْحَيَّةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ سَاكِنِ الْبَلَدِ وَمِنْ والدٍ وَمَا ولد»
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "when the Prophet travelled, he would say at night, O earth! my Lord, and thy Lord, is God; I seek protection with God from thy harms; that is, from sinking into thee, and being bewildered in desarts; and I seek for protection from things that are fixed in thee, such as the Genii, and all animals; and I seek protection with God from tygers, black snakes, and every kind of snake and scorpion; and from the hurts of the inhabitants of towns; and from the devil and his race."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ travelled, he would say at night: "O earth! My Lord and your Lord is God. I seek God's protection from your harms — from sinking into you and being bewildered in deserts; and I seek protection from the things fixed in you, such as the jinn and all animals; and I seek God's protection from tigers, black snakes, and every kind of snake and scorpion; and from the harms of the inhabitants of towns; and from the devil and his progeny."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا غَزَا قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ»
units.en: Anas said, "the Prophet used to say, when at war with the infidels; O Lord! thou art my arm and support; by thy power I make a stratagem for the expulsion of the enemy; and by thy strength I attack the enemies of religion; and I fight by thy support."
units.en2: Anas narrates: When at war with the unbelievers, the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! You are my arm and my support; by Your power I outmanoeuvre the enemy; by Your strength I attack the enemies of religion; and by Your support I fight."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا خَافَ قَوْمًا قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ من شرورهم»
units.en: Abu-Mu'sa said, "verily, when the Prophet frightened a body of people, he would say, O Lord! I throw your fear into their breasts, and take protection with you from their injuries."
units.en2: Abū Mūsā narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ alarmed a body of people, he would say: "O Lord! I throw Your fear into their breasts, and I take protection with You from their injuries."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نَزِلَّ أَوْ نَضِلَّ أَوْ نَظْلِمَ أَوْ نُظْلَمَ أَوْ نَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيْنَا» . رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي دَاوُدَ وَابْنِ مَاجَهْ قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ: مَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ بَيْتِي قَطُّ إِلَّا رَفَعَ طَرْفَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَو يجهل عَليّ»
units.en: Omm-Salmah said, "verily the Prophet used, when he came out of his house, to say, in the name of God! I put my whole trust in him; O Lord! I take protection with thee from slipping, and straying, or oppressing any one; or any one oppressing me, or from acting an ignorant part with any person; or that any one should do so with me."
units.en2: Umm Salama narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ came out of his house, he used to say: "In the name of God! I put my whole trust in Him. O Lord! I take Your protection from slipping or straying, or oppressing anyone, or anyone oppressing me, or acting ignorantly with any person, or anyone doing so with me."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِذَا خَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ حِينَئِذٍ هُدِيتَ وَكُفِيتَ وَوُقِيتَ فَيَتَنَحَّى لَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ وَيَقُولُ شَيْطَانٌ آخَرُ: كَيْفَ لَكَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ هُدِيَ وَكُفِيَ وَوُقِيَ ". رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وروى التِّرْمِذِيّ إِلى قَوْله: «الشَّيْطَان»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "When a man comes out of his house, let him say, in the name of God! and I put my whole trust in God; there is no power or strength but in God. At this time it shall be said for the man, you have been shewn the straight road, and there is enough for you in all your undertakings; and you are guarded from all mishaps." Then the devil removes far from him; and another devil says to the one put away, "how will you overcome a man that has found the right road?"
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a man comes out of his house, let him say: 'In the name of God! I put my whole trust in God; there is no power or strength but in God.' At that it shall be said for the man: 'You have been shown the straight road, there is enough for you in all your undertakings, and you are guarded from all mishaps.' Then the devil withdraws far from him, and another devil says to the one withdrawn: 'How will you overcome a man who has found the right road?'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " إِذَا وَلَجَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْتَهُ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا ثُمَّ لْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ "
units.en: Abu Malik Ash'ari. A. G. s. "When a man comes into his house, let him say, O God! I supplicate thee for a good entrance into this house, and for a good going out of it; that is, that all may be well in going in and out of it; in the name of God! I came in, and I have put my whole trust in my Lord, who is God." After that he must say Salam to the people of the house.
units.en2: Abū Mālik al-Ashʿarī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a man comes into his house, let him say: 'O God! I ask You for a good entrance into this house and a good going out of it' — that is, that all may be well in going in and out of it — 'In the name of God I came in, and I have put my whole trust in my Lord, who is God.' After that he must say salām to the people of the house."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا رَفَّأَ الْإِنْسَانَ إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ قَالَ: «بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the Prophet used, when a man married, to supplicate, and say, God bless thee in increase; and God bless both in increase; and God give concord between ye."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: When a man married, the Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate and say: "God bless you with increase; God bless you both with increase; and God give concord between you."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً أَوِ اشْتَرَى خَادِمًا فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيرًا فليأخُذْ بِذروةِ سنامِهِ ولْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ» . وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْخَادِمِ: «ثُمَّ لْيَأْخُذْ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا وَلْيَدْعُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ»
units.en: Amr-bin-Sho'aib relates from his ancestors, that the Prophet said, when any one of you marries, or buys a slave boy or girl, he must say, "O Lord! I pray thee for good in this boy or girl, and for good dispositions with which thou hast created them; I seek protection with thee from their badness, and from any thing bad which thou mayest have created in their dispositions." And when any one of you buys a camel, he must take him by the hump on the back, and say the same as for a slave boy or girl. (And in one tradition about a slave boy or girl thus; "you must take the boy or girl by the hair of the forehead, and supplicate for blessings.")
units.en2: ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb relates from his forefathers that the Prophet ﷺ said: When one of you marries or buys a servant boy or girl, he must say: "O Lord! I pray You for the good in this boy or girl, and for the good dispositions with which You have created them; I seek Your protection from their badness and from anything bad You may have created in their dispositions." And when one of you buys a camel, he must take it by the hump on its back and say the same as for a servant boy or girl. (And in one tradition about a servant boy or girl: "You must take the boy or girl by the hair of the forehead and supplicate for blessings.")

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «دَعَوَاتُ الْمَكْرُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ»
units.en: Abu-Bacrah. A. G. s. "The supplications of a person in sorrow are these, O Lord! I hope for thy compassion; then do not leave me without it the twinkling of an eye, and make my condition good; there is no God but thee."
units.en2: Abū Bakra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The supplication of a person in sorrow is this: 'O Lord! I hope for Your compassion — so do not leave me without it for the twinkling of an eye, and set my condition right; there is no god but You.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: هُمُومٌ لَزِمَتْنِي وَدُيُونٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «أَفَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلَامًا إِذَا قُلْتَهُ أَذْهَبَ اللَّهُ هَمَّكَ وَقَضَى عَنْكَ دَيْنَكَ؟» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: بَلَى قَالَ: " قُلْ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحُزْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ ". قَالَ: فَفعلت ذَلِك فَأذْهب الله همي وَقضى عَن ديني
units.en: Abu-Sa'id Khudhri said, "a man said, O messenger of God! debts and sorrows have pressed me." His highness said, "shall not I then teach you a saying, which when you say, God will take away your sorrow, and discharge your debts; I mean will cause your debts to be discharged?" The man said, "teach me the words." The Prophet said, "say, morning and evening, O Lord! defend me from melancholy and sorrow; and from incapability and laziness, and from stinginess and cowardice, and from being overcome with debt, and from being overcome by men, on account of debt." The man said, "then I did what the Prophet ordered me; and God took away my sorrow, and discharged my debt."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates: A man said, "O Messenger of God! Debts and sorrows have pressed me." He said, "Shall I not teach you a saying which, when you say it, God will take away your sorrow and discharge your debts — I mean, will cause your debts to be discharged?" The man said, "Teach me the words." The Prophet said: "Say, morning and evening: 'O Lord! Defend me from melancholy and sorrow, from incapability and laziness, from stinginess and cowardice, from being overcome with debt, and from being overcome by men on account of debt.'" The man said, "Then I did what the Prophet ordered me, and God took away my sorrow and discharged my debt."

units.ar: وَعَن عليّ: أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ مُكَاتَبٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي عَجَزْتُ عَنْ كتابي فَأَعِنِّي قَالَ: أَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَاتٍ عَلَّمَنِيهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِثْلُ جَبَلٍ كَبِيرٍ دَيْنًا أَدَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَنْكَ. قُلْ: «اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ» . رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَالْبَيْهَقِيُّ فِي الدَّعَوَاتِ الْكَبِيرِ وَسَنَذْكُرُ حَدِيثَ جَابِرٍ: «إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلَابِ» فِي بَابِ «تَغْطِيَةِ الْأَوَانِي» إِن شَاءَ الله تَعَالَىالْفَصْل الثَّالِث
units.en: Ali-ibn-Abu Talib said, "a Mukatab came to me, and said, verily I am unable to discharge the sum which I agreed for, then assist me; that is, give me something to give in exchange for my bond." I said, "shall I not teach you some words which the Prophet taught me, which if you had a mountain of debt upon you, God would discharge it for you? They are these, O Lord supply me sufficiently with thy lawful things, against those which thou hast made unlawful; that is, give me lawful sustenance, and make me independent, by the increase of thy munificence, of every person beside thee."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates: A contracted servant came to me and said, "I am unable to discharge the sum I agreed for — assist me; that is, give me something to give in exchange for my bond." I said, "Shall I not teach you some words the Prophet ﷺ taught me, which, if you had a mountain of debt upon you, God would discharge it for you? They are these: 'O Lord, supply me sufficiently with Your lawful things against those You have made unlawful — that is, give me lawful sustenance, and make me independent, by the increase of Your munificence, of everyone besides You.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا جَلَسَ مَجْلِسًا أَوْ صَلَّى تكلَّم بِكَلِمَاتٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْكَلِمَاتِ فَقَالَ: " إِنْ تُكُلِّمَ بِخَيْرٍ كَانَ طَابَعًا عَلَيْهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَإِنْ تُكُلِّمَ بِشَرٍّ كَانَ كَفَّارَةً لَهُ: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ "
units.en: Aayeshah said, "the Prophet used, when he sat in an assembly, or performed prayers, to speak a few words; and I asked his highness about the words: he said, they are these, I remember thee, O God! with purity, and praise thee; there is no God but thee; I ask pardon of thee, and repent to thee; and if words are uttered, for which rewards, there will be a seal for them unto the day of resurrection; and if bad words are uttered, those words will be a cause of covering them."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates: The Prophet ﷺ used, when he sat in an assembly or performed prayers, to speak a few words; and I asked him about the words. He said, they are these: "I remember You, O God, with purity, and praise You; there is no god but You; I ask Your pardon, and repent to You." And if good words are uttered, there will be a seal of reward for them until the Day of Resurrection; and if bad words are uttered, those words will be a cause of covering them.

units.ar: وَعَن قَتَادَة: بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ قَالَ: «هِلَالُ خَيْرٍ وَرُشْدٍ هِلَالُ خَيْرٍ وَرُشْدٍ هِلَالُ خَيْرٍ وَرُشْدٍ آمَنْتُ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ» ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي ذَهَبَ بِشَهْرِ كَذَا وَجَاء بِشَهْر كَذَا»
units.en: Kutadah. It reached me, that the Prophet used to say (when he saw the new moon) thrice, "good new moon, shower of the right road:" and he would say thrice, "I believe in him who created thee;" and then would say, "thanks be to God, who ended such a moon, and brought such a one."
units.en2: Qatāda narrates: It reached me that the Prophet ﷺ, when he saw the new moon, used to say three times: "Good new moon, bringer of the right road"; and he would say three times: "I believe in Him who created you"; and then would say: "Thanks be to God, who ended such-and-such a moon and brought such-and-such a one."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " مَنْ كَثُرَ هَمُّهُ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ أَلْهَمْتَ عِبَادَكَ أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي مَكْنُونِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قلبِي وجِلاء هَمِّي وغَمِّي مَا قَالَهَا عَبْدٌ قَطُّ إِلَّا أَذْهَبَ اللَّهُ غمه وأبدله فرجا "
units.en: Ibn-Mas'ud. A. G. s. "Whoever is in sorrow must say, O Lord! I am thy servant, and the son of thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid, and I am in the hand of thy power; and the hair of my forehead is in the hand of thy power; thy orders pass on me; thy decree is just; I supplicate thee by every name which is for thee, by which thou hast called thyself, or which thou hast revealed, in thy own book, or which are especially appropriated to thee in the recess of secrecy; I supplicate thee, to make the Koran a spring in my heart, and a cause of removing my sorrow:" and no servant shall ever repeat these words but God will take away his grief and sorrow; and give him rest in exchange for them.
units.en2: Ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever is in sorrow should say: 'O Lord! I am Your servant, and the son of Your servant, and the son of Your handmaid; I am in Your power; the hair of my forehead is in Your hand; Your orders pass over me; Your decree is just. I supplicate You by every name that is Yours, by which You have called Yourself, or which You revealed in Your book, or which You have kept especially in the recesses of the unseen — I supplicate You to make the Qur'an a spring in my heart and a cause of removing my sorrow.' And no servant ever repeats these words without God taking away his grief and sorrow and giving him rest in exchange for them."

units.ar: وَعَن جابرٍ قَالَ: كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سبحنا
units.en: Ja'bir said, "we used, when going upon high ground, to say allaho acber, and when we came down, to say, Subhan-allah."
units.en2: Jābir narrates: We used, when going up onto high ground, to say "God is greatest," and when we came down, to say "Glory be to God."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا كَرَبَهُ أَمْرٌ يَقُولُ: «يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ»
units.en: Anas said, "verily the messenger of God, would say, when any matter made him melancholy, O thou actual liver! O keeper alive of the creation! I complain to thy mercy and kindness."
units.en2: Anas narrates: When any matter made the Messenger of God ﷺ anxious, he would say: "O Ever-Living! O Self-Subsisting, Keeper of creation! I appeal for help to Your mercy and kindness."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْنَا يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَقُولُهُ؟ فَقَدْ بَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِنَا وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِنَا» قَالَ: فَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ وُجُوهَ أَعْدَائِهِ بِالرِّيحِ وَهَزَمَ اللَّهُ بِالرِّيحِ
units.en: Abu-Sa'id-Khudhri said, "I said, on the day of the battle of the ditch, O messenger of God! is there any thing for me to say, in order to open my work? for verily our hearts are in our throats." He said, "yes there is a thing for you to say, O Lord! cover our vices and guard us from fear." Then God struck the faces of his enemies with a wind, which he sent, and broke their army with it.
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates: I said, on the day of the battle of the Trench, "O Messenger of God! Is there anything for me to say, to open up our work? For truly our hearts are in our throats." He said, "Yes, there is a thing for you to say: 'O Lord! Cover our faults and guard us from fear.'" Then God struck the faces of His enemies with a wind He sent, and broke their army with it.

units.ar: وَعَن بُرَيْدَة قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا دَخَلَ السُّوقَ قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ السُّوقِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُصِيبَ فِيهَا صَفْقَةً خَاسِرَةً»
units.en: Buraidah said, "his highness used to say, when he came into a bazar, I am come in, in the name of God; O Lord! I ask thee for the good of this bazar, and for the good of the thing which is in it; I seek protection with thee from the harms of this bazar, and the thing that is in it, O Lord! I seek protection with thee from losing any thing by buying or selling in this bazar."
units.en2: Burayda narrates: The Prophet ﷺ used to say, when he came into a bazaar: "I have come in, in the name of God. O Lord! I ask You for the good of this bazaar and the good of what is in it; I seek Your protection from the harms of this bazaar and what is in it. O Lord! I seek Your protection from losing anything by buying or selling in this bazaar."

sections.heading: On Asking Asylum (Matthews, Book X, Ch. VII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter VII of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 588-593. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter on seeking God's protection (reports 2457-2481); Matthews omits the cross-reference note 2465.

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوءِ القضاءِ وشَماتة الْأَعْدَاء»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. A. G. s. "Seek protection with God, from the distresses of calamity, and from difficulties and hardships, and from a bad fate, and from the gladness of the enemies of religion in this world."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Seek protection with God from the distresses of calamity, from difficulties and hardships, from a bad fate, and from the gladness of the enemies of religion in this world."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحُزْنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ»
units.en: Anas said, "the Prophet used to say, O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee, from sorrow, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and greediness, and from a heavy load of debt; and from being overcome by debtors."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from sorrow, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and greed, from a heavy load of debt, and from being overcome by creditors."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ وَفِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمغْرب»
units.en: Aayeshah said, "the Prophet used to say, O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee from laziness, decrepitude and debt; and from any thing by which I should err. O Lord! I seek protection with thee from the punishment of the fire, and from that thing which is a cause of it: O Lord! I seek protection with thee from the punishment of the grave, and from the thing causing it; and from the evils and contentions of riches; and harms of poverty; and from the wickedness of Dajjal: O Lord! wash my sins with ice-water, and hail-water; and purify my heart, as is white cloth, from dirt; and make the distance between me and faults far, as the east from the west."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from laziness, decrepitude, and debt, and from anything by which I might err. O Lord! I seek Your protection from the punishment of the Fire and from what causes it; O Lord! I seek Your protection from the punishment of the grave and from what causes it; from the evils and temptations of riches and the harms of poverty; and from the wickedness of the Dajjāl. O Lord! Wash away my sins with ice-water and hail-water, and purify my heart as a white cloth is purified from dirt; and put between me and faults a distance as far as the east from the west."

units.ar: وَعَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَاب لَهَا»
units.en: Zayd-ibn-Arkum said, "the Prophet would say, O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and greediness, and age, and the punishment of the grave: O Lord! give my soul continence and abstinence; and purify it; thou art the best purifier; thou art master of possession, and Lord of aid. O Lord! I seek protection with thee from useless knowledge, and a heart that fears not, and from an insatiable soul, and from a disapproved supplication."
units.en2: Zayd ibn Arqam narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and greed, from old age, and the punishment of the grave. O Lord! Give my soul piety and abstinence, and purify it — You are the best purifier; You are the Master of its charge and the Lord of aid. O Lord! I seek Your protection from useless knowledge, from a heart that does not fear, from an insatiable soul, and from a supplication that is not answered."

units.ar: وَعَن عبد بنِ عمرَ قَالَ: كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ سوسلم: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ»
units.en: Abdullah-ibn-Omer said, "this was one of the number of the Prophet's supplications: O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from the decline of the property which thou hast given me; and from the loss of the health which I have, and from the suddenness of thy reprimands, and from all thy displeasures."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar narrates: This was one of the Prophet's ﷺ supplications: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from the decline of the blessings You have given me, from the loss of the health I have, from the suddenness of Your reprisals, and from all Your displeasures."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أعمَلْ»
units.en: Aayeshah said, "the Prophet used to say, O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from the badness of the actions I have done, and from those I may do."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from the evil of the deeds I have done and from those I may yet do."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالْإِنْسُ يموتون»الْفَصْل الثَّانِي
units.en: Ibn Abbas. Verily the Prophet would say, "O Lord! for thee have I embraced Islam, and believe in thee, and put my whole trust in thee, and turn myself unto thee and fight by thy aid. O Lord! I ask protection in thy strength, that I may not be led astray: there is no God but thee, thou art alive, and dost not die, and Genii and men all die."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! For You have I embraced Islam, in You I believe, upon You I put my whole trust, to You I turn, and by Your aid I strive. O Lord! I ask protection in Your strength, that I may not be led astray — there is no god but You; You are alive and do not die, while jinn and men all die."

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: " اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْأَرْبَعِ: مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ "
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the Prophet would say, O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from four things; from useless knowledge, from a heart that fears not God, from a soul insatiable with the world, and from a supplication that shall not be heard."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from four things: from useless knowledge, from a heart that does not fear God, from a soul insatiable with the world, and from a supplication that will not be heard."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ خَمْسٍ: مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَسُوءِ الْعُمُرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الصَّدْرِ وَعَذَابِ القَبرِ
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khattab said, "the Prophet used to seek protection from five things; from cowardice, greediness, the badness of decrepitude, from bad thoughts falling into the breast, from the punishment of the grave."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek protection from five things: from cowardice, greed, the evil of decrepitude, from the temptation of the heart, and from the punishment of the grave.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ وَالذِّلَّةِ وَأَعُوذُ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah. Verily the Prophet would say, "O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from poverty, and from little good, and from being despicable, and from my oppressing or being oppressed."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from poverty, from having little good, from being despised, and from my oppressing or being oppressed."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشِّقَاقِ وَالنِّفَاقِ وَسُوءِ الْأَخْلَاقِ»
units.en: Ab'uhurairah. A. G. s. "O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from the enmity of the people of religion, and from hypocrisy, and from bad dispositions."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from the enmity of the people of religion, from hypocrisy, and from bad character."

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِطَانَةُ»
units.en: Ab'uhurairah. A. G. s. "O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from hunger, because it is a bad bed-fellow; and from perfidy, because verily it is a bad lining."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from hunger — it is a bad bedfellow; and from treachery — for it is a bad inner garment."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الأسقام»
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from leprosy, and from Elephantiasis, and from madness."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from leprosy, from elephantiasis, from madness, and from the evil of diseases."

units.ar: وَعَن قُطْبةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاق والأعمال والأهواء»
units.en: Qutba-bin-Malik. A. G. s. "O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee, from bad propensities, and actions, and desires."
units.en2: Quṭba ibn Mālik narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from blameworthy inclinations, deeds, and desires."

units.ar: وَعَنْ شُتَيْرِ بْنِ شَكَلِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيه قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي تَعْوِيذًا أَتَعَوَّذُ بِهِ قَالَ: «قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بك من شَرّ سَمْعِي وَمن شَرّ بَصَرِي وَشَرِّ لِسَانِي وَشَرِّ قَلْبِي وَشَرِّ مَنِيِّي»
units.en: Shutair-bin-Shakal-bin-Humaid relates from his father, who said, I said, "O Prophet teach me a thing to seek protection by." He said, "say O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from hearing bad words, and from bad sights, and from a bad tongue, and from a bad heart, and from the badness of fornication."
units.en2: Shuṭayr ibn Shakal ibn Humayd relates from his father, who said: I said, "O Prophet, teach me a thing to seek protection by." He said: "Say: O Lord! I seek Your protection from hearing evil words, from evil sights, from an evil tongue, from an evil heart, and from the evil of fornication."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي الْيُسْر أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَدْعُو: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَدْمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ التَّرَدِّي وَمِنَ الْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرْقِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَمُوتَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِرًا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَمُوتَ لَدِيغًا» رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ وَزَادَ فِي رِوَايَةٍ أُخْرَى «الْغم»
units.en: Abu'l Yasar said, "verily the Prophet used to supplicate by this supplication, O Lord! I seek protection with thee, from dying under a fallen wall, and from falling from a high place, and from being drowned in water, and burnt in fire, and from the devil's casting bad thoughts into me at the time of my death, and from my dying in thy road a retreater, and from my dying by the bite of a snake, scorpion, and such like."
units.en2: Abū'l-Yasar narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate with this supplication: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from dying under a fallen wall, from falling from a high place, from being drowned in water, and burned in fire; from the devil casting evil thoughts into me at the time of my death; from dying in Your way as a deserter; and from dying by the bite of a snake, a scorpion, and the like."

units.ar: وَعَنْ مُعَاذٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " أستعيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ طَمَعٍ يَهْدِي إِلَى طَبَعٍ)
units.en: Mu'adh. A. G. s. "Seek protection with God from ambition, leading to the way of loss in religion."
units.en2: Muʿādh narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Seek God's protection from greed that leads to waywardness in religion."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَظَرَ إِلَى الْقَمَرِ فَقَالَ: «يَا عَائِشَةُ اسْتَعِيذِي بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا فَإِنَّ هَذَا هُوَ الْغَاسِقُ إِذا وَقب»
units.en: Aayeshah said, "verily the Prophet looked towards us, and said, O Aayeshah! seek protection with God from the harm of the moon; because he is a caster of darkness when eclipsed."
units.en2: ʿĀʾisha narrates that the Prophet ﷺ looked toward the moon and said: "O ʿĀʾisha! Seek God's protection from the evil of this — for this is the darkness-caster when it falls."

units.ar: وَعَن عمرانَ بنِ حُصينٍ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لأبي: «يَا حُصَيْن كم تعبد الْيَوْم إِلَهًا؟» قَالَ أَبِي: سَبْعَةً: سِتًّا فِي الْأَرْضِ وواحداً فِي السَّماءِ قَالَ: «فَأَيُّهُمْ تَعُدُّ لِرَغْبَتِكَ وَرَهْبَتِكَ؟» قَالَ: الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ قَالَ: «يَا حُصَيْنُ أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَوْ أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَّمْتُكَ كَلِمَتَيْنِ تَنْفَعَانِكَ» قَالَ: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَ حُصينٌ قَالَ: يَا رسولَ الله علِّمني الكلمتينِ اللَّتينِ وَعَدتنِي فَقَالَ: «قل اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي»
units.en: Imran-bin-Husain said, "the Prophet said to my father, before he became a Musleman, O Husain! how many gods have you worshipped to-day?" He said, "seven; six gods in the earth, and one in the regions." The Prophet said, "then which of them is it you have hope from, and are in awe of?" Husain said, "he who is in the regions." His highness said, "O Husain! beware; verily if you were a Musleman, I would teach you two sayings, which would be advantageous to you." Imran says, "then when my father became a Musleman he said, O Prophet! teach me the two sayings which you promised." His highness said, "say O Lord! throw truth into my heart, and give me protection from the badness of my appetites."
units.en2: ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn narrates: The Prophet ﷺ said to my father before he became a Muslim, "O Ḥuṣayn! How many gods have you worshipped today?" He said, "Seven — six gods on earth, and one in the heavens." The Prophet said, "Then which of them do you hope from and stand in awe of?" Ḥuṣayn said, "The one in the heavens." The Prophet said, "O Ḥuṣayn! Mind — if you were a Muslim, I would teach you two sayings that would profit you." ʿImrān says: Then when my father became a Muslim, he said, "O Prophet!
