Teach me the two sayings you promised." He said: "Say: O Lord! Cast truth into my heart, and give me protection from the evil of my appetites."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: " إِذَا فَزِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي النَّوْمِ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونَ فَإِنَّهَا لَنْ تَضُرَّهُ «وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو يُعَلِّمُهَا مَنْ بَلَغَ مِنْ وَلَدِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَبْلُغْ مِنْهُمْ كَتَبَهَا فِي صَكٍّ ثُمَّ عَلَّقَهَا فِي عُنُقِهِ»
units.en: Amr-bin-Shu'aib relates from his fathers, that "verily the Prophet said, when any one of you is frightened in your sleep, he must say, I seek protection in the words of God, which are perfect, from God's anger and punishment, and from the evils of God's servants, and from bad thoughts, which the devil throws into the heart, and from the presence of devils. Then, verily the devils can do no detriment to the speaker of these words." Abdullah-bin-Omer used to teach these words, to those of riper years, of his children, or otherwise; and would write them on a piece of paper, and suspend it to his children's necks.
units.en2: ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb relates from his forefathers that the Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you is frightened in his sleep, he should say: 'I seek protection in the perfect words of God from God's anger and punishment, from the evils of God's servants, from the evil whispers the devil casts into the heart, and from the presence of devils.' Then the devils can do no harm to the speaker of these words." ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar used to teach these words to those of his children who were of riper years, and would write them on a piece of paper and suspend it from his children's necks.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " مَنْ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ الْجَنَّةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ: اللَّهُمَّ أَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنِ اسْتَجَارَ مِنَ النَّارِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالَتِ النَّارُ: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْهُ مِنَ النَّارِ "
units.en: Anas. A. G. s. "Whoever asks paradise of God thrice, paradise says, O Lord bring him into me; and whoever seeks safety from hell, hell says, O Lord! preserve him from the fire."
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever asks God for Paradise three times, Paradise says, 'O Lord, bring him into me'; and whoever seeks safety from Hell, Hell says, 'O Lord! Preserve him from the Fire.'"

units.ar: عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ: أَنَّ كَعْبَ الْأَحْبَارِ قَالَ: لَوْلَا كَلِمَاتٌ أَقُولُهُنَّ لَجَعَلَتْنِي يَهُودُ حِمَارًا فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مَا هُنَّ؟ قَالَ: أَعُوذُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِي لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَعْظَمَ مِنْهُ وَبِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجاوزُهنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فاجرٌ وَبِأَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَذَرَأَ وبرأ
units.en: Kakaa said, verily Ka'b-al-Ah'bar said, "if it was not for some words which I say, verily the Jews would make me an ass." And it was said to him, "what are the words?" He said, "these, I seek protection with God, than whom there is nothing greater; and by the words of God, which no person can surpass, neither good nor bad; and I seek protection by the names of God, which are better than all names, those that I know and those that I do not know; I seek protection from the evils of the things which God has created, and scattered about, and brought into creation from nothing."
units.en2: Al-Qaʿqāʿ narrates that Kaʿb al-Aḥbār said: "Were it not for some words I say, the Jews would have made me an ass." It was said to him, "What are the words?" He said: "These: 'I seek protection with God, than whom there is nothing greater; and by the words of God which no one can surpass, neither the good nor the bad; and I seek protection by the names of God, which are better than all names, those I know and those I do not know; I seek protection from the evils of the things God has created and scattered about and brought into creation from nothing.'"

units.ar: وَعَن مُسلم بن أبي بَكرةَ قَالَ: كَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلَاةِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِن أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ فَكُنْتُ أَقُولُهُنَّ فَقَالَ: أَيْ بُنَيَّ عَمَّنْ أَخَذْتَ هَذَا؟ قُلْتُ: عَنْكَ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يقولهُنَّ فِي دُبرِ الصَّلاةِ
units.en: Muslim-bin-Abu'Bacrah said, "my father used to say, after every prayer, O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee, from infidelity, power and the punishments of the grave:" and I used to say these words; then my father said, "O my son! who did you take these from?" I said, "from you." He said, "verily the Prophet used to repeat them after prayers."
units.en2: Muslim ibn Abī Bakra narrates: My father used to say after every prayer, "O Lord! I seek Your protection from unbelief, poverty, and the punishments of the grave"; and I used to say these words. Then my father said, "My son! Whom did you take these from?" I said, "From you." He said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to repeat them after prayers."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالدَّيْنِ» فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَعْدِلُ الْكُفْرَ بِالدَّيْنِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» . وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ» . قَالَ رَجُلٌ: وَيُعْدَلَانِ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ»
units.en: Abu-Sa'id said, "I heard the prophet say, I seek protection with God, from infidelity and debt:" and a man said, "O messenger of God! do you compare infidelity with debt?" He said, "yes, because debt causes lying, and acting contrary to promise; and these are the characteristics of infidels." And in one tradition we have this: "O Lord! verily I seek protection with thee from infidelity and poverty." A man said, in the way of question, "are infidelity and poverty made equal?" His highness said, "yes, they are equal; because poverty sometimes draws to infidelity."
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd narrates: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, "I seek protection with God from unbelief and debt"; and a man said, "O Messenger of God! Do you equate unbelief with debt?" He said, "Yes — because debt causes lying and acting contrary to promise, and these are the characteristics of unbelievers." And in one narration we have: "O Lord! I seek Your protection from unbelief and poverty." A man asked, "Are unbelief and poverty equal?" He said, "Yes, they are equal, because poverty sometimes draws toward unbelief."

sections.heading: On Supplications for All Desires and Wishes (Matthews, Book X, Ch. VIII)
sections.note: Matthews' chapter VIII of his Book X, printed 1809, pages 593-598. The reports correspond to the Mishkāt's chapter of comprehensive supplications (reports 2482-2504), complete.

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ: «اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جَدِّي وَهَزْلِي وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي وكلُّ ذلكَ عِنْدِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أعلنت وَمَا أَنْت بِهِ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ وَأَنت على كل شَيْء قدير»
units.en: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari relates, that the Prophet supplicated by this supplication: "O Lord! pardon my faults, and the works which I may have done through ignorance; and forgive my lavishing away; and pardon my sins, which thou knowest better than me; O Lord! pardon me my inconsiderate speaking, and blundering; and forgive my wicked labours and intentions, and all these are my characteristics: O Lord! pardon me the faults which I have done before, and shall do after, and those which I have discovered and concealed; and those which thou knowest better than me, thou art the first and the last, and powerful over every thing."
units.en2: Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī relates that the Prophet ﷺ supplicated with this supplication: "O Lord! Pardon my faults and the works I may have done through ignorance; forgive my excess; and pardon my sins, which You know better than I. O Lord! Pardon my inconsiderate speaking and blundering; forgive my wicked labours and intentions — all these are in my character. O Lord! Pardon me the faults I have done before and shall do after, those I have disclosed and those I have concealed, and those You know better than I — You are the First and the Last, and powerful over everything."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the Prophet would say, O Lord! make my religion prosper, because it is a preventer of faults and punishments; and make the things of the world good for me, in which is my being; and make my latter end good, in which is my return, and make life a means of increase for me in every good, and make life a cause of deliverance for me from every evil."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! Set my religion right for me, for it is the preventer of faults and punishments; and set right the things of this world, in which is my living; and set right my latter end, in which is my return; and make life a means of increase for me in every good, and make death a cause of deliverance for me from every evil."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى»
units.en: Abdullah-ibn-Masu'ud. A. G. s. "O Lord! I wish from thee the right road, and continence; and to refrain from all things prohibited; and I supplicate thee for riches; in property and mind."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Lord! I ask You for the right road, and continence, and to refrain from all things prohibited; and I ask You for riches in property and in mind."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «قُلْ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي وَاذْكُرْ بِالْهُدَى هِدَايَتَكَ الطَّرِيقَ وبالسداد سداد السهْم»
units.en: Ali-ibn-Abu Talib. A. G. s. to me, say "O Lord! shew me the straight road, and make me a doer of straight actions; and remember in the meaning of asking the right road, conceive a straight road; and when asking for straightness of actions, remember the straightness of an arrow."
units.en2: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: Say, "O Lord! Show me the straight road, and make me a doer of straight deeds; and when asking for the right road, conceive a straight road; and when asking for straightness of actions, remember the straightness of an arrow."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: كَانَ الرجل إِذا أسلم علمه النَّبِي صلى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: «اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي»
units.en: Abu Malik-al-Ash'ari relates from his fathers, when a man embraced Islam, the Prophet would teach him the prayers, and then ordered him to supplicate in these words: "O Lord! pardon me, and have mercy on me, and shew me the straight road, and give me health, and daily bread."
units.en2: Abū Mālik al-Ashʿarī relates from his forefathers: When a man embraced Islam, the Prophet ﷺ would teach him the prayers, and then ordered him to supplicate in these words: "O Lord! Pardon me, have mercy on me, show me the straight road, and give me health and daily bread."

units.ar: وَعَن أنسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ أَكْثَرُ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وقنا عَذَاب النَّار»الْفَصْل الثَّانِي
units.en: Anas said, this was a general supplication of the Prophet's, "O Lord! give me good, in the world and in futurity; and defend me from the punishment of the fire."
units.en2: Anas narrates that this was the Prophet's ﷺ all-embracing supplication: "O Lord! Give me good in this world and in the hereafter, and defend me from the punishment of the Fire."

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدْعُو يَقُولُ: «رَبِّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ وَانْصُرْنِي وَلَا تَنْصُرْ عَلَيَّ وَامْكُرْ لِي وَلَا تَمْكُرْ عَلَيَّ وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرِ الْهُدَى لِي وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ بَغَى عَلَيَّ ربِّ اجعَلني لكَ شَاكِرًا لَكَ ذَاكِرًا لَكَ رَاهِبًا لَكَ مِطْوَاعًا لَكَ مُخْبِتًا إِلَيْكَ أَوَّاهًا مُنِيبًا رَبِّ تَقَبَّلْ تَوْبَتِي وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتِي وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي وَثَبِّتْ حُجَّتِي وَسَدِّدْ لِسَانِي وَاهْدِ قَلْبِي وَاسْلُلْ سَخِيمَةَ صَدْرِي»
units.en: Ibn Abbas said, "his highness would supplicate, and say, O Lord! aid me against my enemies, and aid not my enemies against me; and give me victory over my enemies, and give not my enemies victory over me; and send calamity to my enemies, and not to me; and shew me the straight road; make my going straight easy to me, and give me assistance over those that have oppressed me; O my patron! make me a thanks-giver to thee, and a repeater of thy name; and a fearer of thee, and a great obeyer of thee, and a great humbler of myself before thee; and a complainer and repenter to thee. O Lord! accept my repentance, and wash away my sins, and approve my supplication; and strengthen my proofs, and make my tongue true; and shew my heart the straight road; and draw away the blackness of my heart."
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would supplicate and say: "O Lord! Aid me against my enemies, and aid not my enemies against me; give me victory over my enemies, and give not my enemies victory over me; and send calamity to my enemies, and not to me; show me the straight road; make my going straight easy for me; and give me assistance over those who have oppressed me. O my Lord! Make me a thanks-giver to You, a rememberer of Your name, a fearer of You, a great obeyer of You, a great humbler of myself before You, and a complainer and repenter to You. O Lord! Accept my repentance, wash away my sins, answer my supplication, strengthen my proofs, make my tongue true, guide my heart to the straight road, and draw away the blackness of my heart."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي بكرٍ قَالَ: قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ بَكَى فَقَالَ: «سَلُوا اللَّهَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فَإِنَّ أَحَدًا لَمْ يُعْطَ بَعْدَ الْيَقِينِ خَيْرًا مِنَ الْعَافِيَةِ»
units.en: Abu Bakr said, "the Prophet stood upon the pulpit, and then cried and said, ask God remission of your sins, and safety from calamity; because, no one has been given (after faith in God, and his messenger) a better benefit than health."
units.en2: Abū Bakr narrates: The Prophet ﷺ stood upon the pulpit, and then wept, and said: "Ask God for remission of your sins and safety from calamity, for no one has been given — after faith in God and His messenger — a better benefit than health."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الدُّعَاءِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: «سَلْ رَبَّكَ الْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ» ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فِي الْيَوْمِ الثَّانِي فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الدُّعَاءِ أَفْضَلُ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فِي الْيَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ: «فَإِذَا أُعْطِيتَ الْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَقَدْ أَفْلَحْتَ»
units.en: Anas relates that "a man came to the Prophet and said, O prophet! what supplication is most advantageous?" He said, "ask God safety from calamities, and to keep thee in safety from the vexation of man, and to give to man safety from thy disturbances; to give thee safety in the world and futurity." After that, the man came to his highness, the second day, and said, "O messenger of God! what is the best supplication?" He gave him the same answer as on the first day. After that, the man came on the third day, and asked the same question; and received the like answer; and his highness said, "when you are given safety in the world and futurity, verily you have found redemption."
units.en2: Anas relates: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Prophet! What supplication is most advantageous?" He said, "Ask God for safety from calamities, to keep you safe from the vexation of men, and to give men safety from your disturbances — to give you safety in this world and the next." Then the man came to him the second day and said, "O Messenger of God! What is the best supplication?" He gave him the same answer as the first day. Then the man came on the third day and asked the same question, and received the like answer; and the Prophet said: "When you are given safety in this world and the next, truly you have found redemption."

units.ar: وَعَن عبد الله يزِيد الخطمي عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَنْفَعُنِي حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ اللَّهُمَّ مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي مِمَّا أحب فاجعله فراغا ي فِيمَا تحب»
units.en: Abdullah-bin Yezid Khatmi relates, that "his highness said, in his supplications, O Lord give me thy friendship, and the friendship of him that may be useful to me towards thee, O Lord! the thing which I liked thou hast given me; then make it a cause of my capability in that which I love. O Lord! the thing which thou hast drawn from me which I loved, make it not a preventative of the thing which you like."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn Yazīd al-Khaṭmī relates that the Prophet ﷺ said in his supplications: "O Lord, give me Your friendship, and the friendship of those who may be useful to me toward You. O Lord! The thing which I liked, You have given me — so make it a cause of my strength in what I love. O Lord! The thing You have drawn from me which I loved — make it no barrier against the thing You love."

units.ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: قَلَّمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُومُ مِنْ مَجْلِسٍ حَتَّى يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلَاءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ لِأَصْحَابِهِ: «اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيْبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا»
units.en: Ibn-Omer said, "it was seldom that his highness stood up in an assembly, till he supplicated for his friends, in this supplication, O Lord! apportion to us of thy fear, that which will be a partition between us and our sins. O Lord! give us, of thy obedience, that which will bring us to thy paradise; and give us of the truth, by which the misfortunes of the world shall be easy on us, and make us fortunate in our hearing and sight, our strength and capability, so long as thou keepest us alive; and constitute an heir of our race, and make us powerful to punish tyrants, and give us victory over those that abuse us, and make no misfortunes in our religion; and make not the world the greatest of our griefs; and do not make the world the end of our knowledge; and let not rulers be over us, that would have no mercy upon us."
units.en2: Ibn ʿUmar narrates: The Prophet ﷺ would seldom stand up in an assembly without supplicating for his companions with this supplication: "O Lord! Apportion to us of Your fear that which will be a partition between us and our sins. O Lord! Give us, of Your obedience, that which will bring us to Your paradise; and give us such certainty that the misfortunes of the world become easy upon us; and make us blessed in our hearing and sight, our strength and capability, so long as You keep us alive; and make an heir of our posterity; and make us powerful to punish tyrants; and give us victory over those who abuse us; and make no misfortunes in our religion; and make not the world the greatest of our griefs, nor the end of our knowledge; and let not rulers be set over us who would have no mercy upon us."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ حَالِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ»
units.en: Abu Hurairah said, "the Prophet used to say, O Lord benefit me by that which thou hast taught me; and teach me what will benefit me, and increase my knowledge: thanks to God in every state: I seek protection with God, from the condition of the people of hell."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates that the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "O Lord, benefit me by what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me, and increase my knowledge. Thanks be to God in every state; and I seek God's protection from the condition of the people of Hell."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْيُ سُمِعَ عِنْدَ وَجْهِهِ دوِي كَدَوِيِّ النَّحْل فأنل عَلَيْهِ يَوْمًا فَمَكَثْنَا سَاعَةً فَسُرِّيَ عَنْهُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ وَقَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا وَأَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا وَأَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا وَآثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا وَأَرْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا» . ثُمَّ قَالَ: «أُنْزِلَ عَلَيَّ عَشْرُ آيَاتٍ مَنْ أَقَامَهُنَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ» ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ) حَتَّى خَتَمَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ
units.en: Omer ibn-al-Khattab said, "when instructions from above were sent down to the Prophet, a noise was heard from the side of his face, like the noise of bees; then instructions were sent down one day, and we stayed a Sa'at, and the noise was removed; and his highness turned himself to the Kiblah and raised up both his hands, and said, O Lord! increase our worldly and future benefits, and do not diminish them; and keep us high, not mean; and give us good of the world and futurity; and do not disappoint us; and give us strength to discharge religion, and allow not our enemies to overcome us; and make us satisfied with thee; that is, give us such that we may be satisfied with, and be pleased with us, that we may do such works as may be the cause of your pleasure." After that, his highness said, "ten revelations have been sent down to me; and whoever acts by them shall enter into paradise." After that the Prophet repeated the chapter commencing "Now are the true believers happy," till he completed ten verses of this chapter.
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: When revelations from above were sent down to the Prophet ﷺ, a noise was heard from beside his face, like the noise of bees; then instructions were sent down one day, and we stayed a while, and the noise was removed; and he turned himself to the Qibla, raised both his hands, and said: "O Lord! Increase our worldly and future benefits, and do not diminish them; keep us high, not low; give us the good of this world and the next, and do not disappoint us; give us strength to discharge religion, and let not our enemies overcome us; make us satisfied with You — give us such that we may be satisfied with, and be pleased with us, that we may do such works as may be the cause of Your pleasure." After that the Prophet said: "Ten verses have been sent down to me; whoever acts by them shall enter Paradise." Then the Prophet recited the chapter beginning "Now are the true believers happy" until he completed ten verses of that chapter.

units.ar: عَن عثمانَ بنِ حُنَيفٍ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَجُلًا ضَرِيرَ الْبَصَرِ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُعَافِيَنِي فَقَالَ: «إِنْ شِئْتَ دَعَوْتُ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ صَبَرْتَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» . قَالَ: فَادْعُهُ قَالَ: فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ فَيُحْسِنَ الْوُضُوءَ وَيَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ وَأَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ إِنِّي تَوَجَّهْتُ بِكَ إِلَى رَبِّي لِيَقْضِيَ لِي فِي حَاجَتِي هَذِهِ اللهُمَّ فشفّعْه فيَّ»
units.en: Othman-bin-Hunif said, "verily a blind man came to the Prophet, and said, pray God to cure me of blindness." His highness said, "if you wish it, I will supplicate; and, if you chuse, have patience; therefore your patience in your blindness is better for you, on account of future rewards; because its reward is paradise." The man said, "I wish for cure; then supplicate God." Then his highness ordered the man to perform Wadu properly, and to supplicate by this: "O Lord verily I supplicate, and turn my face towards thee, by the means of thy Prophet, whose name is Muh'ammed, and thou didst send him for compassion to many kind: verily I have turned my face towards thee, on thy account, that he may order in my necessities; O Lord! then accept his supplication in my favor."
units.en2: ʿUthmān ibn Ḥunayf narrates: A blind man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Pray God to cure me of blindness." He said, "If you wish, I will supplicate; and if you choose, have patience — your patience in your blindness is better for you, on account of future rewards, for its reward is Paradise." The man said, "I wish for cure — so supplicate God." Then the Prophet ordered the man to perform wudu properly, and to supplicate thus: "O Lord, truly I supplicate and turn my face toward You by means of Your Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ, whom You sent as a mercy to many kinds; truly I have turned my face toward You on his account, that he may order my necessities; O Lord! Then accept his intercession in my favour."

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ دَاوُدَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي وَمَالِي وَأَهْلِي وَمِنَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ» . قَالَ: وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا ذَكَرَ دَاوُدَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْهُ يَقُولُ: «كَانَ أَعْبَدَ الْبَشَرِ»
units.en: Abu-Dardaa. A. G. s. "This was of the number of David the Prophet's supplications: O Lord! I wish for thy friendship, and for that of him whom thou considerest as a friend, and I wish for a deed to cause me to reach thy friendship. O Lord! make thy friendship more friendly to me than the friendship for myself, my property, and family, and than cold water to the thirsty." And Abu-Dardaa said, the Prophet used, when he mentioned David, and when relating from him, to say, "David was the greatest adorer of his time."
units.en2: Abū al-Dardāʾ narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: This was among the supplications of David the Prophet: "O Lord! I ask for Your friendship, and for that of him whom You consider a friend, and I ask for a deed that will cause me to reach Your friendship. O Lord! Make Your friendship dearer to me than the friendship of myself, my property, and family, and than cold water to the thirsty." And Abū al-Dardāʾ said: The Prophet ﷺ used, when he mentioned David and related from him, to say, "David was the greatest worshipper of his time."

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ صَلَاةً فَأَوْجَزَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ: لَقَدْ خَفَّفْتَ وَأَوْجَزْتَ الصَّلَاةَ فَقَالَ أَمَا عَلَيَّ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ فِيهَا بِدَعَوَاتٍ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمَّا قَامَ تَبِعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ هُوَ أَبِي غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَنَّى عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الدُّعَاءِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَأَخْبَرَ بِهِ الْقَوْمَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ وقُدرتِكَ على الخَلقِ أَحْيني مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْرًا لِي اللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَى وَالْغَضَبِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَى بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ وَالشَّوْقِ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ اللَّهُمَّ زِيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الْإِيمَانِ وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مَهْدِيِّينَ»
units.en: Ata-bin-Sa'ib relates, from his father, who said, "I performed prayers with Ammar-bin-Yasir, and he was concise in supplicating; and some of those present said to Ammar, verily you have performed prayers, quick, and abbreviated." He said, "this abbreviation and conciseness is not a means of loss to me; verily I supplicated, in these prayers, by supplications which I heard from the Prophet." Then, when Ammar got up, my father followed him and asked him about the supplications; after that my father came, and informed people of it; it is this, "O Lord! I supplicate thee, by thy mysterious knowledge and thy power in creation, keep me alive as long as thou knowest it best for me; and give me death when thou judgest it best for me. O Lord! I supplicate thee for thy fear, externally and internally; and I supplicate thee for truth in pleasure and anger; and for a medium in riches and poverty, and for eternal benefit; and for a family which shall not be extinct, to the day of resurrection; and I supplicate thee for satisfaction with fate, and for rest after dying, and the delight of beholding thy face, and for desire to meet thee without its being detrimental to me: keep me alive without calamity: O Lord adorn me with the ornament of Iman; and make me a shower of the right road to others."
units.en2: ʿAṭāʾ ibn al-Sāʾib relates from his father, who said: "I performed prayers with ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir, and he was concise in supplicating; and some of those present said to ʿAmmār, 'You have performed prayers quickly and abbreviated.' He said, 'This abbreviation is no loss to me — truly I supplicated in these prayers with supplications I heard from the Prophet ﷺ.' Then when ʿAmmār got up, my father followed him and asked him about the supplications; after that my father came and informed people of it. It is this: 'O Lord! I ask You, by Your hidden knowledge and Your power in creation, keep me alive as long as You know it best for me, and give me death when You judge it best for me. O Lord! I ask You for Your fear, outwardly and inwardly; and I ask You for truth in pleasure and anger; and for the middle way in riches and poverty; and for eternal benefit; and for posterity that shall not be extinct until the Day of Resurrection; and I ask You for satisfaction with fate, and for rest after dying, and the delight of beholding Your face, and for longing to meet You without its being detrimental to me — keep me alive without calamity. O Lord, adorn me with the ornament of faith, and make me a guide of the right road to others.'"

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا»
units.en: Omm-Salmah. "Verily the Prophet would say, after morning prayer, O Lord! I supplicate thee for profitable knowledge, and approved actions, and pure sustenance."
units.en2: Umm Salama narrates: After the morning prayer the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord! I ask You for profitable knowledge, approved actions, and pure sustenance."

units.ar: وَعَن أبي هريرةَ قَالَ: دُعَاءٌ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَا أَدَعُهُ: «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أُعْظِمُ شُكْرَكَ وَأُكْثِرُ ذِكْرَكَ وَأَتَّبِعُ نُصْحَكَ وَأَحْفَظُ وصيتك»
units.en: Ab'uhurairah said, "I remember a supplication of his highness, which I shall not abandon, O Lord! make me to be verily grateful for thy benefits, and to repeat thy name often, and follow thy advice, and guard thy admonition."
units.en2: Abū Hurayra narrates: I remember a supplication of the Prophet ﷺ which I shall never abandon: "O Lord! Make me truly grateful for Your benefits, to repeat Your name often, to follow Your counsel, and to guard Your admonition."

units.ar: وَعَن عبدِ الله بنِ عَمْروٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الصِّحَّةَ وَالْعِفَّةَ والأمانةَ وحُسنَ الْخلق والرضى بِالْقدرِ»
units.en: Abdullah-bin-Amer said, "the Prophet would say, O Lord verily I supplicate thee for health of body, and for refraining from all things forbidden; and for integrity in the properties of man; and for good humour, and satisfaction with fate."
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAmr narrates that the Prophet ﷺ would say: "O Lord, I ask You for health of body, for refraining from all things forbidden, for integrity in the affairs of man, and for good humour and satisfaction with fate."

units.ar: وَعَن أُمِّ مَعْبدٍ قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ وَعَمَلِي مِنَ الرِّيَاءِ وَلِسَانِي مِنَ الْكَذِبِ وَعَيْنِي مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ» . رَوَاهُمَا الْبَيْهَقِيُّ فِي الدَّعَوَاتِ الْكَبِيرِ
units.en: Anas relates, that the Prophet visited a sick-Musleman, who really was so very weak that his voice could not be heard; and the Prophet said to him, "did you supplicate any thing?" He said, "yes, I repeated this, O Lord! hasten in this world thy punishment which was prepared for me in futurity." The Prophet said, "it is astonishing; you are not able to bear God's punishment; why did you not make this supplication? O Lord! give me good in the world and in futurity, and defend me from the punishment of the fire." Then the man prayed to God in these words, and God gave him health.
units.en2: Anas relates that the Prophet ﷺ visited a sick Muslim who was so very weak that his voice could not be heard. The Prophet said to him, "Did you supplicate anything?" He said, "Yes, I repeated this: 'O Lord! Hasten in this world Your punishment which was prepared for me in the hereafter.'" The Prophet said, "It is astonishing — you are not able to bear God's punishment; why did you not make this supplication: 'O Lord! Give me good in this world and in the hereafter, and defend me from the punishment of the Fire'?" Then the man prayed to God in these words, and God gave him health.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَادَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَدْ خَفَتَ فَصَارَ مِثْلَ الْفَرْخِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «هَلْ كُنْتَ تَدْعُو اللَّهَ بِشَيْءٍ أَوْ تَسْأَلُهُ إِيَّاهُ؟» . قَالَ: نَعَمْ كُنْتُ أَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ مَا كُنْتَ مُعَاقِبِي بِهِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ فَعَجِّلْهُ لِي فِي الدُّنْيَا. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: " سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ لَا تُطِيقُهُ وَلَا تَسْتَطِيعُهُ أَفَلَا قُلْتَ: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ". قَالَ: فَدَعَا الله بِهِ فشفاه الله
units.en: Hud'haifah. A. G. s. "It is not worthy of a Musleman to make himself despicable." The companions said, "how can Muslemans make themselves despicable?" He said, "in this manner, coming before a calamity which he has not power to ward off."
units.en2: Ḥudhayfa narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not worthy of a Muslim to make himself despicable." The Companions said, "How can a Muslim make himself despicable?" He said, "In this manner: coming before a calamity which he has not power to ward off."

units.ar: وَعَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ يُذِلَّ نَفْسَهُ» . قَالُوا: وَكَيْفَ يُذِلُّ نَفْسَهُ؟ قَالَ: «يَتَعَرَّضُ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ لِمَا لَا يُطِيقُ» وَقَالَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ: هَذَا حَدِيث حسن غَرِيب
units.en: Omer-ibn-al-Khattab said, "his highness taught me, and said, say O Lord! make my internal better than my external, and my external good; O Lord! I supplicate thee for this, that whatever you give to man, of family, property, and children, may be good; and that they stray not, nor lead others astray."
units.en2: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb narrates: The Prophet ﷺ taught me and said, say: "O Lord! Make my inward better than my outward, and my outward good. O Lord! I ask You that whatever You give a man — of family, property, and children — may be good, and that they stray not nor lead others astray."

works.author: Imam al-Jazūlī
works.description_en: The celebrated manual of blessings upon the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ composed by the Moroccan Sufi Imam Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Jazūlī, recited daily by communities across the Muslim world for five centuries. The Arabic text is in the public domain and complete here in eight parts; the opening devotions, intention and supplication of completion are rendered in an original translation made for this project, and Hizbs 1–8 in the public-domain 1907 translation of Rev. John B. Pearson.

units.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ.
الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي إِلَى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، امْتِثَالًا لِأَمْرِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا لَهُ وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ وَشَوْقًا إِلَيْهِ وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ، وَلِكَوْنِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَهْلًا لِذَلِكَ، فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقِرَاءَتِهَا عَلَى الدَّوَامِ بِجَاهِهِ عِنْدَكَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. Allah is my sufficiency and the best of Protectors, and there is no Strength and Power except in Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. O Allah, verily I appeal from my strength and my power into Thy Strength and Thy Power. O Allah, verily I draw near unto Thee in prayer for our master Muhammad, Thy Servant, and Thy Prophet and Thine Apostle, the Lord of Envoys, in accordance with Thy Command, and in implicit belief in him, and for love of him, and for yearning towards him, and for veneration of his high station, and for that he is right worthy thereof. Therefore, receive this prayer for our Master Muhammad from me in Thy graciousness, make me of Thine upright servants, and grant me success to recite it continuously by his standing with Thee; and Allah bless our master Muhammad and his Family and his Companions, all of them.
units.en2: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. God suffices me, and what an excellent Guardian He is. There is no power and no might except through God, the Most High, the Most Great. O God, I renounce my own power and strength in favour of Your power and Your strength. O God, I draw near to You by blessing our master Muḥammad — Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger, the master of the messengers; may God Most High bless him and grant him peace, and them all — in obedience to Your command, in affirmation of him, out of love for him and longing for him, and in veneration of his rank, and because he, may God bless him and grant him peace, is worthy of that. So accept it from me by Your grace, make me one of Your righteous servants, and grant me success in reciting it always, by his standing with You. And may God bless our master Muḥammad, and his family and his companions, all of them.

units.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ العَظِيمَ (3)
units.en: I ask pardon of Allah, the Almighty. (three times)
units.en2: I seek the forgiveness of God the Magnificent. (three times)

units.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيم (3)
units.en: Laud and Praise be to Allah; and there is no God but Allah; and Allah is Greatest; and there is no Strength and Power except in Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. (three times)
units.en2: Glory be to God; praise belongs to God; there is no god but God; God is greatest; and there is no power and no might except through God, the Most High, the Most Great. (three times)

units.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ (3)
units.en: Allah is my sufficiency and the best of Protectors. (three times)
units.en2: God suffices me, and what an excellent Guardian He is. (three times)

units.ar:
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ . اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ . لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ . وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
﴾(3)
units.en: I take refuge with Allah from Satan the stoned. In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate. Say: He is Allah, the One! Allah, the eternally Besought of all! He begetteth not nor was begotten. And there is none comparable unto Him. (three times)
units.en2: I seek refuge in God from Satan the accursed. In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. «Say: He is God, One. God, the Everlasting Refuge. He neither begets nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.» (three times)

units.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ . مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ . وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ . وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ . وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
﴾
بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ . مَلِكِ النَّاسِ . إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ . مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ . الَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ النَّاسِ . مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
﴾
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of Daybreak from the evil of that which He created; from the evil of the darkness when it is intense, and from the evil of malignant witchcraft, and from the evil of the envier when he envieth. In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the sneaking whisperer, who whispereth in the hearts of mankind, of the Jinn and of mankind.
units.en2: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of the blowers on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.» In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.»

units.ar:
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ . الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَـٰلَمِينَ . الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ . مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ . إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ . اهْدِنَا الصِّرَٰطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ . صِرَٰطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّينَ
﴾
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds, the Beneficent, the Merciful, Owner of the Day of Judgment. Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help. Show us the straight path, the path of those whom Thou hast favoured; not (the path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
units.en2: «In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us along the straight path — the path of those You have blessed, not of those upon whom is anger, nor of those astray.»

units.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ  ﴿
الٓمٓ . ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ . الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ . وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ . أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
﴾
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Alif. Lam. Mim. That is the Book whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off evil: who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them; and who believe in that which is revealed unto thee and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter. These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.
units.en2: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. «Alif Lām Mīm. This is the Book in which there is no doubt — guidance for the God-conscious: those who believe in the unseen, establish the prayer, and spend from what We have provided them; and those who believe in what was sent down to you and what was sent down before you, and who are certain of the Hereafter. Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and those are the ones who prosper.»

units.ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي نَوَيْتُ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَليْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، امْتِثَالًا لِأَمْرِكَ، وَتَصْدِيقًا لِنَبِيِّكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَليْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ، وَشَوْقًا إِلَيْهِ، وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ، وَلِكَوْنِهِ أَهْلًا لِذَلِكَ. فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ. وَأَزِلْ حِجَابَ الغَفْلَةِ عَنْ قَلْبِي وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate. O Allah, verily I have resolved, in prayer for our master Muhammad, Thy Servant and Thy Prophet, in accordance with Thy Command, and in implicit belief in him, and for love of him, and for yearning towards him, and for veneration of his high station, and for that he is right worthy thereof: therefore receive this prayer from me in Thy graciousness and kindness, and make the veil of forgetfulness fall from my heart, and make me of Thine upright servants.
units.en2: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. O God, I have resolved, by blessing the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to obey Your command, to affirm Your prophet, our master Muḥammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, out of love for him and longing for him and veneration of his rank, and because he is worthy of that. So accept it from me by Your grace and Your kindness, lift the veil of heedlessness from my heart, and make me one of Your righteous servants.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْهُ شَرَفًا عَلَى شَرَفِهِ الَّذِي أَوْلَيْتَهُ، وَعِزًّا عَلَى عِزِّهِ الَّذِي أَعْطَيْتَهُ، وَنُورًا عَلَى نُورِهِ الَّذِي مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَهُ، وَأَعْلِ مَقَامَهُ فِي مَقَامَاتِ المُرْسَلِينَ وَدَرَجَتَهُ فِي دَرَجَاتِ النَّبِيِّينَ.
units.en: O Allah, ever increase his honour upon the honour which Thou hast already bestowed upon him, and make him mightier upon the might which Thou hast given him, and make his light greater upon the light from which Thou hast created him, and make his station higher among the stations of the Messengers, and his rank higher among the ranks of the Prophets.
units.en2: O God, increase him in honour upon the honour You bestowed on him, in might upon the might You gave him, and in light upon the light from which You created him; and raise his station among the stations of the messengers, and his degree among the degrees of the prophets.

units.ar:
وَأَسْأَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَرِضَاهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ مَعَ العَافِيَةِ الدَّائِمَةِ وَالمَوْتِ عَلَى الكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ وَالجَمَاعَةِ وَكَلِمَتَيْ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلَى تَحْقِيقِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ تَبْدِيلٍ وَلَا تَغْيِيرٍ.
وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا ارْتَكَبْتُهُ بِفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِمَامِ المُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى المُرْسَلِينَ وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: And O Allah I entreat for Thy pleasure and his pleasure, O Lord of the Worlds, and beseech Thee for lasting well-being and a death following the Book, the Sunnah, and the Community, and upon the two words of witness in their true reality, without alteration or change. Forgive me for what I have done, through Thy Grace, Thy Favour, Thy Generosity and Thy Nobility, O Most Merciful of the Merciful. Allah's blessings and peace be upon our master Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and Leader of the Messengers, and upon his Family and his Companions, all of them; and peace be upon the Messengers, and praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: And I ask You for Your pleasure and his pleasure, Lord of the worlds, together with lasting well-being, and death upon the Book, the Sunna and the Community, and upon the two words of witness in full realisation of them, without alteration or change. Forgive me what I have committed, by Your grace, Your bounty and Your generosity, Most Merciful of the merciful. And may God bless our master Muḥammad, the Seal of the Prophets and leader of the messengers, and his family and his companions, all of them. And peace be upon the messengers, and praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds.

units.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
units.en: In the Name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.
units.en2: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

units.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
units.en: The blessing of Allah and perfect peace be on our master and our lord Muhammad, and his Family and Companions.
units.en2: The blessing of Allah and perfect peace be upon our master and our lord Muhammad, and his family and Companions.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and his wives, and his descendants, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants as Thou didst favour our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants, as You favoured our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as Thou didst favour our master Abraham in the ages; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham throughout the ages — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst favour our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the Family of our master Muhammad.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Thy Servant and Thy Apostle.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst favour our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: And, O Allah, have mercy on our master Muhammad and on the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou hadst mercy on our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: And, O Allah, have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You had mercy on our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَحَنَّنْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: And, O Allah, show compassion to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show compassion to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: And, O Allah, show compassion to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed compassion to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا سَلَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, and send peace to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst send peace to our master Abraham, and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, send peace upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You sent peace upon our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and show favour on our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show blessing and mercy and favour to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham in the ages; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed blessing, mercy, and favour to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham throughout the ages — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Prophet, and his wives who are Mothers of the Faithful, and his descendants and the people of his House, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Prophet, his wives who are the Mothers of the Faithful, his descendants, and the people of his house, as You blessed our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, show favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show favour to our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed favour to our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ دَاحِيَ المَدْحُوَّاتِ، وَبَارِئَ المَسْمُوكَاتِ، وَجَبَّارَ القُلُوبِ عَلَى فِطْرَتِهَا شَقِيِّهَا وَسَعِيدِهَا، اجْعَلْ شَرَائِفَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَأْفَةَ تَحَنُّنِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ الفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، وَالمُعْلِنِ الحَقَّ بِالحَقِّ، وَالدَّامِغِ لِجَيْشَاتِ الأَبَاطِيلِ كَمَا حُمِّلَ، فَاضْطَلَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ بِطَاعَتِكَ، مُسْتَوْفِزًا فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ، وَاعِيًا لِوَحْيِكَ، حَافِظًا لِعَهْدِكَ، مَاضِيًا عَلَى نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ، حَتَّى أَوْرَى قَبَسًا لِقَابِسٍ، آلَاءُ اللَّهِ تَصِلُ بِأَهْلِهِ أَسْبَابَهُ، بِهِ هُدِيَتِ القُلُوبُ بَعْدَ خَوْضَاتِ الفِتَنِ وَالإِثْمِ، وَأَبْهَجَ مُوضِحَاتِ الأَعْلَامِ، وَنَائِرَاتِ الأَحْكَامِ، وَمُنِيرَاتِ الإِسْلَامِ، فَهُوَ أَمِينُكَ المَأْمُونُ، وَخَازِنُ عِلْمِكَ المَخْزُونِ، وَشَهِيدُكَ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ، وَبَعِيثُكَ نِعْمَةً، وَرَسُولُكَ بِالْحَقِّ رَحْمَةً.
units.en: O Allah, Thou who didst level the plains and create the heights, and art Controller of hearts in their imaginations, be they wretched or be they happy, give the most excellent of Thy blessings and the kindest of Thy favours and the gentlest of Thy graces to Muhammad, Thy Servant and Apostle, who reveals whatever is most closed and secret, and seals whatever is past, and manifests the truth by the truth, and destroys the armies of folly, even as he was supported and enabled to bear his burthen in Thy work in obedience to Thee, maintaining himself promptly in Thy good favour, mindful of Thy revelation, observant of the promise, ever forward in the advance of Thy work, till he kindled the light for those who aspired to receiving the light, and access was gained through him to the blessings of Allah: when hearts were guided by him after discussions upon trials and sins, and the finest arguments of the learned, and the brilliant thoughts of the wise, and the enlightenments of self-surrender: verily he is Thy trusted trustee, and the treasure of Thy valued knowledge, and Thy Witness on the Day of Judgment, and Thy Envoy as a favour, and Thy Apostle too, in truth, as a mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, You who levelled the plains and created the heights, who govern hearts according to their inborn nature, wretched or happy: give the most excellent of Your blessings, the kindest of Your favours, and the gentlest of Your graces to Muhammad, Your servant and messenger — who opened what was closed, sealed what came before, proclaimed the truth by the truth, and crushed the armies of falsehood, bearing his burden in Your work as he was charged: in obedience to You, hastening to Your good pleasure, mindful of Your revelation, keeping Your covenant, ever pressing forward with Your command, until he kindled a light for everyone who aspired to receive it, and through him people gained access to the blessings of Allah; hearts were guided by him after plunging into trials and sins, after the finest arguments of the learned, the brilliant thoughts of the wise, and the lights of self-surrender. Truly he is Your trusted trustee, the treasure of Your valued knowledge, Your witness on the Day of Judgement, Your envoy as a favour, and Your messenger, in truth, as a mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي عَدْنِكَ، وَاجْزِهِ مُضَاعَفَاتِ الخَيْرِ مِن فَضْلِكَ مُهَنَّئَاتٍ لَهُ غَيْرَ مُكَدَّرَاتٍ، مِنْ فَوْزِ ثَوَابِكَ المَحْلُولِ، وَجَزِيلِ عَطَائِكَ المَعْلُولِ.
units.en: O Allah, give him free place in Thy Eden, and double his reward in the best of Thy favour, made pleasant and unalloyed for him, from the bounty of Thy manifest recompense, and the greatness of Thy repeated gifts.
units.en2: O Allah, give him a spacious place in Your Eden, and double his reward from the best of Your favour — made pleasant and untroubled for him — from the bounty of Your manifest recompense and the greatness of Your repeated gifts.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ أَعْلِ عَلَى بِنَاءِ النَّاسِ بِنَاءَهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ مَثْوَاهُ لَدَيْكَ وَنُزُلَهُ، وَأَتْمِمْ لَهُ نُورَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ مِنِ ابْتِعَاثِكَ لَهُ مَقْبُولَ الشَّهَادَةِ، وَمَرْضِيَّ المَقَالَةِ، ذَا مَنْطِقٍ عَدْلٍ، وَخُطَّةٍ فَصْلٍ، وَبُرْهَانٍ عَظِيمٍ، ﴿
إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ ۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا  ﴾، لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّى وَسَعْدَيْكَ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ البَرِّ الرَّحِيمِ، وَالمَلَائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبِينَ، وَالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَمَا سَبَّحَ لَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، خَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَسَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ المُتَّقِينَ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، الشَّاهِدِ البَشِيرِ، الدَّاعِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ، السِّرَاجِ المُنِيرِ، وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
units.en: O Allah, exalt his followers over all mankind and honour his abode and his sojourn in Thy Presence, and give him perfect light, and when Thou recallest him to life, reward him by Thy witness to the reception and by Thy approval of the address awarded him, so that he becomes the author of upright speech, gracious conduct, and prevailing reason; Verily Allah and His Angels bless the Prophet. O ye who believe, pray Allah to bless him, and grant him abundant peace; I am Thy servant; O Allah, my Lord, in the name of Thy own felicity, the blessings of the True and Merciful Allah, and the angels who have the privilege of access to the Presence, and the Prophets and the Just, and the Witnesses, and the Upright, and whatever else offers Thee praise; yea, Thou Lord of the ages, may these blessings be on our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, Seal of the Prophets, and master of the Apostles, Imam of the Devout, and Apostle of the Lord of the Worlds; the Witness, the Evangelist, the one who invoked mankind towards Thee by Thy leave, the Lamp of the Brightness, and on him be peace.
units.en2: O Allah, raise his edifice above the edifices of mankind; honour his resting-place and his lodging with You; perfect his light; and when You call him back to life, reward him with accepted testimony and approved speech — a tongue of justice, a decisive word, and a mighty proof. Truly, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet; O you who believe, call blessings upon him and greet him with abundant peace. At Your service, O Allah, my Lord, and at Your service again: may the blessings of Allah, the Benign, the Merciful, and of the angels brought near to the Presence, and of the prophets, the truthful, the witnesses, and the upright, and of everything that glorifies You — O Lord of the worlds — be upon our master Muhammad, son of ʿAbdullāh, the Seal of the Prophets, the master of the messengers, the imam of the devout, the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, the witness, the bearer of good news, the caller to You by Your leave, the luminous lamp — and upon him be peace.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ المُتَّقِينَ، وَخَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِك، إِمَامِ الخَيْرِ، وَقَائِدِ الخَيْرِ، وَرَسُولِ الرَّحْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, give effect to Thy Blessings and Thy Gracious Favours and Thy Mercy on the master of Apostles, the Imam of the Devout, the Seal of the Prophets, Muhammad Thy Servant and Apostle, the good Imam, the good Ruler, and Apostle of Mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bestow Your blessings, Your gracious favours, and Your mercy upon the master of the messengers, the imam of the devout, the Seal of the Prophets — Muhammad, Your servant and messenger, the good imam, the good leader, and the messenger of mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا يَغْبِطُهُ فِيهِ الأَوَّلُونَ وَالآخِرُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, send him to an honourable place, so that the First and the Last will envy him in it.
units.en2: O Allah, raise him to an honoured station in which the first and the last will envy him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, grant favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst to the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, grant favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You granted favour to the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَوْلَادِهِ، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَأَصْهَارِهِ، وَأَنْصَارِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، وَمُحِبِّيهِ وَأُمَّتِهِ وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
units.en: Bless our master Muhammad and his Family, and his Comrades, and his children, and his wives, and his descendants, and the men of his house, and his relatives by marriage, and those who aided him, and his partisans, and those who were attached to him, and are of his creed, and ourselves in union with them, one and all, Thou Merciful and Compassionate.
units.en2: Bless our master Muhammad, his family, his Companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his relatives by marriage, those who aided him, his partisans, those who were attached to him and follow his creed — and ourselves together with them all, O Merciful and Compassionate.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَي سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَّمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him, and bless our master Muhammad in every one who does not bless him, and bless our master Muhammad as Thou hast enjoined us, in prayer to him; and bless our master Muhammad even as it is meet that he should be blessed.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him; bless our master Muhammad in everyone who does not bless him; bless our master Muhammad as You commanded us to, in prayer for him; and bless our master Muhammad as it is fitting that he should be blessed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast enjoined that we bless him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You commanded us to bless him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَاهُ لَهُ.
units.en: Bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad even as Thou desirest, and art pleased to approve for him.
units.en2: Bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You desire and are pleased to approve for him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، صَلِّ عَلَي سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الدَّرَجَةَ وَالوَسِيلَةَ فِي الجَنَّةِ.
units.en: O Allah, yea, Thou Lord of our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and give our master Muhammad rank and influence in Paradise.
units.en2: O Allah — Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad — bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and give our master Muhammad rank and intercession in Paradise.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اجْزِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, yea, Thou Lord of our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, reward our master Muhammad — Allah bless him and give him peace — even as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah — Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad — reward our master Muhammad, Allah bless him and grant him peace, as richly as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and the people of his house.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and the people of his house.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ، وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ شَيْءٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ البَرَكَةِ شَيْءٌ، وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ السَّلَامِ شَيْءٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, until there is no sort of blessing left; and have mercy upon our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, until there is no sort of mercy left; and show favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, until there is no sort of favour left; and grant peace to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, until there is no form of peace left.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until no blessing of any kind is left; have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until no mercy of any kind is left; show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until no favour of any kind is left; and grant peace to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until no peace of any kind is left.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الأَوَّلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الآخِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي المُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad among the First, and bless our master Muhammad among the Last; and bless our master Muhammad among the Prophets, and bless our master Muhammad among the Apostles, and bless our master Muhammad among the Exalted Assembly until the Day of Judgment.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad among the first; bless our master Muhammad among the last; bless our master Muhammad among the prophets; bless our master Muhammad among the messengers; and bless our master Muhammad in the Exalted Assembly until the Day of Judgement.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَالشَّرَفَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الكَبِيرَةَ.
units.en: O Allah, give our master Muhammad influence, and grace, and grandeur, and powerful rank.
units.en2: O Allah, give our master Muhammad intercession, grace, grandeur, and mighty rank.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ، وَارْزُقْنِي صُحْبَتَهُ، وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاسْقِنِي مِنْ حَوْضِهِ مَشْرَبًا رَوِيًّا، سَائِغًا هَنِيًّا، لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
units.en: For, O Allah, I believe in our master Muhammad, and I have not beheld him; so do not Thou exclude me from the gardens where his friends are found; grant me the privilege of his company, and at last receive me into his society, and suffer me to drink from his cistern a refreshing, palatable, wholesome draught, after which we shall never thirst; for Thou art in everything all Powerful.
units.en2: For, O Allah, I believe in our master Muhammad though I have not seen him — so do not exclude me from the gardens where his friends are found; grant me the privilege of his company, receive me at last into his society, and let me drink from his Pool a refreshing, palatable, wholesome draught after which we will never thirst — for You are powerful over all things.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ رُوحَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنِّي تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا.
units.en: O Allah, let the spirit of our master Muhammad receive from me salutation and peace.
units.en2: O Allah, let the spirit of our master Muhammad receive greeting and peace from me.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ.
units.en: And, O Allah, even as I have believed in our master Muhammad and have not beheld him, so do not Thou exclude me from the gardens where his friends are found.
units.en2: And, O Allah, as I have believed in our master Muhammad without seeing him, do not exclude me from the gardens where his friends are found.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الكُبْرَى، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ العُلْيَا، وَآتِهِ سُؤْلَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولَى، كَمَا آتَيْتَ سَيِّدَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَيِّدَنَا مُوسَى.
units.en: O Allah, receive the intercession of our master Muhammad the great, and advance his already exalted rank, and grant his prayer in the Hereafter and in this Present life, even as Thou didst with our master Abraham and our master Moses.
units.en2: O Allah, accept the great intercession of our master Muhammad, raise his already exalted rank still higher, and grant him his petition in the hereafter and in this present life, as You granted our master Abraham and our master Moses.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham, and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast shown favour to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham; and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed favour to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَصَفِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا مُوسَى كَلِيمِكَ وَنَجِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا عِيسَى رُوحِكَ وَكَلِمَتِكَ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَخِيرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ، وَخَاصَّتِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ، وَكَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَكُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الغَافِلُونَ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ، وَعِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا.
