units.en: O Allah, show blessing and peace and favour to our master Muhammad, Thy Prophet and Apostle, and to our master Abraham, Thy Friend and Chosen ally, and to our master Moses, Thy Friend in converse and confidence, and to our master Jesus, Thy Spirit and Thy spokesman, and to Thy angels one and all, and to Thy Apostles, and Thy Prophets, and to the best Thou hast in Thy creation, and to the chief of Thy elect, and to Thy attendants, and to those who aid Thee of the denizens of Thy earth and Thy heaven; and may Allah bless our master Muhammad in all His creation and in His own special favour, and the embellishment of His Throne, and the form of His Words, and even as they are his people; so often as his memory is renewed by those who renew it, or neglected by those who neglect its renewal; blessing on the people of his house, and on the pure descendants, and perfect peace to all.
units.en2: O Allah, show blessing, peace, and favour to our master Muhammad, Your prophet and messenger; to our master Abraham, Your friend and chosen ally; to our master Moses, Your friend in converse and confidence; to our master Jesus, Your spirit and Your word; and to all Your angels, Your messengers, and Your prophets, the best of Your creation, the chief of Your elect, Your attendants, and those who aid You among the dwellers of Your earth and Your heaven. And may Allah bless our master Muhammad as many times as all His creation, to His own pleasure, to the measure of the adornment of His Throne and the form of His words, and as befits him, as often as his memory is renewed by those who renew it and neglected by those who neglect it — blessings on the people of his house and his pure descendants, and perfect peace upon all.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالمَلَائِكَةِ وَالمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَجَمِيعِ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، عَدَدَ مَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ مُنْذُ بَنَيْتَهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنبَتَتِ الأَرْضُ مُنْذُ دَحَوْتَهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ فَإِنَّكَ أَحْصَيْتَهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَنَفَّسَتِ الأَرْوَاحُ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ وَمَا تَخْلُقُ، وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَأَضْعَافَ ذَلِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants, and all the Prophets and Apostles, and the angels, and those who have the privilege of access, and all the upright servants of Allah, in all that the heavens have blessed with rain ever since Thou hast framed them; O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that the earth has produced, ever since Thou didst form its plains; and bless our master Muhammad in all the stars in the Heaven, even as Thou hast set them in order; and bless our master Muhammad in all the breezes that have breathed, ever since Thou createdst them; and bless our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast created, and that Thou wilt create, and that Thy knowledge includes, aye, and twice as much.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants, and all the prophets and messengers, the angels and those brought near, and all the upright servants of Allah, as many times as the heavens have rained since You framed them; O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the earth has produced since You spread out its plains; bless our master Muhammad in all the stars of heaven, as You set them in order; bless our master Muhammad in all the breezes that have blown since You created them; and bless our master Muhammad in all You have created, all You will create, and all Your knowledge encompasses — yes, and twice as much again.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ، وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَمَبْلَغَ عِلْمِكَ وَآيَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless them in all Thy creation, and whatever Thy Soul favoureth, and the embellishment of Thy Throne, and the form of Thy Words, and the extent of Thy knowledge, and Thy Signs, and the beauty of all Thy created works.
units.en2: O Allah, bless them in all Your creation, to the pleasure of Your Self, to the measure of the adornment of Your Throne, the form of Your words, the extent of Your knowledge and Your signs, and the beauty of all Your created works.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً تَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ المُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ، كَفَضْلِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless them in a blessing that will surpass and be full of grace, the blessing of those who bless them, one and all in creation, like Thy Grace upon all Thy creation.
units.en2: O Allah, bless them with a blessing that surpasses and overflows with grace beyond the blessing of all in creation who bless them — as Your grace surpasses all Your creation.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مُسْتَمِرَّةَ الدَّوَامِ، عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالأَيَّامِ، مُتَّصِلَةَ الدَّوَامِ، لَا انْقِضَاءَ لَهَا وَلَا انْصِرَامَ، عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالأَيَّامِ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ وَابِلٍ وَطَلٍّ.
units.en: O Allah, bless them in a continuous blessing that endures to eternity in the progress of nights and days, bringing a blessing through an eternity that never terminates and has no cessation, in the progress of nights and days, in all showers of rain, severe and soft.
units.en2: O Allah, bless them with a continuous blessing that endures into eternity through the passing of nights and days — a blessing through an eternity that never ends and never ceases, through the passing of nights and days, as many as all showers of rain, heavy and soft.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ، مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ، وَزِنَةَ جَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ، صَلَاةً مُكَرَّرَةً أَبَدًا، عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، وَمِلْءَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، وَأَضْعَافَ مَا أَحْصَى عِلْمُكَ، صَلَاةً تَزِيدُ وَتَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ المُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ، كَفَضْلِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad Thy Prophet, and Abraham Thy friend, and all Thy Prophets and Thy elect, of the people of Thy earth and Thy heavens, throughout all Thy creation, and all that Thy soul favours, and the embellishment of Thy Throne, and the form of Thy Words, and the utmost limits of Thy knowledge, and the beauty of all Thy created works; a blessing that repeats itself evermore in everything of which Thy knowledge takes account; yea, give a blessing to all that Thy knowledge comprehends; and the double that Thy knowledge comprehends; a blessing that will increase and exceed and be full of grace; the blessing of those in creation who bless them, one and all, even as Thy favour is upon all Thy creation.
units.en2: O Allah, bless Muhammad Your prophet, Abraham Your friend, and all Your prophets and Your elect among the people of Your earth and Your heavens, throughout all Your creation, to the pleasure of Your Self, to the measure of the adornment of Your Throne, the form of Your words, the utmost limits of Your knowledge, and the beauty of all Your created works — a blessing repeating itself forever in everything Your knowledge takes account of; yes, bless them as much as all Your knowledge comprehends, and double what Your knowledge comprehends — a blessing that increases, surpasses, and overflows with grace beyond the blessing of all in creation who bless them, as Your favour is upon all Your creation.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ لَزِمَ مِلَّةَ نَبِيِّكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَظَّمَ حُرْمَتَهُ، وَأَعَزَّ كَلِمَتَهُ، وَحَفِظَ عَهْدَهُ وَذِمَّتَهُ، وَنَصَرَ حِزْبَهُ وَدَعْوَتَهُ، وَكَثَّرَ تَابِعِيهِ وَفِرْقَتَهُ، وَوَافَى زُمْرَتَهُ، وَلَمْ يُخَالِفْ سَبِيلَهُ وَسُنَّتَهُ.
units.en: O Allah, make me of those who are attached to the religion of Thy Prophet and our master Muhammad — Allah bless him and give him peace — and sanctify his ordinance, and give force to his word, and to the observance of his promise, and his protection, and the aid of his company, and his prayer, and multiply his followers, and his association, and those who answer for his association, and do not quit his path or his law.
units.en2: O Allah, make me one of those who hold fast to the religion of Your prophet, our master Muhammad — Allah bless him and grant him peace — who sanctify his ordinance, give force to his word, keep his covenant and his protection, aid his company and his call, multiply his followers and his party, keep pace with his throng, and never leave his path or his law.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الاسْتِمْسَاكَ بِسُنَّتِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الانْحِرَافِ عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ.
units.en: For, O Allah, I entreat Thee that I may establish myself in his law, and take refuge with Thee, so that I may never deviate from whatever comes to me through him.
units.en2: For, O Allah, I ask You to establish me firmly in his law, and I take refuge with You from ever deviating from whatever comes to me through him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
units.en: For, O Allah, I entreat Thee for every blessing that our master Muhammad entreated of Thee, he Thy Prophet and Apostle — Allah bless him and give him peace; and I take refuge with Thee against the evil against which our master Muhammad appealed to Thee, he Thy Prophet and Apostle — Allah bless him and give him peace.
units.en2: For, O Allah, I ask You for every blessing that our master Muhammad asked of You — Your prophet and messenger, Allah bless him and grant him peace; and I take refuge with You from every evil from which our master Muhammad sought Your protection — Your prophet and messenger, Allah bless him and grant him peace.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ الفِتَنِ، وَعَافِنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ المِحَنِ، وَأَصْلِحْ مِنِّي مَا ظَهَرَ وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الحِقْدِ وَالحَسَدِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ عَلَيَّ تِبَاعَةً لِأَحَدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, preserve me from the worst temptations, and spare me all trials, and render harmless to me whatever of them is seen or is unseen, and cleanse my heart from hatred and envy, so that Thou wilt not bring on me any consequence, not even one.
units.en2: O Allah, preserve me from the worst temptations, spare me all trials, render harmless to me whatever of them is seen or unseen, and cleanse my heart of hatred and envy, so that You do not bring upon me any consequence, not even one.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَالتَّرْكَ لِسَيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الكَفَافِ وَالمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ، وَالفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ، وَالعَدْلَ فِي الغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَىٰ، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ القَضَا، وَالاقْتِصَادَ فِي الفَقْرِ وَالغِنَىٰ، وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي القَوْلِ وَالفِعْلِ، وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الجِدِّ وَالهَزْلِ.
units.en: O Allah, for I entreat Thee that I may lay hold on the best that Thou knowest, and that I may forsake the evil that Thou knowest; and I entreat of Thee that Thou wilt secure me the necessaries of life, and self-restraint in everything, and success in speech in every doubt, and victory in decision in every discussion, and justice in anger, and a willing assent to whatever Providence may award; and that I may keep moderation in poverty and wealth, and modesty in speech and action, and sincerity in earnestness or mirth.
units.en2: O Allah, I ask You to let me lay hold of the best that You know and forsake the evil that You know; and I ask You to secure me the necessities of life, self-restraint in everything, clarity of speech in every doubt, victory through rightness in every dispute, justice in anger, and willing assent to whatever the decree awards; and to let me keep moderation in poverty and wealth, modesty in speech and action, and sincerity in earnest and in jest.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ لِي ذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ، وَذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, if there be offences in anything between me and Thee, or offences in anything between me and Thy creation,
units.en2: O Allah, if there are offences in anything between me and You, or offences in anything between me and Your creation —

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا كَانَ لَكَ مِنْهَا فَاغْفِرْهُ لِي، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهَا لِخَلْقِكَ فَتَحَمَّلْهُ عَنِّي، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ إِنَّكَ وَاسِعُ المَغْفِرَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, whatever share Thou hast in them, pardon it, and whatever share Thy creation has in them, take the burden of it away from me, and make me rich in Thy grace, for Thou hast pardon in Thy Power.
units.en2: O Allah, whatever share is Yours in them, pardon it; and whatever share belongs to Your creation, lift its burden from me; and make me rich in Your grace, for pardon is in Your power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ نَوِّرْ بِالْعِلْمِ قَلْبِي، وَاسْتَعْمِلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ بَدَنِي، وَخَلِّصْ مِنَ الفِتَنِ سِرِّي، وَاشْغَلْ بِالاعْتِبَارِ فِكْرِي، وَقِنِي شَرَّ وَسَاوِسِ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ لَهُ عَلَيَّ سُلْطَانٌ.
units.en: O Allah, illuminate my heart with knowledge, and employ my person in Thy obedience, and make my secret thoughts pure of temptation, and foster in my thoughts reflection, and avoidance of evil and of the power of Satan, and enable me to escape him, Thou Merciful One, until he has no power over me.
units.en2: O Allah, illumine my heart with knowledge, employ my body in Your obedience, purify my secret thoughts from temptation, occupy my mind with reflection and with shunning evil and the power of Satan, and enable me to escape him, O Merciful One, until he has no power over me.

sections.heading: The Second Part (Ḥizb 2 of 8)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ، إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الغُيُوبِ.
units.en: O Allah, I do entreat Thee for some of the good that Thou knowest, and I appeal to Thee against the evil that Thou knowest, and I entreat Thee for pardon for all that Thou knowest; for Thou knowest and we do not know, and Thou art above all Learned in Secrets.
units.en2: O Allah, I ask You for the good of all that You know, I seek Your protection from the evil of all that You know, and I ask Your forgiveness for all that You know — for You know and we do not know, and You are the All-Knower of hidden things.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِي هَذَا وَإِحْدَاقِ الفِتَنِ، وَتَطَاوُلِ أَهْلِ الجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ.
units.en: O Allah, have mercy on me in times of my encirclement in discomforts and save me from the oppression of the tyrants so exceedingly cruel.
units.en2: O Allah, have mercy on me whenever troubles close in around me, and deliver me from the oppression of tyrants so exceedingly cruel.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ، وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ، مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِي أَجَلِي مُعَافَى.
units.en: O Allah, place me for Thyself in secure protection and a strong refuge from all Thy creation, until Thou enablest me to reach the most transcendent eminence.
units.en2: O Allah, place me under Your own secure protection, in a strong refuge from all Your creation, until You bring me to the loftiest station.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَنْبَغِي الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَجِبُ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي نُورُهُ مِنْ نُورِ الأَنْوَارِ، وَأَشْرَقَ بِشُعَاعِ سِرِّهِ الأَسْرَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, in every one who blesses him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, in every one who does not bless him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad even as the blessing is suited to him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as the blessing is needful for him; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast ordained that he shall be blessed; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, whose Light is from the Light of Lights, and enlighten his inmost secret thoughts with rays of brightness.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in everyone who does not bless him; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with the blessing that befits him; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad with the blessing he needs; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You have decreed he should be blessed; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, whose light is from the Light of Lights — and illumine his inmost secret with rays of brightness.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الأَبْرَارِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and the men of his Household, most upright of all, every one of them.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and the people of his household, the most upright of them all, every one.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَخَاتِمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ، وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family, the Sea of Thy Brightness, and the Mine of Thy Secrets, and the Voice of Thy Arguments, and the Bridegroom of Thy Royalty, and the Imam of Thy Presence, and the Seal of Thy Prophets; a blessing that will last whilst Thou endurest, and will survive while Thou survivest: a blessing that will find favour with Thee, and will find favour with him, and will bring favour to me through it for ourselves; O Thou Most Compassionate, Most Merciful: O Thou Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family — the ocean of Your radiance, the mine of Your secrets, the tongue of Your proofs, the bridegroom of Your kingdom, the imam of Your presence, the seal of Your prophets — with a blessing that lasts as long as You last and endures as long as You endure: a blessing that pleases You, pleases him, and brings us favour through it, O Most Compassionate, Most Merciful, Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الحِلِّ وَالحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ المَشْعَرِ الحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ البَيْتِ الحَرَامِ، وَرَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَالمَقَامِ، أَبْلِغْ لِسَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنَّا السَّلَامَ.
units.en: O Allah, Lord of whatever is Allowed, Lord of whatever is Forbidden, Lord of the Sacred Precinct, Lord of the Sacred House, and Lord of Stone of Support, and the Place of Honour, cause this salutation of peace to reach our master and patron Muhammad from us.
units.en2: O Allah, Lord of the permitted, Lord of the forbidden, Lord of the Sacred Precinct, Lord of the Sacred House, Lord of the Cornerstone and the Station — convey this greeting of peace from us to our master and patron Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad. our master of the First and the Last.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad, our master of the first and the last.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad at every time and moment.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad at every time and moment.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the higher assembly of angels, until the Day of Judgement.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the highest assembly of angels until the Day of Judgement.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَرِثَ الأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الوَارِثِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad until Thou art the Heir of the earth, and whoever there is on it; for Thou art the best of heirs.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad until You inherit the earth and everyone on it — and You are the best of inheritors.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Unlettered Prophet and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious; and show favour to our master Muhammad the Unlettered Prophet, even as Thou didst with our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious;
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious; and show favour to our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, as You showed favour to our master Abraham — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَجَرَى بِهِ قَلَمُكَ، وَسَبَقَتْ بِهِ مَشِيئَتُكَ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، بَاقِيَةً بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، إِلَى أَبَدِ الأَبَدِ، أَبَدًا، لَا نِهَايَةَ لِأَبَدِيَّتِهِ، وَلَا فَنَاءَ لِدَيْمُومِيَّتِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all that Thy Knowledge includes or Thy Pen has covered, or to which Thy Will extends, or Thy angels bless: in a blessing that lasts as long as Thou endurest, and continues in Thy Grace and Thy Goodness, through all the length of time for ever; for there is no limit to his endurance, and there is no finality of his continuance.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that Your knowledge encompasses, Your Pen has recorded, Your will extends to, and Your angels bless: a blessing that lasts as long as You last and continues in Your grace and goodness through all eternity — for Your duration has no limit and Your continuance no end.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَارْحَمْ أُمَّتَهُ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and Patron Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad. in all that Thy knowledge includes, and Thy Book recounts, or that Thy angels and earth testify of his Comrades, and have mercy on his religion, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book recounts and in all that Your angels and the earth bear witness to of his Companions — and have mercy on his religion, for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَصْحَابِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and all the Comrades of our master Muhammad.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and all the Companions of our master Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and show favour, O Allah, on our master Muhammad and on the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst toward our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham in the world at large; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You blessed our master Abraham; and show favour, O Allah, to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You showed favour to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham throughout the worlds — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِخُشُوعِ القَلْبِ عِنْدَ السُّجُودِ، لَكَ يَا سَيِّدِي بِغَيْرِ جُحُودٍ، وَبِكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا جَلِيلُ فَلَا شَيْءَ يُدَانِيكَ فِي غَلِيظِ العُهُودِ، وَبِكُرْسِيِّكَ المُكَلَّلِ بِالنُّورِ إِلَى عَرْشِكَ العَظِيمِ المَجِيدِ، وَبِمَا كَانَ تَحْتَ عَرْشِكَ حَقًّا، قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَصَوْتَ الرُّعُودِ، ذَاكَ إِذْ كُنْتَ مِثْلَ مَا لَمْ تَزَلْ قَطُّ إِلٰهًا عُرِفْتَ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ، فَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ المُحِبِّينَ المَحْبُوبِينَ المُقَرَّبِينَ العَاشِقِينَ لَكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا وَدُودُ.
units.en2: O Allah, from the depths of a heart humbly prostrating before You, with no trace of unbelief — for Your sake, O Allah the Sublime: nothing matches You in keeping inviolable promises. For the sake of Your Footstool adorned with light, reaching to the vastness of Your mighty, powerful Throne, and for the sake of what lay beneath Your Throne before You created the heavens and the sound of Your thunder — You are infinite, without parallel, the One. I implore You to make me one of Your favourites, Your beloved, Your near ones, Your ardent lovers — O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, O Bestower!

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad. in all that Thy Knowledge includes.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that Your knowledge encompasses.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that the Book recounts.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that Your Book recounts.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا نَفَذَتْ بِهِ قُدْرَتُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in as much as he is distinguished by Thy Will.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad to the full measure of what Your will has singled him out for.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَصَّصَتْهُ إِرَادَتُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that Thy Will authorizes.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything Your will ordains.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَوَجَّهَ إِلَيْهِ أَمْرُكَ وَنَهْيُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that Thy Command or Thy Refusal has in view.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that Your command and Your refusal intend.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَسِعَهُ سَمْعُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that is within Thy Hearing.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything within Your hearing.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ بَصَرُكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything to which Thy Power of Sight extends.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything within Your sight.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that those who record Thy works record.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that the recorders of Your works record.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الغَافِلُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that they who are neglectful neglect to record.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all that the heedless neglect to record.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الأَمْطَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in every shower of rain.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad with every shower of rain.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الأَشْجَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the leaves of the trees.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad as many times as all the leaves of the trees.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ القِفَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the expanse of the dry land.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad to the full breadth of the dry land.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ دَوَابِّ البِحَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the expanse of the sea.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad to the full breadth of the sea.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِيَاهِ البِحَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the waters of the sea.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all the waters of the sea.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything on which night throws its darkness, or light its brightness.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything the night darkens and the daylight brightens.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the morning and in the evening.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad morning and evening.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّمَالِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad through all the sandy plains.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad through all the sandy plains.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النِّسَاءِ وَالرِّجَالِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad among all women and men.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad among all women and men.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ رِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad as Thy Soul pleaseth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad as Your Self is pleased.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the form of Thy Words.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad to the measure of Your words.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the fullness of Thy heavens and Thy earth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad to the fullness of Your heavens and Your earth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the beauty of Thy Throne.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in the beauty of Your Throne.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all Thy created things.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in all Your created things.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad with the most gracious of Thy blessings.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad with the most gracious of Your blessings.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the Prophet of mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the Prophet of mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى شَفِيعِ الأُمَّةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the advocate of the faith.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the champion of the faith.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى كَاشِفِ الغُمَّةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who takes away grief.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the remover of grief.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُجْلِي الظُّلْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who enlightens darkness.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who lights up the darkness.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُولِي النِّعْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the lord of pleasure.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the lord of delight.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُؤْتِي الرَّحْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the giver of mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the giver of mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الحَوْضِ المَوْرُودِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the owner of the conduit cistern.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the lord of the flowing Pool.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المَقَامِ المَحْمُودِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the claimant of the honoured place.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the claimant of the honoured station.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ اللِّوَاءِ المَعْقُودِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the knotted standard.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bearer of the knotted banner.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المَكَانِ المَشْهُودِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of the acknowledged sojourn.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the keeper of the appointed meeting-place.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَوْصُوفِ بِالْكَرَمِ وَالجُودِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who was adorned by nobleness and generosity.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one adorned with nobility and generosity.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ هُوَ فِي السَّمَاءِ سَيِّدُنَا مَحْمُودٌ، وَفِي الأَرْضِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ.
units.en: O Allah him who in heaven is Mahmood, and on earth Muhammad.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who in heaven is Mahmūd and on earth is Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man with the mole.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bearer of the birthmark.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ العَلَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the one who possessed distinguishing mark.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who bore the distinguishing sign.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَوْصُوفِ بِالكَرَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man endued with miracles.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man endowed with miracles.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَخْصُوصِ بِالزَّعَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man the object of veneration.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man who is the object of veneration.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ تُظِلُّهُ الغَمَامَةُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who was shaded by clouds.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man shaded by clouds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ كَمَا يَرَى مَنْ أَمَامَهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who saw everything from behind, even as could see one who was in front of him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who saw everything behind him just as one sees what is in front.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ المُشَفَّعِ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the one whose intercession is accepted in the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one whose intercession is accepted on the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الضَّرَاعَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the example of humility.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the model of humility.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الشَّفَاعَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the votary of intercession.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the devoted seeker of intercession.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الوَسِيلَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the promoter of good influence.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the promoter of goodly influence.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الفَضِيلَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of gracious mind.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man of gracious spirit.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the model of exalted dignity.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the model of exalted dignity.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الهِرَاوَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of the stalwart staff.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man of the sturdy staff.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ النَّعْلَيْنِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who wore his sandals.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man who wore sandals.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الحُجَّةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of argument.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the master of argument.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ البُرْهَانِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of sound reason.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man of sound reason.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ السُّلْطَانِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of power.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man of power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the wearer of the turban.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the wearer of the turban.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المِعْرَاجِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the night ascent.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the hero of the Night Journey.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ القَضِيبِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the hero of the sword.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the hero of the sword.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ النَّجِيبِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the noble rider.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the noble rider.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَاكِبِ البُرَاقِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the rider of Borak
units.en2: O Allah, bless the rider of al-Burāq.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُخْتَرِقِ السَّبْعِ الطِّبَاقِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who traversed the seven spheres.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who passed through the seven heavens.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ فِي جَمِيعِ الأَنَامِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the intercessor for all creatures.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the intercessor for all creation.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَ فِي كَفِّهِ الطَّعَامُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who held food in his hand and which glorified Allah.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man who held food in his hand, and it glorified Allah.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بَكَى إِلَيْهِ الجِذْعُ وَحَنَّ لِفِرَاقِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man for whom the palm trunk wept and sighed at its separation from him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man for whom the palm-trunk wept and sighed when parted from him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَوَسَّلَ بِهِ طَيْرُ الفَلَاةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him of whom the birds of the desert sought influence.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one whose favour was sought by the birds of the desert.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَبَّحَتْ فِي كَفِّهِ الحَصَاةُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who held stones in his hand and which glorified Allah.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man who held pebbles in his hand, and they glorified Allah.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَشَفَّعَ إِلَيْهِ الظَّبْيُ بِأَفْصَحِ كَلَامٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him of whom the gazelles sought intercession, in articulate speech,
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one whose intercession the gazelles sought in clear, articulate speech.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَلَّمَهُ الضَّبُّ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ الأَعْلَامِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him to whom the lizard spoke at an open conference of the most learned (or with his most learned companions).
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one to whom the lizard spoke in an open gathering of the most learned.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى البَشِيرِ النَّذِيرِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the devoted evangelist.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the devoted herald of good news.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السِّرَاجِ المُنِيرِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the brilliant lamp.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the shining lamp.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْهِ البَعِيرُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man to whom the camel made its complaint.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man to whom the camel brought its complaint.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَفَجَّرَ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ المَاءُ النَّمِيرُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man for whom the sparking water burst forth from his fingertips for his Companions.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man from whose fingertips sparkling water burst forth for his Companions.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّاهِرِ المُطَهَّرِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who was pure and yet purified.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who was pure and ever purified.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نُورِ الأَنْوَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the light of lights.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the light of lights.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ انْشَقَّ لَهُ القَمَرُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him for whom the moon opened out.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one for whom the moon split open.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الطَّيِّبِ المُطَيَّبِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who was good and who did good.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who was good and did good.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ المُقَرَّبِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the Apostle who was given the privilege of access.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the Messenger granted the privilege of nearness.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الفَجْرِ السَّاطِعِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the spreading dawn.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the spreading dawn.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّجْمِ الثَّاقِبِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the brilliant star.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the brilliant star.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى العُرْوَةِ الوُثْقَى.
units.en: O Allah, bless the trusty handle.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the firm handhold.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى نَذِيرِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the monitor of the people of earth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who counsels the people of the earth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الشَّفِيعِ يَوْمَ العَرْضِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who intercedes for the Day of Visitation.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who intercedes on the Day of the Meeting.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى السَّاقِي لِلنَّاسِ مِنَ الحَوْضِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who gives mankind drink of the cistern.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who gives mankind to drink from the Pool.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ لِوَاءِ الحَمْدِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the standard-bearer of praise.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bearer of the banner of praise.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُشَمِّرِ عَنْ سَاعِدِ الجِدِّ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who bared his arm to the elbow to shoot with zeal (for Thy service)
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who bared his arm to the elbow, shooting with zeal in Your service.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُسْتَعْمِلِ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ غَايَةَ الجُهْدِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him who was a student of Thy Will to the utmost of his power.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one who strove to know Your will with all his power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الخَاتِمِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the sealing Prophet.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the Seal of the Prophets.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الرَّسُولِ الخَاتِمِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the sealing envoy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the Seal of the Messengers.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُصْطَفَى القَائِمِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the chosen and unswerving man.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the chosen one, firm and unswerving.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رَسُولِكَ أَبِي القَاسِمِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless Thy Apostle Abou Qasim.
units.en2: O Allah, bless Your messenger Abū al-Qāsim.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الآيَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man of many signs.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man of many signs.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الدَّلَالَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the author of true guidance.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bringer of true guidance.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الإِشَارَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the author of advice.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the giver of counsel.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الكَرَامَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the worker of wonders.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the worker of wonders.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ العَلَامَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the designer of evidences.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the giver of proofs.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ البَيِّنَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the originator of plain evidence.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bringer of clear evidence.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ المُعْجِزَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the author of miracles.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the author of miracles.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى صَاحِبِ خَوَارِقِ العَادَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the author of unusual customs.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the bringer of wondrous ways.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَلَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِ الأَحْجَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who was greeted by stones.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man greeted by the stones.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَجَدَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ الأَشْجَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man in whose presence the trees did obeisance.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man in whose presence trees bowed down.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ تَفَتَّقَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ الأَزْهَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose light the flowers open.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man at whose light the flowers open.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ طَابَتْ بِبَرَكَتِهِ الثِّمَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose blessing the fruits mature.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man at whose blessing the fruits ripen.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنِ اخْضَرَّتْ مِنْ بَقِيَّةِ وَضُوئِهِ الأَشْجَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man whose left over ablution water turned the trees green.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man whose leftover ablution-water turned the trees green.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ فَاضَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ جَمِيعُ الأَنْوَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man at whose light all other lights burst forth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man from whose light all other lights burst forth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُحَطُّ الأَوْزَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man on prayer to whom lightens our every sinful load.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man through prayer to whom our every load of sin is lightened.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ مَنَازِلُ الأَبْرَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom the most convenient lodgings are granted.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man through prayer to whom the best lodging is granted.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ يُرْحَمُ الكِبَارُ وَالصِّغَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom the great and the small find mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man through prayer to whom great and small find mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ نَتَنَعَّمُ فِي هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَفِي تِلْكَ الدَّارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him, on prayer to whom we shall find things well and pleasant, in this sojourn and in that.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the one through prayer to whom we find all well and pleasant, in this world and the next.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ تُنَالُ رَحْمَةُ العَزِيزِ الغَفَّارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man, on prayer to whom there will be awarded the mercy of the Mighty and Merciful Lord.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man through prayer to whom the mercy of the Mighty and Merciful Lord is granted.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المَنْصُورِ المُؤَيَّدِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the beloved conqueror.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the beloved conqueror.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى المُخْتَارِ المُمَجَّدِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the chosen and honoured man.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the chosen and honoured one.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ إِذَا مَشَى فِي البَرِّ الأَقْفَرِ تَعَلَّقَتِ الوُحُوشُ بِأَذْيَالِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the man who when he was travelling in the most desert lands, the wild creatures actually clung to the skirts of his robe.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the man who, when travelling through the emptiest deserts, had wild creatures clinging to the skirts of his robe.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him and his Family and his Comrades, and give them perfect peace, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah, bless him and his family and his Companions, and grant them perfect peace; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى حِلْمِهِ بَعْدَ عِلْمِهِ، وَعَلَى عَفْوِهِ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِهِ.
units.en: Praise be to Allah for his indulgence as the fruits of His knowledge, and for His Forgiveness as the outcome of His Power.
units.en2: Praise be to Allah for His bounty, the fruit of His knowledge, and for His forgiveness, the outcome of His power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا، أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا، أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ، وَعُضَالِ الدَّاءِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ.
units.en: For, O Allah, I take refuge with Thee for poverty’s sake only to Thee, and for humility to Thee alone, and for fear from Thee alone; and I appeal to Thee whether I speak falsehood, and whether I indulge in wickedness, or whether I am presumptuous with Thee: and I appeal to Thee for the jealousy of the enemies and for the difficulties of misery, and to save the disappointment of my hopes and the loss of pleasure, and the fell effect of vengeance.
units.en2: For, O Allah, in poverty I take refuge with You alone, in humility with You alone, in fear of You alone; and I turn to You whether I speak falsehood, indulge in wickedness, or grow presumptuous with You; and I turn to You against the envy of enemies, the hardships of misery, the disappointment of my hopes, the loss of pleasure, and the cruel stroke of vengeance.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ حَبِيبُكَ (3)
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and give him peace and reward him as much as he deserves, he who is Thy Beloved. {Three times}
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, grant him peace, and reward him as richly as he deserves — Your beloved. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ خَلِيلُكَ (3)
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Abraham and give him peace, and reward him as much as he deserves, he who is Thy Friend. [Three times].
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Abraham, grant him peace, and reward him as richly as he deserves — Your friend. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَاءَ نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast blessed and shown mercy and favour towards our master Abraham in the worlds; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious throughout all Thy creation, and in the pleasure of Thy Soul, and the embellishment of Thy Throne, and the form of Thy Words.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed, showed mercy, and showed favour to our master Abraham throughout the worlds — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious — through all Your creation, to the pleasure of Your Self, the adornment of Your Throne, and the measure of Your words.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who does not bless him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everyone who does not bless him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as he has been blessed.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as he has been blessed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَضْعَافَ مَا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad twice in everything that is blessed in him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad twice over in everything blessed in him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as richly as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى لَهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad even as Thou lovest and favourest him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as You love him and are pleased with him.

sections.note: English: historical translation by Rev. John B. Pearson (Guide to Happiness, Oxford, 1907), in the public domain.

sections.heading: The Third Part (Ḥizb 3 of 8)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى رُوحِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الأَرْوَاحِ، وَعَلَى جَسَدِهِ فِي الأَجْسَادِ، وَعَلَى قَبْرِهِ فِي القُبُورِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the spirit of our master Muhammad among the spirits, and his body among all bodies, and his sepulcher among the sepulchers, and his Family and his Comrades and give them peace.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the spirit of our master Muhammad among the spirits, his body among bodies, and his grave among graves, and bless his family and his Companions, and grant them peace.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, every time that the devout record his name in prayer.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad whenever the mindful remember him in prayer.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كُلَّمَا غَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِ الغَافِلُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad every time that the negligent neglect to record his name.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad whenever the heedless neglect to remember him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ، وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ، صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا لَا يُحْصَى عَدَدُهُمَا، وَلَا يَنْقَطِعُ مَدَدُهُمَا.
units.en: O Allah, bless and give peace to our master Muhammad. the Unlettered Prophet, and his wives who are Mothers of the Faithful, and his descendants, and the people of his Household; blessings and peace that their number can not be reckoned, either of them, or their amount cut short, either of them at all.
units.en2: O Allah, bless and grant peace to our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and to his wives, the Mothers of the Faithful, and his descendants and the people of his household — blessings and peace beyond all reckoning, never to be cut short.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَهُ رِضَاءً، وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، وَأَعْطِهِ الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ اللَّهُمَّ المَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that Thy knowledge includes and Thy Book prescribes: a blessing that will be acceptable to Thee, and a recompense to his truth, and give him influence and grace and rank and advancement, and raise him again, O Allah, in the Honoured Place which Thou hast promised him; and reward him for us who are his people, and bless all his brethren of the Prophets, and those who are Truthful, and who testify to the Truth, and are Upright in conduct.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book prescribes: a blessing pleasing to You and a fitting reward for his truth; grant him intercession, grace, rank, and nearness, and raise him, O Allah, to the Praised Station You promised him; reward him on behalf of us, his people, and bless all his brethren among the prophets, the truthful, the witnesses, and the upright.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْزِلْهُ المُنْزَلَ المُقَرَّبَ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and award him the position of nearest access to Thee in the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and grant him the station nearest to You on the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad,
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَوِّجْهُ بِتَاجِ العِزِّ وَالرِّضَا وَالكَرَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, that he may advance wearing the crown of power and favour and distinction.
units.en2: O Allah, that he may come forward wearing the crown of power, favour, and distinction.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ لِنَفْسِهِ، وَأَعْطِ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ لَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَأَعْطِ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلَ مَا أَنْتَ مَسْئُولٌ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, give to Our master Muhammad the highest favour that he asks of Thee for himself, and give to our master Muhammad the highest favour that any of Thy creation asks of Thee for him; and give our master Muhammad the highest favours that are desired of Thee till the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, give our master Muhammad the highest favour he asks of You for himself; give our master Muhammad the highest favour any of Your creation asks of You for him; and give our master Muhammad the highest favours that will ever be asked of You until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَسَيِّدِنَا نُوحٍ وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مُوسَى وَسَيِّدِنَا عِيسَى، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ (3)
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and our master Adam and our master Noah and our master Abraham and our master Moses and our master Jesus, and all who come between them, be they Prophets or Apostles; the blessings of Allah and his peace be on them one and all [Repeat it Three times]
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, our master Adam, our master Noah, our master Abraham, our master Moses, and our master Jesus, and all the prophets and messengers between them — the blessings of Allah and His peace be upon them all. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى أَبِينَا سَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ وَأُمِّنَا سَيِّدَتِنَا حَوَّاءَ، صَلَاةَ مَلَائِكَتِكَ، وَأَعْطِهِمَا مِنَ الرِّضْوَانِ حَتَّى تُرْضِيَهُمَا، وَاجْزِهِمَا اللَّهُمَّ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ أَبًا وَأُمًّا عَنْ وَلَدَيْهِمَا.
units.en: O Allah, grant to our father and our master Adam and our mother our lady Eve the blessings of Thy angels, and give to both of them Thy Approval till Thou grace them both; and grant them both, O Allah, every reward Thou hast given either to father or mother of all their descendants.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our father, our master Adam, and our mother, our lady Eve, the blessings of Your angels; grant them both Your good pleasure until You are well pleased with them; and grant them, O Allah, every reward You have given to any father or mother among all their descendants.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مِيكَائِيلَ، وَسَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ وَسَيِّدِنَا عَزْرَائِيلَ، وَحَمَلَةِ العَرْشِ وَعَلَى المَلَائِكَةِ وَالمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ (3)
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Gabriel, and master Michael, and master Asraphel and master Azrael, and the bearers of the Thorne, and the angels and those who have the privilege of access, and the Prophets and Apostles, one and all; the blessings and peace of Allah be on them one and all. [Repeat it Three times]
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Gabriel, our master Michael, our master Isrāfīl, and our master Azrael, the bearers of the Throne, the angels brought near, and the prophets and messengers, one and all — the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them all. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا عَلِمْتَ، وَمِلْءَ مَا عَلِمْتَ، وَزِنَةَ مَا عَلِمْتَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad throughout all that Thou knowest, and the fullness that Thou knowest, and the embellishment that Thou knowest, and the ink consumed in the form of Thy Words.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad throughout all that You know, to the fullness of all that You know, with the adornment You know, and with the ink spent on Your words.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً بِالْمَزِيدِ.
units.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing that is ever continuous and ever increasing.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing ever continuous and ever increasing.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً لَا تَنْقَطِعُ أَبَدَ الآبَادِ وَلَا تَبِيدُ.
units.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing that will never terminate through the ages of eternity, and will never pass away.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing that will never end through all eternity and will never pass away.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاتَكَ الَّتِي صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَلَامَكَ الَّذِي سَلَّمْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the blessings Thou hast awarded him; and give our master Muhammad the grants of peace with which Thou hast ever favoured him, and reward him for our sakes, as much as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the blessings You have bestowed on him; grant our master Muhammad the greetings of peace You have always favoured him with, and reward him on our behalf as richly as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا مَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing that will satisfy him, and that Thou will approve for our sakes, and reward him for our sakes, as much as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing that will content him and win Your approval on our behalf, and reward him on our behalf as richly as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ، وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ، وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ، وَعَرُوسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ، وَإِمَامِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَطِرَازِ مُلْكِكَ، وَخَزَائِنِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَطَرِيقِ شَرِيعَتِكَ، المُتَلَذِّذِ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ، إِنْسَانِ عَيْنِ الوُجُودِ، وَالسَّبَبِ فِي كُلِّ مَوْجُودٍ، عَيْنِ أَعْيَانِ خَلْقِكَ، المُتَقَدِّمِ مِنْ نُّورِ ضِيَائِكَ، صَلَاةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِكَ، وَتَبْقَى بِبَقَائِكَ، لَا مُنْتَهَى لَهَا دُونَ عِلْمِكَ، صَلَاةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتُرْضِيهِ، وَتَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Sea of Thy Brilliancy, and the Mine of Thy Secretes, and the Voice of Thy Arguments, and the Bridegroom of Thy kingdom, and the Imam of Thy Presence, and the Robe of Thy Power, and the Treasure of Thy Mercy, and the Pathway of Thy Divine Law, ever delighting men with Thy Doctrine of the Unity of Allah, the Eye of Existence and the Cause of everything that exists; the Eye of the eyes of Thy Creation, first advanced in the Light of Thy Brightness; a blessing that will endure in the eternity, and that will survive while Thou Survivest; that will never end for those who have the guidance of Thy knowledge; a blessing that will satisfy Thee, and will satisfy him, and by which from ourselves, Thou wilt find Pleasure, O Thou Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad — the ocean of Your radiance, the mine of Your secrets, the tongue of Your proofs, the bridegroom of Your kingdom, the imam of Your presence, the robe of Your power, the treasure of Your mercy, the pathway of Your sacred law, ever delighting in Your oneness, the eye of existence and the cause of all that exists, the foremost of Your creation in the light of Your brightness — with a blessing that endures for eternity, that lasts as long as You last, that never ends for those guided by Your knowledge: a blessing that satisfies You, satisfies him, and wins Your pleasure with us, O Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِ اللَّهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through everything that is within the knowledge of Allah; a blessing that will endure through the eternity of the Kingdom of Allah.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that is within the knowledge of Allah — a blessing enduring through the everlasting kingdom of Allah.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَي نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا ذَكَرَكَ بِهِ خَلْقُكَ فِيمَا مَضَى، وَعَدَدَ مَا هُمْ ذَاكِرُونَكَ بِهِ فِيمَا بَقَى، فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ وَشَهْرٍ وَجُمُعَةٍ وَيَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ وَسَاعَةٍ مِنَ السَّاعَاتِ وَشَمٍّ وَنَفَسٍ وَطَرْفَةٍ وَلَمْحَةٍ، مِنَ الأَبَدِ إِلَى الأَبَدِ، وَآبَادِ الدُّنْيَا وَآبَادِ الآخِرَةِ، وَأَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، لَا يَنْقَطِعُ أَوَّلُهُ، وَلا يَنْفَدُ آخِرُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and show favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst towards the Family of our master Abraham throughout the ages, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious throughout Thy Creation and the pleasure of Thy Soul, and the embellishment of Thy Throne, and the ink of Thy Words, in all that Thy creation records of Thee in whatever has occurred, and in all that they are recording of Thee of whatever may have still to occur any year or month, or week, or day or night or any one hour of the hours, or breath, or second, or instant, or moment; from age to age, and to the ages of the world, and to the ages of after- time, and even more than that, the first whereof will never terminate, and the end whereof will never disappear.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as You blessed our master Abraham, and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You showed favour to the family of our master Abraham throughout the ages — You are Praiseworthy and Glorious — through all Your creation, to the pleasure of Your Self, the adornment of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words: in all that Your creation has recorded of You of what has passed, and all they are recording of You of what is yet to come, in any year or month, week, day or night, any hour of the hours, breath, second, instant, or moment — from age to age, to the ages of the world, to the ages of the after-time, and beyond even that, with no first that ever ends and no end that ever disappears.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ حُبِّكَ فِيهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the power of Thy Love for him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad by the power of Your love for him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ عِنَايَتِكَ بِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the power of Thy Solicitude for him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad by the power of Your care for him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَمِقْدَارِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the truth of his power and authority.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad by the truth of his power and authority.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الأَهْوَالِ وَالآفَاتِ، وَتَقْضِي لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيعَ الحَاجَاتِ، وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الغَايَاتِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الخَيْرَاتِ، فِي الحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ المَمَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad with a blessing whereby Thou wilt enable us to escape from all alarms and uncertainty and will satisfy therewith all our needs, and wilt purify us from all vices, and wilt advance us to all grades of honour, and wilt enable us to reach the utmost ranges of all that is good in life and after death.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad with a blessing by which You deliver us from every fear and uncertainty, meet all our needs, purify us from every vice, raise us to the highest degrees of honour, and bring us to the utmost heights of all that is good in life and after death.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةَ الرِّضَا، وَارْضَ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ رِضَاءَ الرِّضَا.
units.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing of approval, and accept from his Comrades the same as fully as may be.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad a blessing of approval, and accept from his Companions the like of it, as fully as can be.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ السَّابِقِ لِلْخَلْقِ نُورُهُ، وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ ظُهُورُهُ، عَدَدَ مَنْ مَضَى مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَمَنْ بَقِيَ، وَمَنْ سَعِدَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ شَقِيَ، صَلَاةً تَسْتَغْرِقُ العَدَّ، وَتُحِيطُ بِالْحَدِّ، صَلَاةً لَا غَايَةَ لَهَا وَلا مُنْتَهَى وَلَا انْقِضَاءَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ، وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the foremost of the Creatures who enjoy his light; whose appearance is Mercy to all the Worlds, with every one of Thy Creation who passes away, and of every one who remains, and every one of them who enjoys happiness, and every one who is unhappy; a blessing that will transcend all amounts and embrace all limits: a blessing that has no limit, no boundary, no termination; a blessing that endures through Thy Existence, and extending to his Family and his Comrades, and perfect peace, agreeing therewith.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad — the foremost of creatures who share his light, whose coming was mercy to all the worlds — with every one of Your creation who passes away and everyone who remains, everyone happy and everyone unhappy: a blessing that surpasses all counting and encompasses all limits, a blessing with no limit, no boundary, no end, a blessing enduring as long as You endure — extending to his family and his Companions, with perfect peace to match.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي مَلَأْتَ قَلْبَهُ مِنْ جَلَالِكَ، وَعَيْنَهُ مِنْ جَمَالِكَ، فَأَصْبَحَ فَرِحًا مُؤَيَّدًا مَنْصُورًا، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, grant a blessing to our master Muhammad, whose heart Thou didst fill with Thy Majesty, and his eye with Thy Beauty; most noble, most joyous, beloved, victorious; yes, and to his Family and his Comrades; perfect peace withal, and praise be to Allah for this.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, whose heart You filled with Your majesty and his eye with Your beauty — most noble, most joyous, beloved, victorious — and his family and his Companions too, with perfect peace; and praise be to Allah for this.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الزَّيْتُونِ وَجَمِيعِ الثِّمَارِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad throughout all the leaves of the olive trees, and in all fruits.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad as many times as all the leaves of the olive trees, and as all fruits.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا كَانَ وَيَكُونُ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that has been, and everything that will be; everything on which the night has darkened, or the light dawned on it.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad in everything that has been and everything that will be — everything the night has darkened and everything the dawn has lit.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِ أُمَّتِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad, and his Family, and his wives and his descendants, through all the souls of his followers.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master and patron Muhammad, his family, his wives, and his descendants, as many times as all the souls of his followers.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِبَرَكَةِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ اجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الفَائِزِينَ، وَعَلَى حَوْضِهِ مِنَ الوَارِدِينَ الشَّارِبِينَ، وَبِسُنَّتِهِ وَطَاعَتِهِ مِنَ العَامِلِينَ، وَلا تَحُلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدِينَا وَلِجَمِيعِ المُسْلِمِينَ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, through the favour of the blessing upon him, of the blessing upon him, make us to be among those who share it, and at his cistern let us be of those who descend there and drink of it: and let us be of those who labour at his law and his obedience; then Thou wilt not make a separation between us and him in the Day of Resurrection: yea, Thou Lord of the World; and pardon ourselves and our parents and all Muslims. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah, by the grace of the blessing upon him, make us among those who share it; at his Pool let us be among those who come down and drink; make us among those who work by his law and his obedience; then do not part us from him on the Day of Resurrection — yes, O Lord of the Worlds — and forgive us, our parents, and all Muslims. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَكْرَمِ خَلْقِكَ، وَسِرَاجِ أُفُقِكَ، وَأَفْضَلِ قَائِمٍ بِحَقِّكَ، المَبْعُوثِ بِتَيْسِيرِكَ وَرِفْقِكَ، صَلَاةً يَتَوَالَى تَكْرَارُهَا، وَتَلُوحُ عَلَى الأَكْوَانِ أَنْوَارُهَا.
units.en: O Allah, grant blessing and peace and favour to our master Muhammad and to the Family of our master Muhammad, the most Noble of Thy Creation, and the Shining Lamp of Thy Heaven; highest in grace, ever persevering in Thy Truth, the Envoy of Thy Relief and Kindness; a blessing that will ever continue to renew itself, that will shine during the existence of its brightness.
units.en2: O Allah, grant blessing, peace, and favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad — the noblest of Your creation, the shining lamp of Your heaven, highest in grace, ever steadfast in Your truth, the envoy of Your relief and kindness — a blessing that ever renews itself and shines as long as its brightness lasts.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلِ مَمْدُوحٍ بِقَوْلِكَ، وَأَشْرَفِ دَاعٍ لِلِاعْتِصَامِ بِحَبْلِكَ، وَخَاتِمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ، صَلَاةً تُبَلِّغُنَا فِي الدَّارَيْنِ عَمِيمَ فَضْلِكَ، وَكَرَامَةَ رِضْوَانِكَ وَوَصْلِكَ.
